chapters.title: Chapter 51: Zipppp...
paragraphs: Vritra talked with Vanessa for a while longer and understood her problem. Because of her Succubus physique, her body was acting strangely.

Sometimes even she had no control over her actions—her body released that sweet smell that made even him dazed for a moment. But the biggest problem was that when he was around her, his body was reacting strangely to her.

It was certainly because of the natural effects of her bloodline and physique. Vritra was sure once she got a little stronger, she would be able to control it on her own; but for now, it seemed he would have to take care of his mother.
After spending a couple of hours with his mother, he decided to pay a visit to his slave. Walking out of the castle, Vritra looked at the sky—it was already evening, and the sun had started to set.

"Now, it is time to finally meet your classmates and all the people you believe might have something to do with that attempt at taking your life; still, we have to be a bit careful of the Nine Pacts." Yasmine’s melodic voice sounded in his head. Vritra nodded. He would start from small targets—that is, his classmates.
Once he got involved with stronger people, the game would undoubtedly be much more dangerous. He only needed to send his mother to safety first before going all out.
While planning a few things along with his supportive and encouraging wife, Vritra made his way towards the temple. Even as he walked, he kept earning Sin Points, though the number was low.
After a few minutes, he arrived close to the majestic white temple that looked very beautiful and holy.

Just as he was about to approach the entrance, his ears picked up a high-pitched voice that was singing a really shitty song. Vritra looked to the right side wall of the temple as he saw a shiny bald head.
There was a man in his twenties who was singing and peeing on the temple wall. He was even aiming and making a drawing.
"I am a master... m- m- master... Master disaster, pro and fantast-er,
My father once called me—’You son of a bitch, Can’t you even flip the switch?!’
My mother whipped me with the back of her wig, Screaming at me, ’You’re the lost kid of a darn pig!’
I am a master... m-m-master... master blaster, pro and fantasto—uwahhh!!"
It was none other than Monk Shitless, who was startled when he suddenly heard the sound of footsteps approaching. He pulled up his pants in haste and closed the zip in a hurry—
"Aaaaaaaaaah!!!" A heart-wrenching scream rang out as Monk Shitless fell down and, while holding his crotch, began to roll around. His bull glanced at him and just ignored the monk.
Vritra observed him from a distance for a minute, then shook his head and walked away. He truly was a liar—there was no way someone like that could read fortunes.
"P-Pitiful one? Is that you? Did you come here to help me ease my pain? H-Hurry up and ask the priest to sparkle some holy water on me." Monk Shitless saw Vritra and begged desperately for his help.

’Oh, he recognized me even faster than my mother. This guy’s level is quite low, but it seems he truly isn’t that simple.’After thinking, Vritra took out a healing potion that he had borrowed from the castle’s inventory and threw it toward the monk before walking away.

"T-Thank you, Pitiful One! You are about to experience something very good. Don’t reject your fate. But be careful of snakes..." Monk Shitless shouted before focusing on his critical injury. The poor man was crying and wiped his snot on the clothes of the guards that came to help him.
Vritra walked into the temple and saw that Diana was sitting on a lavish seat, while lots of people sat on chairs in front of her as they prayed to the god and worshipped Diana.

She was wearing a long white dress that was adorned with beautiful jewels and embroideries. She looked just as pure and beautiful; her milky white skin seemed to be glowing, and she held a proud expression.
He stood at the back of the chairs, attracting several eyes toward him. But as Diana saw him, she was startled, and her arrogant expression changed to helplessness and anger.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}

She hastily ended the prayer and walked back toward her room while acting calm. She didn’t want Vritra to create a scene in front of those people. While climbing the stairs, she glanced back and saw that he was no longer there.
’Did he leave? Was it because I was busy? There is no way... so where is he?’Diana wondered as she arrived in front of her room and pushed open the door.
Then she froze again as she muttered,
"Y-You, when did you get here?!!"
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}

Vritra was sitting calmly on the bed, eating a juicy fruit he picked from there. Diana looked around and then entered, closing the door behind her as she approached him and stood silently in front of him.

She knew that her peaceful month had already ended. Almost every night she had the same dream—in which she was sucking his penis and drinking that thick white semen. She felt that he had spoiled her holy and pure body.
"I just came back." Vritra stood up and put the fruit away, then he patted her head and complimented, "You did a great job in taking care of my mother. I will give you a nice reward very soon."

Diana wanted to directly reject his reward, but she remained silent. She stared at his face, wondering if he was really Vritra. He seemed to have changed quite a bit, and now appeared dangerous somehow.
"Oh right, I had something that belonged to you. You should have it back." After speaking, he took out the black box and placed it in front of her.
"Did you manage to solve it?" Diana asked. She was very curious about its content.
"Of course not. Do you think it is so easy?" Vritra shook his head.
"Yes, no one has managed to solve this puzzle—hmmm... does it seem a little light?" Diana wondered as she held the black box.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}

"It must be your imagination. Anyway, I want you to call a meeting where all my classmates should be summoned tomorrow early in the morning. Did anyone else die among them?" he asked as he sat down on the chair and pulled the goddess’s hand.
"Ahh—" Diana suddenly lost her balance as she landed softly on Vritra’s lap. Her cheeks burned with shame and humiliation, but she sat still, feeling his warmth against her thighs.
{Sin Point Gained: Resentful +1}
He was treating a goddess as he wished, yet Diana could only drink her anger and nod.

"Okay, I will call the meeting. And no, no one else died after that incident in the labyrinth, though a few of the boys had gone out to train with a strong team led by one of the guard commanders." She answered in a low voice, as she wriggled in his lap to find a more comfortable position.
Although she was still filled with defiant feelings, she could accept this much. Unknown to her, she was already getting tamed.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Flower of allure
paragraphs: Diana sat on Vritra’s lap like a well-behaved child, fighting was obviously not her strongest suit though it didn’t mean she was weak, but now she was completely at his mercy.
"Is there some event going on in the capital where a lot of people gather?" Vritra questioned, one of his hands resting over her thigh while with his left hand he was caressing her long white hair.
"Not currently, but in a few days I heard there is going to be a competition for the recruitment of guards in the castle, but I don’t know much about it," the beautiful goddess answered.
"How many people do you think will come to watch?" he asked further.
"I am not sure, should be around a thousand," she replied with a thoughtful expression; she never takes interest in such low-level mortal affairs.
"I see," Vritra nodded and decided to go there to earn some sin points. Spinning that Gacha was quite addicting, then he remained silent for a while and asked:
"Is there an opportunity to safely and officially leave this kingdom? I want to send my mother out first, do you have a way?"
Diana remained silent for a while, trying to ignore the comfort that came from his caress and the burning sensation over her thighs. Finally, she nodded and replied:

"Indeed, there will be a chance. Summoning heroes to fight the demons is a big matter and is discussed between several kingdoms. This time it was our luck to be the one to do it. Still, while in the training phase, few of the heroes are allowed to visit other kingdoms. That is to increase their attachment and maybe if they want, they could settle in that kingdom. This is the rule, and after a month or so I will be bringing some heroes along to visit other kingdoms."
"Yes, that is a good chance but I doubt the king will let the best heroes leave the kingdom, right?" Vritra pondered.

"Yeah, aside from the top, I am free to bring anyone with me. So it’s a good thing that no one is aware of your and your mother’s strength and talent. No one would object it, if you want I can bring you both to whichever kingdom you wish," she added with a hopeful look in her eyes. She wondered if Vritra left, would she be free?

"Hurry that trip as much as you can and bring my mother out safely, I will follow along on my own. For now just call the meeting." After speaking Vritra gently slapped her ass, as Diana stood up with a startle.
"And your reward, you will have it soon." Vritra spoke and walked towards the door, while Diana stood there with a red face and slight anger in her eyes, wanting to beat him up a bit.
"Oh right, what is up with that Monk... Shitless?" Vritra held the doorknob and asked.

"He... uh He came here from the Blue Kingdom. He is the priest of the temple there and he came here speaking that fate was calling him or something," Diana answered with a shrug, she didn’t really like that bald Monk.

Nodding, Vritra walked out of the room as the goddess finally relaxed and fell back on the bed. Whenever he is around she always feels on edge. Vritra left the temple and headed back towards his room, it was already getting dark. He didn’t see the Monk there.
’Is someone following me?’ Vritra felt a faint sensation. He looked at the message that had popped out and indeed that was the case.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +1}

"Yeah, it’s a middle-aged man. He is wearing a black robe but from the leather armor he is wearing underneath, I am sure he must be a part of this kingdom’s army," Yasmine spoke. She could sense the killing intent in the man’s eyes.
’Then he must be the guard commander, heh I had allowed him to live until now but he is begging to die. What is his level?’ Vritra acted as if nothing was wrong as he walked back towards the castle.
"Should be around level... two hundred fifty," Yasmine answered.
’Oh, he is at quite a high level,’ Vritra was a bit surprised but still not worried.

"Not really. You have gained so many levels in such a short time so it might seem like those levels aren’t very easy to gain, but these people have lived for at least a century. Even if they slowly kill a few monsters every few days they would continue to gain levels; not to mention he is a mere human, even at the same level you could crush thousands like him instantly," Yasmine said proudly and confidently.
After a while the gaze vanished as Vritra walked into the castle. Right from the next day he planned to start causing trouble and killing a few people around.
After walking into the corridor where their rooms were located, Vritra paused and spoke in a low voice: "Hellmancer."
A dark shadow instantly separated from Vritra’s shadow and lingered on the ground in front of him. The soul wraith didn’t reveal its body as it waited for orders.

"Go and keep watch over the person who was watching me secretly, and don’t do anything until I give any further order," Vritra ordered as the humming sound of acknowledgement rang out before the dark shadow disappeared.

Even though at level 742 Hellmancer wasn’t the strongest soul wraith, it was undoubtedly the smartest among the five. Plus, it possessed all kinds of strange spells, even from curses to debuffs, so without anyone knowing he could easily kill anyone.

After sending it away Vritra entered his mother’s room. At this time Vanessa was preparing the dinner. The two sat together and ate, and again Vritra seemed to gain experience points from the food, though his mother just said it is an additional ability of hers.

After eating and chatting for a while, it was finally time to sleep. At first Vritra was going back to his room to sleep but under the pitiful pleading of his mother and remembering that she is currently having some strange problems, he gave in.

The two lay on the bed just normally, it wasn’t long before the two fell asleep. Then a very strong scent drifted from Vanessa’s body, which was like a strong aphrodisiac, a scent that her body seemed to be making naturally.

Vritra was soon affected by the scent. As he inhaled more and more of this sweet scent, his body began to feel hotter and hotter, so like before he took off the clothes from his upper body and threw it away in sleep before falling back.
In the darkness, Vanessa opened her eyes that seemed to be glowing with a pink light. She stared at her son’s face for a few seconds then apologized to him in her mind.
’Sorry, honey. But I am gonna need you to take the initiative, we can only depend on each other in this new world.’
The sound of clothes rustling rang out in the silent room, as Vanessa adjusted them in a manner that her chest was exposed and both of her large milky white boobs had come out of all restraints.
Then she lay on her side, facing him and made use of her ability, calledFlower of Allure, that would attract her target towards her like a bee to nectar rich flower.

paragraphs: Vritra was having a very comfortable sleep. He was hugging something very soft and warm that felt nice and cool against his body; it had been quite a long time since he felt so comfortable.

Something sweet, tasty, and warm filled his mouth as the creamy fluid flooded in. Vritra subconsciously gulped it all down. There was something soft in his mouth that was releasing all that delicious and sweet fluid.

He pushed his face forward, burying it into something very soft as he began to crave more of that warm liquid in his sleep. Within seconds, he was sucking the small candy like thing that had slowly turned hard inside his mouth. It rested over his tongue, and with each squeeze and suck, more delicious fluid flowed out.
GULP GULP

The warm sensation traveled down his throat and filled his belly. From the taste to the drinking, all of it felt so good that Vritra sucked harder, his tongue lapping continuously at the pink nipple that was releasing waves after waves of hot milk.

Vanessa bit her lip and stifled her moan as she hugged his head tightly, making it easier for him to suckle. As she gazed down at Vritra’s face, peacefully feeding from her boobs, she was reminded of the time he was little, though it felt erotic now.
Vritra’s eyes fluttered, and Vanessa hastily closed hers, pretending to be asleep. As Vritra unconsciously bit her nipple lightly, Vanessa let out a soft moan that finally awoke him.

His eyes opened as he blinked in confusion. There was something warm constantly entering his mouth and flowing down his throat, and even now, his mouth and tongue were working tirelessly on their own at the strange object in his mouth.

He pulled his face back a bit and tried to observe exactly what was happening. Then he froze as he noticed that right now, he was drinking his mother’s milk, and her nipple was filling up his mouth. The whole situation was too bizarre.
’W- What am I doing? How did we end up like this? Is that milk? Wait, why is she lactating?’ Vritra’s mind instantly became a mess. He just stayed still with Vanessa’s nipple in his mouth.

Finally coming to his senses, Vritra pulled his head back as her nipple came out of his mouth with a wet pop sound, leaving behind a strong taste of her sweet milk. The tip of her nipple was still glistening with droplets of her milk.

This sudden motion seemed to have woken up the history’s best actor. Vanessa first looked at Vritra, then down at her chest, and she pretended to be surprised yet didn’t cover up her chest as she asked:
"H- Honey? What were you doing?"

"I- uhh..." Vritra took a deep breath. His mother’s boobs were still right in front of his face. She didn’t move one bit and even seemed to slightly push her nipples forward temptingly while making it seem like she hadn’t done anything.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Seduced +1}
Vritra’s mind became calm. He soon noticed that the milky taste in his mouth seemed quite familiar. Then he sighed and sat up, pulling his arm away from under Vanessa’s head.
Massaging his temples, Vritra spoke in a serious tone:
"Mom, I have been trying not to think about it, but you still keep doing it. If you keep on lying to me, then I wouldn’t even be able to have faith in the only person whom I trust the most.

Do you want me to be wary of you at all times? Even if you don’t have any intentions of hurting me, I don’t like getting lied to. In the end, my only choice would be to go away from you. Do you really want that?"

As Vritra spoke, Vanessa’s face was filled with horror as she sat up hastily. Her heart almost stopped just imagining being separated from her son. Tears welled up in her eyes. It was like something heavy was stuck in her throat suddenly, and she couldn’t speak.
She straightened her clothes and covered her chest, then tilted her head and muttered in a very low voice:

"I am s- sorry, it’s all my fault. The situation became so strange from the start t- that I had no choice but to hide it from you. Please forgive me and never leave me. I will never lie to you again."

Vanessa felt guilt and fear creeping into her heart. She had already been thinking about herself all this time and didn’t consider her son’s feelings. She knew that he would be able to catch on easily, but she couldn’t find any other solutions.
"It’s fine, but tell me everything truthfully now. If you try to lie to me again, then after leaving this kingdom, we would never meet again."
Vritra’s eyes held no emotion as he spoke. His tone made her feel even worse. She had never regretted any of her decisions so badly.

chapters.title: Chapter 54: I will support you
paragraphs: "Such a thing indeed happens in the Succubus race, many of them even die in the end, but after living for a long time, of course, they found a way to delay this. But finding anyone from the succubus race is a lot more difficult than even finding dragons.

Humans and demons both are trying to find them since leveling up with a succubus is the most pleasurable way of getting stronger. All of them have completely disappeared so that they don’t end up as others’ toys.

Your mother should still be able to hold on for two or three more weeks or maybe even a week, but after that her identity and life will both be in danger." Yasmine explained, her words putting a deep frown on Vritra’s face.
He then looked at his mother and asked: "By the word bonding in the skill, does it mean..."
Vanessa nodded, as she said directly: "It does mean that. As long as that thing enters even once, the master crest could be obtained."

"Sigh, I see. I know it must be difficult for you, holding back all kinds of thoughts and urges. Give me a little time, I will do whatever I can to help you." Vritra spoke as he hugged his mother’s delicate body, but he also knew that there was only one option.

After letting out everything, Vanessa felt a lot better; she slept a lot more peacefully while using his arm as her pillow. While Vritra remained deep in thought, it seemed he would have to help his mother, though the process was very unusual.
He had never looked at his mother like that, but now he couldn’t ignore her sinful body.
He closed his eyes and decided to ’help’ his mother later. She would never even go near a man, and without a master, her fate would be very bad.
’Yasmine, what do you think?’ he asked.
"It is fine no matter what you choose, I will support you." She spoke in a gentle tone, her presence alone feeling like a huge comfort.
’Thanks...’
Early in the morning, inside a large hall in the castle.
A lot of people had gathered upon receiving the order from the goddess. It seemed she had something important to announce.

Thirty-two teenagers from Earth sat on the seats as they chatted among themselves and wondered the reason behind the meeting. They were about to leave for hunting or training when all of them were summoned here.
There were also lots of guards present, several commanders, and even the king, who sat calmly over the throne.

Two people stood on either side of King Aldric. One wore golden armor, his presence exuding an intense pressure on the surrounding, while the other person was wearing a black robe with his face hidden. His presence was almost impossible to detect.
Several ministers of the kingdom and other important figures had also gathered. There were more than a hundred people present currently. All of them waited patiently for Diana.
"Has the capital been peaceful recently?" Aldric asked. A scholar-like man was standing in front of him while holding a book.
"Yes, recently no demons have been spotted, but there are traces of spies here. They might have caught onto a few things," the scholar, who is the information minister, spoke.
The four people were covered in a faint boundary that stopped others from hearing their words.
"Release some demons outside the boundary of the capital in the kingdom and send these heroes to deal with them. Let them receive some limelight. As for the spies, they will be taken care of soon."
After a short pause, the king asked: "How is the investigation on Vritra going? If there is nothing unusual, then kill him. We only have so few test subjects."
"Yes, my lord. After observing him for a while, he seems to have some connection with the goddess, though his strength is still stuck at level 1. Is it still okay to kill him?" the scholar spoke.
Just as the king was about to answer, he noticed that the beautiful goddess was approaching. He looked at the scholar and answered quickly.
"Observe him for a little longer. If nothing is out of the ordinary, then kill him." Then the barrier disappeared as the king stood up with a smile and welcomed the goddess, who took her seat.
"Goddess, did you have something important to announce?" the king asked in a respectful tone, while the scholar walked away and took his seat.
"Yes, you will know soon." Diana replied, her expression as icy and prideful as ever.

"Are we going on some important mission?" Max stood up from his seat, looking straight at Diana and asked. He wore a brown dress and looked very arrogant. It seemed his bad nature had only intensified after coming to this world.

"..." Diana looked at him and felt how disgustingly weak he was when compared to someone like Vritra. She ignored him completely. Previously, his talent seemed good, but now it was as bad as his personality.
"What is-" Max felt a little angry at being ignored, but before he could speak, he noticed that all the heads had turned towards the entrance of the hall.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +168}

A boy looking devilishly charming entered the hall, and walking beside him was an exceedingly beautiful woman. Her face and figure were just too seductive; almost everyone in the hall was captivated by the two people.
"They are?" the king asked, and everyone focused to hear the answer.
"This is Vritra, one of the summoned heroes, and that is Vanessa, his mother." Diana spoke calmly.

"..." Silence fell for a few seconds, then everyone exclaimed in shock. All the teenagers had seen Vanessa before; she looked very hot and beautiful, but now it seemed her charms had been multiplied by at least 100. Even in loose clothes, her voluptuous figure remained too mouthwatering.
"T- That is Vritra?" several boys exclaimed. Half of his face was always covered by his messy long hair, but it was impossible to believe that he could be so good-looking.
"I- I did hear that he returned from the labyrinth, but... is he really not an imposter? Jack’s looks appear like a joke in front of him." Raino spoke, rubbing his eyes.
"Goddess Diana, King Aldric, it is nice to meet you. I am Vritra, the one who almost died in the labyrinth." Vritra spoke after a moment, a small smile on his face.
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +165}
Vritra noticed that three people weren’t surprised. Aside from his mother and Diana, one of the two people standing beside the king should have seen him before.

"We are overjoyed that you managed to survive such a disaster. Even without the demons, the labyrinth contains several traps. It was our fault not to take them into account." Aldric spoke with some regret in his voice.

"It’s nobody’s fault that I almost died after falling into the trap. I must have been hit by a demon since I lost consciousness, but some people saved me, thankfully." Vritra spoke. The reason behind creating this meeting was to gauge the reactions of several people and also to earn some points—not to mention his revenge.
"Yo Max, it’s been a long time. Looks like you have grown a lot stronger now."
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +168}
{Sin Point Gained: Flustered +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared At +1}

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Kinky
paragraphs: Max was baffled for a moment. After all, he was the one to deliver that strike that left Vritra paralyzed for a while, but he soon returned to his usual self. A mocking smile spread across his face as he laughed and spoke:

"Seriously, all of us have missed you so much, we were truly sad when we heard that you died. All of our rooms have gotten really dirty. Now that you are back, won’t you use that great ability of yours to help us clean everything?"
{Sin Point Gained: Taunted +1}
The tense atmosphere became normal again. Everyone’s attention was now completely on Vritra; they still found it hard to believe that he actually looked like this.

"Sure, I will help you clean everything." Vritra spoke, his gaze moving from Max to Fiona for a moment as his lips curled up. He could give others a normal death, but for a selected few, he planned to torture them both physically and mentally before killing them.

Vritra observed the group of his classmates. His teacher and a few students were gone. It seemed three or four people from Max’s group had gone out to train, so they weren’t attending the meeting. Even Jace and Tyler were there, though both still looked a bit weak because of stress.
Encouraged by Max’s words, a member of his group called Raino the pervert laughed and hit the armrest as he spoke:
"Yeah, I got a little dust on my clothes. Can you help me clean it, sir janitor?"
A few of the teenagers who were friends with Max laughed. A few like Fiona and Jack didn’t pay much attention to such comments. A very few felt pity.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Laughed at +25}
{Sin Point Gained: Got Pitied +9}
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +168}

’Sigh, keep the sin points coming... such a refreshing feeling.’ Vritra’s smile widened. Normally, he wouldn’t show off too much, but now he got stronger by showing off, so Vritra wasn’t planning to shy away.
Looking at Raino with a friendly smile, Vritra nodded:
"Of course, my friend. It is our duty to contribute as much as we can in whatever ways."
{Sin Point Gained: Looked down upon +164}
"Hmm, you indeed look dirty. You should be careful of the dust on your clothes..."

As Vritra spoke, he twirled his finger in the air as the dust particles swirled around Raino like small blades, and before he could even notice, his clothes had been torn to shreds. But they were still stuck to his body as Vritra continued:
"Also, dust on your face and the seat you are seated on. Dust could be anywhere and in any form."

As Vritra finished speaking, a beastial roar filled with utter pain rang out, startling almost all the people present there. His body jerked up like a spring as all the clothes on his body were cut into tiny pieces. Countless small cuts appeared on his face, but what was worst of all was the thing that everyone saw on his seat.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +169}
All the people were shocked to see a small thick needle of nearly 10 cm height made of dust standing straight at the place Raino was seated on. It was covered in blood.

"Oh, sorry. I didn’t notice you were using something like that to sit on, aren’t you a kinky one." Vritra said as he turned his eyes away from the slightly fat naked boy, who was holding his ass and jumping around like a monkey, a small joke hanging between his legs.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +76}
{Sin Point Gained: Silenced +11}
{Sin Point Gained: Tormented +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +1}

Max was extremely angry, but before he could do anything, Fiona pulled him back and shook her head. She could feel that Vritra wasn’t weak. In fact, she wasn’t sure she would be able to defeat him even after reaching a level as high as 81.
Max was even slightly weaker than her. She didn’t want the boy she loved to suffer something like that or be a joke. How could she allow his bad boy image to be ruined?
Even Vanessa was a little worried since he did something like that in front of everyone, even the king is here, but seeing that no one made a big issue out of it she felt relieved.
Ignoring Raino, Vritra looked at the king and spoke in a solemn tone:
"Actually, it was me who called out this meeting. There is very important news that I needed to share with everyone."

’What is this Great Demon Emperor planning to do now? Whatever it is, he is certainly going to create trouble.’ Diana thought and sighed. She knew she would have to help in whatever situation he ends up in.
"...Is that so? What kind of news do you have to share?" the king glanced at Raino, who was being carried by a couple of guards, creating a long line of blood on the ground.

’So Yasmine, how strong do you think the king and the other two are?’ Vritra asked. He didn’t use the appraisal skill since he had checked it before, and strong people could feel if someone was probing their strength.

"That man in golden armor is very strong. If you were to go all out without hiding any of your abilities and trump cards such as soul wraiths and that purple flame, then there is an eighty percent chance you could kill him, twenty percent chance that he could escape. His level is definitely above 800; he must be one of the top warriors of this kingdom.

As for the king, he is strong, but I can tell he gathered those levels like your mother, so you would be able to kill him without using everything you have. His level should be around five hundred, and he is several centuries old despite his appearance.

As for that man in black, I am certain he is from the Nine Pacts. Dealing with him will be troublesome. If we manage to kill him, we would only be attracting a lot of trouble toward us. It would be better to avoid him for now, but in the worst case, we will have to leave this kingdom after killing him." Yasmine explained in a serious tone.
Vritra nodded internally. Then his smile transformed into a solemn expression as he spoke:
"King, when I was returning to the castle from the labyrinth a day ago, I found something in the capital."

Then he took out a demonic giant’s corpse out of his inventory. He had kept a few for explosions and rations. As the large body of the giant fell to the ground, it covered a big part of the hall. All the teenagers gasped at seeing such a terrifying demon; they could tell it was several times stronger than them.
{Sin Point Gained: Bewildered +122}
{Sin Point Gained: Petrified +67}
"Oh? Tell me more about it." The king spoke as he observed the corpse and saw that its head was split in two, though it still remained connected to its body.
The man in golden remained still, his soul duty was to protect the king but the person in black robe appeared quite interested.

• Mana: 938
Even though there wasn’t a very high difference between Vritra’s stats and Arthur’s stats, the actual power difference between the two was huge because of their level difference.
If the two fought normally, Vritra would undoubtedly lose—but a real fight might not always be fair.
Arthur’s brows furrowed inside the armor upon sensing that gaze, but suddenly that presence disappeared—it was as if that person had never existed in that part of space.
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +2}
Not only Arthur but even Diana was shocked to see Vritra disappear all of a sudden, and she couldn’t sense him anywhere. She gulped and stood rooted to the same place.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
But before Arthur could ponder the change for too long, a change occurred in front of him suddenly.
The demonic giant corpse suddenly swelled. All the people were shocked by the sudden transformation, and most of them didn’t even have the time to react—even the king was frozen.

But Arthur and the man in the black robe reacted fast. Before the corpse could explode, both of them formed protective barriers. A golden barrier surrounded only the king— Arthur focused only on protecting the king as he jumped in front of Aldric.

While a black barrier protected the king and the teenagers, the man in the black robe stood there calmly, trying to locate the enemy. He was protecting the king, but more of his focus was on protecting those teenagers.
BOOOOOOOM

Finally, the demon giant’s corpse exploded as fire engulfed the entire hall and destroyed most of the things inside. Even several walls were shattered. Most guards were able to protect themselves with only a few injuries, but a few were seriously injured and very few even died.
"EXHUME!!"
Before the madness of the explosion could die down, five shadows of various shapes and sizes suddenly jumped out in front of the king.
ROOOOAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRRR
One was a Demon Giant—much more majestic and bigger than the one that had exploded. A single roar from it made all the guards and teenagers unconscious. Its presence alone turned the hall dark.
HIIIIIIIIIIIISSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

Beside it was a gigantic serpent, its long body coiling around the entire hall as it raised its head high and released a piercing hissing sound, making the walls and ground crack. Its entire body was covered in darkness, and only two glowing red eyes were visible.

Then appeared a seven-foot-tall shadow holding a magic staff, wearing a robe made of darkness. Just as it appeared, faint chanting could be heard as an extreme amount of mana was exhausted in just a moment. The Hellmancer used several dozens of spells at the same time.

The ground trembled. A large part of the castle instantly broke down, as a gigantic figure much bigger than all rose into the sky. Its body seemed to be made of dark stones. A single roar from the golem reverberated across the capital. Its presence alone created a large crater on the ground.
It looked like an ancient giant without any head and two large arms. A quarter of its feet were embedded in the ground, and the sky seemed to have turned dark as it shadowed over everything.
And at last, a disfigured monster—the same height as the golem—rose. It possessed countless arms, legs, and even heads. It looked terrifying and disgusting. The Chimera had also been summoned.

Its strength was undoubtedly much higher than all the soul wraiths, but unfortunately its intelligence was very low, so it could only follow whatever instructions were given—unlike the Hellmancer, who could react according to the situation on its own.

But the Chimera would go to any lengths as long as it received an order from its master to kill someone. Even Vritra wasn’t sure of total combat powers and all of its ability, it was a broken creature that was created from the corpses of countless creatures, some even very rare.
The five terrifying creatures appeared in front of the king all of a sudden. All the changes were occurring too fast—this was definitely a properly planned ambush.
Arthur’s first reaction was to jump in front of the king and employ whatever defensive measures he could. He wasn’t given any time to go on the offensive.

The man in the black robe maintained the barrier around himself and the king, but he hurriedly sent out all the teenagers. He couldn’t let those possible experiment subjects be destroyed in this fight.

While the king was frozen—with his strength, he could do nothing but rely on others for protection—but he wasn’t worried. With Arthur here, who could hurt him? Only one person in the Dunshire kingdom could even bring a fight to a draw against Arthur. His strength was simply mind-baffling.

Hellmancer was the first to make its move. It used hundreds of spells in a moment and even used several mana potions to avoid disappearing after exhausting all its energy. The demonic mage launched all kinds of spells.

It made any kind of teleportation impossible, then used all kinds of debuffs—speed, strength, thinking ability, reactions, defense, and many more—only towards Arthur and the black-robed man, while giving tons of buffs to all its teammates.

Thousands of chains shot out from under its feet and all headed toward the king. Arthur obviously wouldn’t let them through. He stood in front of Aldric like a wall, drawing out his sword as he released a loud roar and energy burst out of his body.

But the target of the chains had never been Aldric. The chains directly passed through the energy barrier of Arthur and wrapped around his body—not only greatly slowing down his movements but also attaching thousands of debuffs in an instant.
Normally he would have been able to dodge them, but now he couldn’t move because of the king—who was a liability and further decreased Arthur’s combat strength.

He had served under the previous king of the Dunshire kingdom and now protected Aldric with every bit of his strength.
He had followed all the orders of the king, no matter how brutal or morally wrong they were.
He had been the sword and shield of the king.
Arthur could easily be ranked in the top three in the entire kingdom.
It had been a long time since anyone had even seen his face.

Just like always, he stood beside the king and protected him with full concentration— but who would dare to even try to do anything in his presence?

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Gang of Demons
paragraphs: Just as the Hellmancer’s work was done, it had already exhausted all of its energy in placing all those restrictions on Arthur while increasing the strength of its five teammates to the limits.

The Demonic Giant and the golem attacked at the same time, their large fists containing every bit of their strength struck down on Arthur who could only take the attack head on. The golden knight also exerted all his strength as he tightly held his sword in front of his chest.

Releasing a mad roar, he used a large amount of his energy to form several golden shields in front of him. He was the only strongest warrior around to protect the king right now, aside from the man in the black robe, but Arthur would never put his hopes on others.
WHOOOOSH
BOOOOOOOM BAAANNNNNNGGGGGGG
Four giant fists landed on the shields at the same time. They broke apart one by one until all the shields had shattered and Arthur himself had to shield the blows with his body.
CRACK CRACK

Cracks extended along the body of his sword as he took a step back but had successfully stopped the attacks of two giant figures. His arm was numb, but he didn’t seem to have received much injury, just some minor cracks on his armor.

After the man from Nine Pacts had sent all the teenagers away from the battlefield, he decided to intervene and protect the king since they still needed him. He was also surprised by the barrage of attacks; the opponent wasn’t giving them any time at all.

As soon as the enormous black golem had launched its first attack, effectively its body disappeared. In an instant, a thick black barrier appeared around the man in the black robe, completely cutting him off from the outside.

After exhausting some of Arthur’s energy, the only purpose of the demonic golem was to hold back the man in the black robe for just a few seconds. This shield was undoubtedly extremely strong, not only did it protect the man in black, but it would also make it impossible for him to participate in the battle for a few moments.
HIIIISSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS!!!

Then came the turn for the Demonic Wyrm King. It released a shrill cry as it appeared in front of Arthur instantly. The Wyrm King exhausted all its energy in a single attack. Such a large amount of mana was used in less than a second as its body began to disappear.

After accumulating all that energy, the Wyrm King threw out a sphere of burning red liquid. At first it looked like blood, but wherever it passed, the surroundings began to melt and rot. It was an extremely dangerous poison created with all the energy in Wyrm King’s body.

As the large serpent disappeared, its attack had successfully arrived in front of the golden armored knight, who still stood proudly and ready to tackle this attack as well. He collected a vast amount of energy in his hands before channeling it into his sword.

This was his full-power attack. It would easily be able to kill a couple of these strange demons. But before the red sphere could collide or Arthur could launch his attack, the distorted demon—the Chimera—finally made its move.
It let out a loud roar that shook the land, and thousands of people in the capital fainted instantly. The few guards who had managed to survive were blasted into a bloody mess instantly.

This wasn’t a simple roar but a mental attack, and its main target was Arthur. Those guards died just by the aftershocks. It was their bad luck to be present at such a place during such a dangerous fight.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM

This time, even Arthur suffered damage from the sonic attack. He coughed out blood and even more flowed out of his nose and ears. The energy in his body became chaotic, disrupting his strongest attack and making him suffer the backlash instead, as the energy he gathered exploded in his hands.

All ten of his fingers exploded and even his palms were a mess, but the Chimera wasn’t done. Just a fraction of a second before the liquid sphere could fall on the knight, several tentacles shot out of its body at an incredible speed, turning into a blur as they struck the armor and almost shattered it, as cracks extended all over it.
SSSSZZZZZZZZZZZZZTTTTTTTTTT

A sizzling sound reverberated all across the broken hall as the two-meter-wide sphere finally landed on the defenseless Arthur. He wasn’t even able to use the mana in his body to resist because of the constant sonic attack that the Chimera was releasing—it almost made his mind explode.
Very few people could actually resist against mental or soul attacks.
KRAAANNNNGGGGGGG!
THUD THUD
SIZZLE!!
As the viscous liquid fell on his body, the armor that was barely holding on finally broke down and fell to the ground before being dissolved by the corrosive power of the venomous fluid.
Arthur was in an even worse state. His entire body was covered by this toxic fluid. His skin, despite the high defense, gradually began to melt, and his flesh was being affected.
But being a fighter who had survived for several centuries and had been through countless battles, Arthur’s mind still hadn’t crumbled. He planned to fight to his very last breath.

After getting a bit used to the sonic attack, Arthur crazily compressed the mana in his body before letting it explode with a wild ferocity. It affected his body too, but all the liquid that was slowly eroding his body was thrown away in all directions.
Of course, the king was completely protected under the golden and black shields.

Right now, Arthur was in the worst state he had ever been. His mind was working at only twenty percent, while more than seventy percent of his energy had already been exhausted. His physical body was in its worst condition.
The golden knight from the start was never able to exhibit his strength properly nor use any of his treasures to turn the tables.
Because he had to protect the king, he had neglected his own safety, which was why his condition had deteriorated to this state.
All his skin was gone. Even his bones could be seen clearly on several parts of his body, while his blood had been corroded. He looked like a corpse who had been brutally murdered.

Yet it was still not enough to kill a monster like him. A person at such a high level is extremely difficult to kill. Even if more than half of their body had been destroyed, they would still survive and recover gradually. Their vital energy becomes extremely high.

So to kill people at such high levels, they have to be properly dealt with and destroyed in every possible way. Their soul, body, and mind should be thoroughly annihilated. Otherwise, with the right methods or treasures, they would still be able to survive—or be resurrected.
"COME FORWARD, YOU DEMONS!!!"

Arthur roared in a hoarse voice as he threw away his broken sword. He used his remaining energy to activate a secret move—his final trump card that had saved his life several times in the past and had killed the most dangerous and troublesome foes. Even though the cost was quite high.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Devil in the capital
paragraphs: Even though the cost of using the final trump card was extremely high, it couldn’t be costlier than his own life. Arthur’s hate for these demonic figures had risen to the extreme level; he wanted to slaughter them all at any cost.
"BODY AND MIND, ENERGY AND SOUL, SKY AND EARTH, DEFENSE AND—" Arthur chanted something in haste while forming some kind of symbols with his hands—or whatever was left of his hands.
His energy began to rise rapidly, as golden symbols began to swim around him, not only protecting him but also increasing his strength at a very fast pace.

Hellmancer was already doing its best to greatly restrict the golden knight. Otherwise, Arthur wouldn’t have received several attacks, and he didn’t even get to release any attack of his own. This was because of the great mage, whose chains of restriction still remained wrapped around the knight.

The Demonic Golem was holding back the man in the black robe who had already started to launch attacks from inside. He didn’t hold back and launched one attack after another, gradually weakening the Golem’s defense.
The strange person was slightly stronger than Arthur, so it was taking all of Demonic Golem’s energy to hold back such a strong foe.
The wyrm had already lost all of its energy after that attack and had disappeared, but its attack had undoubtedly greatly weakened Arthur’s physical defense, almost turning him into a meat paste.

The demonic giant couldn’t do much at this point. With its strength, it couldn’t deal much damage to the golden knight— even though he had weakened— but now it seemed he had obtained a strong shield and even his body was getting stronger.
Only Chimera was the one who could still deal great damage to Arthur. But aside from releasing that piercing roar, it wasn’t launching any additional attacks.
The Hellmancer— whose body was trembling because of overexertion— even wondered if this mindless, strongest brother of theirs didn’t understand their master’s command properly.

At this moment, it seemed all their hard work and effort in ambushing him would be wasted. Maybe Vritra only planned to scare them a bit but didn’t actually plan to kill them. The Hellmancer wondered but held on with even more determination.

Arthur showed a hideous grin on his broken face. One of his eyeballs had melted, and he looked very disgusting at this moment. He would annihilate all these creatures as soon as his transformation completed. It was only because of Hellmancer and Chimera that his transformation had slowed down.
’What exactly was their motive? Even though they were targeting the king, it didn’t seem the king was their real target. I was the one they planned to take out from the beginning.

But what could be the reason? Is it to remove the king’s shield? Did their attacks fail since even after all that they were unable to kill me? Then what now? Are they just waiting for me to use my biggest trump card? Something is wrong...’

Even now, Arthur’s mind was sufficiently clear. All these thoughts appeared in his mind in less than a moment. Despite knowing that something was amiss, in his current condition, he could do nothing but put all his hopes on his final trump card.
[Fourth Dimension Deactivated]

At this moment, Arthur felt a chill down his body as suddenly a presence appeared exactly beside him out of nowhere. His body trembled, and for the first time in the entire fight, he panicked and felt a long-lost feeling—FEAR!!
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +1}

Arthur saw that it was a person wrapped in a black cloth, and it was impossible to see his identity. He focused all his attention on this person, who seemed the most mysterious out of all the current enemies.

From the start, everything had been too random yet deliberately planned, where one action led to another and each needed to be followed in succession; the strongest warrior of the Dunshire Kingdom, the experienced and proud warrior, had been led by the nose from the very start.
From the Hellmancer to the wyrm and Chimera, all of that had been just the preparation for what was about to come. As this thought popped into Arthur’s mind, he was filled with unease and shock.

After the corpse had exploded, the plan had already started; the moment he began to protect the king, he had already fallen into the trap. The enemy had cleverly made him unable to attack and forced him to defend only.

’H-How terrifying...’ Arthur’s remaining eye was filled with vigilance. But for now, he could only trust that the protective shield of his trump card would protect him until his transformation was complete.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength → Agility]
Strength: 10 Agility: 3255
[Partial Dragon Transformation Activated!!]
Lustrous black scales grew over Vritra’s arms, legs, neck, chest, back, and cheeks. His strength and defense began to rise rapidly; he had never felt this level of power coursing through his body.

His speed had increased to the limit at this moment. He raised his right hand and shot it toward the top of Arthur’s head at full speed using all his might, not holding back even a bit as the sound of air being torn apart rang out.
Even the partial dragon transformation had increased his strength and defense stat by quite a bit. Those black scales looked almost indestructible.
The speed was so fast that in his current state, the golden knight only saw a blurry thing flash in front of him. He had no way of dodging it.

Dust swirled around Vritra’s fist, becoming sharper and sharper. It was so concentrated that just a slight touch would cut most things apart, while at the same time the temperature rose rapidly, making the surroundings extremely hot.
Then a dark purple flame burst out and completely covered his right fist. The air began to distort slightly and was destroyed just by coming in contact with this flame.
Evil-Veyll God Essence!!
Made from two extreme energies: the energy of one of the demon gods and the flames of the 2nd-ranked Mythic Halo, which is known for its destructive power.
So even if the purple flames that Vritra possessed were slightly weak right now, they were still enough to destroy any kind of defense, possessing vast destructive power.

Along with Evil-Veyll God Essence, a colourless flame also covered his right fist, as very faint lines could be seen extending in the space around his fist. Although Nihil-Anima couldn’t harm his physical body, it was the bane of all souls.
Vritra exhausted all the mana in his body in just a moment.

Containing all the destructive energy, Vritra’s fist descended on Arthur’s head. The fearless warrior for the first time experienced what was the fear of death. He had always believed that when death came, he would be able to accept it like a trophy.
But now, he wanted to live so badly. He wanted to do anything to survive, but all he could do was stand there and take the attack head-on.
Just a moment before the lightning-fast fist struck Arthur, its energy increased even further.

Arthur’s hate for these demonic figures had risen to the extreme level; he wanted to slaughter them all at any cost.
"BODY AND MIND, ENERGY AND SOUL, SKY AND EARTH, DEFENSE AND—" Arthur chanted something in haste while forming some kind of symbols with his hands—or whatever was left of his hands.
His energy began to rise rapidly, as golden symbols began to swim around him, not only protecting him but also increasing his strength at a very fast pace.
Hellmancer was already doing its best to greatly restrict the golden knight.
Otherwise, Arthur wouldn’t have received several attacks, and he didn’t even get to release any attack of his own.
This was because of the great mage, whose chains of restriction still remained wrapped around the knight.
The Demonic Golem was holding back the man in the black robe who had already started to launch attacks from inside.
He didn’t hold back and launched one attack after another, gradually weakening the Golem’s defense.
The strange person was slightly stronger than Arthur, so it was taking all of Demonic Golem’s energy to hold back such a strong foe.
The wyrm had already lost all of its energy after that attack and had disappeared, but its attack had undoubtedly greatly weakened Arthur’s physical defense, almost turning him into a meat paste.
The demonic giant couldn’t do much at this point.
With its strength, it couldn’t deal much damage to the golden knight— even though he had weakened— but now it seemed he had obtained a strong shield and even his body was getting stronger.
Only Chimera was the one who could still deal great damage to Arthur.
But aside from releasing that piercing roar, it wasn’t launching any additional attacks.
The Hellmancer— whose body was trembling because of overexertion— even wondered if this mindless, strongest brother of theirs didn’t understand their master’s command properly.
At this moment, it seemed all their hard work and effort in ambushing him would be wasted.
Maybe Vritra only planned to scare them a bit but didn’t actually plan to kill them.
The Hellmancer wondered but held on with even more determination.
Arthur showed a hideous grin on his broken face.
One of his eyeballs had melted, and he looked very disgusting at this moment.
He would annihilate all these creatures as soon as his transformation completed.
It was only because of Hellmancer and Chimera that his transformation had slowed down.
’What exactly was their motive?
Even though they were targeting the king, it didn’t seem the king was their real target.
I was the one they planned to take out from the beginning.
But what could be the reason?
Is it to remove the king’s shield?
Did their attacks fail since even after all that they were unable to kill me?
Then what now?
Are they just waiting for me to use my biggest trump card?
Something is wrong...’
Even now, Arthur’s mind was sufficiently clear.
All these thoughts appeared in his mind in less than a moment.
Despite knowing that something was amiss, in his current condition, he could do nothing but put all his hopes on his final trump card.
[Fourth Dimension Deactivated]
At this moment, Arthur felt a chill down his body as suddenly a presence appeared exactly beside him out of nowhere.
His body trembled, and for the first time in the entire fight, he panicked and felt a long-lost feeling—FEAR!!
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +1}
Arthur saw that it was a person wrapped in a black cloth, and it was impossible to see his identity.
He focused all his attention on this person, who seemed the most mysterious out of all the current enemies.

From the start, everything had been too random yet deliberately planned, where one action led to another and each needed to be followed in succession; the strongest warrior of the Dunshire Kingdom, the experienced and proud warrior, had been led by the nose from the very start.
From the Hellmancer to the wyrm and Chimera, all of that had been just the preparation for what was about to come.
As this thought popped into Arthur’s mind, he was filled with unease and shock.
After the corpse had exploded, the plan had already started; the moment he began to protect the king, he had already fallen into the trap.
The enemy had cleverly made him unable to attack and forced him to defend only.
’H-How terrifying...’ Arthur’s remaining eye was filled with vigilance.
But for now, he could only trust that the protective shield of his trump card would protect him until his transformation was complete.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength → Agility]
Strength: 10 Agility: 3255
[Partial Dragon Transformation Activated!!]
Lustrous black scales grew over Vritra’s arms, legs, neck, chest, back, and cheeks.
His strength and defense began to rise rapidly; he had never felt this level of power coursing through his body.
His speed had increased to the limit at this moment.
He raised his right hand and shot it toward the top of Arthur’s head at full speed using all his might, not holding back even a bit as the sound of air being torn apart rang out.
Even the partial dragon transformation had increased his strength and defense stat by quite a bit.
Those black scales looked almost indestructible.
The speed was so fast that in his current state, the golden knight only saw a blurry thing flash in front of him.
He had no way of dodging it.
Dust swirled around Vritra’s fist, becoming sharper and sharper.
It was so concentrated that just a slight touch would cut most things apart, while at the same time the temperature rose rapidly, making the surroundings extremely hot.
Then a dark purple flame burst out and completely covered his right fist.
The air began to distort slightly and was destroyed just by coming in contact with this flame.
Evil-Veyll God Essence!!
Made from two extreme energies: the energy of one of the demon gods and the flames of the 2nd-ranked Mythic Halo, which is known for its destructive power.
So even if the purple flames that Vritra possessed were slightly weak right now, they were still enough to destroy any kind of defense, possessing vast destructive power.
Along with Evil-Veyll God Essence, a colourless flame also covered his right fist, as very faint lines could be seen extending in the space around his fist.
Although Nihil-Anima couldn’t harm his physical body, it was the bane of all souls.
Vritra exhausted all the mana in his body in just a moment.
Containing all the destructive energy, Vritra’s fist descended on Arthur’s head.
The fearless warrior for the first time experienced what was the fear of death.
He had always believed that when death came, he would be able to accept it like a trophy.
But now, he wanted to live so badly.
He wanted to do anything to survive, but all he could do was stand there and take the attack head-on.
Just a moment before the lightning-fast fist struck Arthur, its energy increased even further.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Master
paragraphs: Just a moment before the lightning-fast fist struck Arthur, its energy increased even more.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility → Strength]
• Agility: 10
• Strength: 3555
And finally, the strike landed as everything was instantly engulfed by silence, before everything fell apart.
Arthur, who was surrounded by golden letters that provided him with the most powerful shield, was still hopeful of surviving that strike.
He could tell that the other party had exhausted all his strength in this single blow, so if he could somehow survive, then he would certainly be able to kill this mysterious and dangerous person.

But as that fist containing several kinds of powers and glowing with a dark purple light came close to him, those golden letters disappeared as if they were mere illusions, not putting up even the slightest bit of defense against that flame.

Arthur felt a chill. He knew that it was now impossible for him to survive, plus the speed of that fist was so fast that he couldn’t even think of anything, let alone do something. All he could wonder was—who was this guy, and why did he want to kill him? What was that purple flame that was so destructive?

Finally, the strike landed, and Arthur’s body’s defenses held on for a moment before being completely swallowed by the cataclysmic mix of energies. All of him was erased before the explosion expanded all over the place.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Chaos spread all across the place. Everything around was completely shattered.
Almost the entire castle was blown into pieces—even the land around had been destroyed. Not even the temple was left unscathed; it barely managed to survive.

The sound of the explosion rang out across the entire capital, throwing the people into a state of panic, and a large mushroom-like cloud rose into the sky. Dozens upon dozens of houses around the castle had been destroyed.
The scale of destruction was too huge. The capital hadn’t suffered such a devastating blow in several centuries. Even most of the demons wouldn’t attack the capital openly.

The destructive storm lasted for almost a minute before it began to die down. All the people who had witnessed this historic moment were shocked. They wondered which terrifying demon had entered to have caused this much mayhem.
To be honest, even Vritra hadn’t expected his full power punch to cause so much chaos and destruction.
He was completely exhausted after delivering that punch, and all his skills were deactivated, and even his partial dragon transformation was undone.
Just before Vritra was about to be swallowed by the energy, his body disappeared, and he was safely teleported back to the same room beside Diana, who was protecting that room with all her might.

He fell on the chair, his body drenched in sweat as he panted heavily. He was barely keeping his eyes open. But with his recovery skills and the passive effect of Shift, his condition became much better within seconds.

The man in the black robe finally managed to destroy the Demonic Golem’s body as he came out and witnessed the shocking scene. Arthur was dead, and all of it had happened in less than ten seconds— no, in just five or six seconds.
He wasn’t in the mood to test his power against this destructive energy as he grabbed the king and disappeared from there, locking onto the locations of the remaining demons.
Soon, Hellmancer and the Demonic Giant disappeared too, and only Chimera remained, who moved back hastily from the attack— and still, it received a few injuries but was mostly fine.

Finally, the chaos ended, and peace filled the area. The man in the black robe put the king to safety first, then looked at his target: the Chimera, who had spread its wings already and had started to flee at extreme speed.
Of course, it was nothing more than a diversion, just to make the enemies confused by giving them false knowledge and tracking a false target.
The king had fainted. Several of the strongest men from his army arrived and protected the king. They were shocked to see the greatest knight of their kingdom, Sir Arthur, had been slain.

"Q-Quick, form a protective barrier around the king! We can’t let any harm near him. Call all the warriors, this is of utmost importance, this is a catastrophe-level attack," one of the warriors commanded.

"Several of our warriors have fallen... a-and even honourable Sir Arthur has sacrificed himself while performing his duty..." another man added. All of them were even more shocked by the news of Arthur’s death than the attack itself. He was the most feared and respected man in the kingdom, after all.
Most of the strong demons stayed out of their kingdom just because of his presence, and now he had fallen? Who could be powerful enough to slay him—was it a Demon Lord?

They were all filled with countless doubts, but right now was not the time for any of that. Fortunately, the enemy made no further attempt at the king’s life, so all the warriors began to work efficiently and with proper planning.

The man in the black robe chased after the Chimera for a very long distance, but after reaching the boundary of the kingdom, the strange creature disappeared all of a sudden without leaving behind any trace.

"How strange. It certainly wasn’t any normal demon. I have never seen such dark demons—all of them seemed to be made of the same kind of energy. Is some other organization performing similar experiments on demons? But what could their purpose be in killing that knight?

Is it somehow related to that boy who took out the corpse? Hmmm... I don’t think so. He was too weak and clueless. I believe he must have been used as a chess piece by someone without even knowing it.

I have to find out all about the organization behind this attack... at least the king and those test subjects are safe, and that’s all that matters." The man spoke in a thick voice—it was impossible to know his identity from the voice alone.
In the next instant, he disappeared from there after sensing that Chimera was nowhere around.
"Are you alright?" Yasmine asked, her voice was filled with worry, excitement, and pride.

’Yeah, just a little exhausted. That purple flame took away all my energy—even my stamina was depleted. Even though it is still weak, I didn’t expect it to possess such destructive energy,’ Vritra spoke as he wiped away the sweat from his forehead.
"Well that’s not a surprise..." she replied.

But the one who was the most shocked in all this was none other than the goddess. Others might not recognize those creatures, but how could Diana not tell what they were? After all, she had seen Vritra’s Soul Wraiths.
She had done her best to protect the room from all that destruction. Her body shivered as Vritra appeared behind her out of nowhere after delivering that devastating punch.

"M- Master, you are back?" she asked in a meek tone, her heart now filled with fear. He had grown to this extent in a mere two months— who knows how terrifying he would become in the future? There was no shame in becoming a maid for such a figure, even as a goddess.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Knight of Darkness
paragraphs: "M- Master, you are back?" Diana asked in a meek tone.
"Oh?!" Vritra was taken aback, but he didn’t focus on Diana for now. After a nod, he looked at a certain part of his status window.
{Sin Points: 19,489}
Vritra couldn’t get Sin Points if someone was talking about him and he wasn’t around.
But as long as that person was not too far away from him and was within his sensing range, he would be able to get the points.
Just now, he had terrorized a lot of people. Although most were far away from him, he still got quite a bit of points—yet they were still nowhere near enough to spin the Gacha Wheel.
With a probability of less than 2%, he would need a lot of keys to pull out something good.
Vritra had made the plan to kill Arthur only after arriving there and observing them for a while. Even if he had failed to kill that knight, he would have still managed to succeed in his goal.
Now that they are chasing a new enemy, Vritra would have quite a bit of free time. It won’t be anytime soon that the Nine Pact or the King makes a move against him.
He also wanted to see his combat power if he didn’t hold back and the result was more than satisfying, especially the purple flame.
But after using that one attack, the core in his chest was completely empty. It would need at least a few days to refill on its own.
With this attack, not only had he diverted the attention but also reduced the King’s strength by a great level.
But none of this was his biggest gain. Vritra’s lips curled into a big devilish smile that made the goddess shiver.
He focused his gaze on the ethereal letters in front of him, a particular part of the status window.
[SOUL WRAITH INVENTORY]:
• Name: Knight of Darkness
Level: 849
Now he possessed another Soul Wraith with terrifying strength— even slightly stronger than the Chimera— with high intelligence.
If Arthur wasn’t caught up in that plan and didn’t need to protect the King, then there was no way he would have died so easily.
’Indeed a nice addition. Turning that guy into Soul Wraith exhausted so much of my energy, but it was so worth it.’
For a moment, Vritra wondered if he should remove the demonic giant, since aside from its physical strength, it wasn’t much helpful.
But in the end, he decided to keep it for now; its level was still quite high.
’And everything is taken care of. Now I can slowly move inside the kingdom and deal with a few things before leaving. I will avoid the Nine Pacts for now.’
Vritra made up his mind as he stood up. His pale face had already returned to normal and even half of his mana had been regenerated.
"Diana, take care of the mess. Just make something up if anyone asks about me." Vritra spoke, patting her head with a kind, angelic smile that made the goddess cower in fear.
"A- And where are you going? Others might still get suspicious of you, even if they don’t think that you could cause all this trouble.
But they might pick you up for interrogation, and if you are taken by the Nine Pact, then even with your strength, it would be impossible to escape.
So you should stay in the temple, then they won’t cross the line." Diana said with a confident expression. After all, even those people are afraid of the true gods.
Vritra remained silent for a few moments, then he nodded:
"Since all the rooms in the castle had already been destroyed, make everyone shift into the temple. That place should still be useful. But for now, I need to go and practice my acting skills."
Then he walked away, leaving the goddess behind, feeling nervous and awed. Then she shook her head, shocked by the fact that she actually felt worried about that great demon emperor.
Vritra walked past the rubble of the castle as he made his way towards the survivors— all the people from his class. After all, they had been saved by that black-robed man.
After looking around, his gaze landed on the redhead who was still lying unconscious, though none of them seemed to have suffered any injuries.
Fiona had been extremely shocked when the corpse of the demon giant had suddenly exploded.
She really thought that she was going to die at that moment, but somehow she was able to survive. It seemed someone had protected all of them.
But then those large dark demonic figures appeared, and the moment they released a roar, she fell unconscious. At some point, all of them had been shifted away from the battlefield.
"...ake up, Fio...!!"
She heard the faint sound of someone calling out to her. The eyes of the redhead fluttered as she felt someone holding her tightly and protectively, filling her with a comforting warmth.
’Is it Max? Yeah, he should be the one calling me and protecting me. I knew it—bad boys would do anything for the girl they like. But it is the first time he is embracing me...’
Fiona felt happy as she slowly became aware of her surroundings.
"Are you okay, Fiona?" the same person called out to her again, touching her cheek gently. Finally, she woke up.
Her eyes fluttered and opened slightly, but because of the bright sunlight, she couldn’t clearly see the face of the person who seemed so worried about her and kept calling her name so passionately.
’His face is so close to mine...’ Fiona faintly saw the outline of his face. Max had never before looked so handsome. As she lay in his arms, all her worry and fear melted away.
She smiled lovingly and spoke in a weak tone while placing her palm gently over his hand that was still caressing her cheek: "I am fine..."
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +1}
"What are you doing?!!" An angry and familiar voice suddenly reverberated and Fiona was shaken out of her daze. She wondered why that voice was so familiar.

As her sight became clearer, she was shocked to see that indeed Max could never look so handsome. The person holding her wasn’t Max at all, but it was a devilishly charming face that held a gentle and caring smile.
{Sin Point Gained: Flustered +1}
"V- Vritra?!!" Fiona was shocked and frozen. She believed it was Max— that was why she smiled like that and even touched his hand, giving him permission and even encouraging him to touch her cheek.
She glanced to the other side from the corner of her eyes and saw Max standing there with an enraged look on his face.
He looked so mad. When thinking about the current situation, it was indeed easy to misunderstand the current situation.
She hastily moved her hand away, a look of horror on her face as she hastily tried to explain.
"M- Max, this is a misunderstanding. I thought it was—" Fiona tried to explain, but Max was completely locked onto Vritra who sat there with Fiona in his arms without any clue.
She finally noticed that she was still in his arms, so she pushed him away. Both her palms hit Vritra’s chest, pushing him backward and Fiona was finally away from him.

Vritra let go of her boob as he pulled back and got off the bed. Then he touched his lips and tilted his head to the side before muttering in a pitiful tone:
"You are a monster, pulling the weak me forcefully into the room and kissing like that. Haa, what would everyone think if they ever came to know of this."
{Sin Point Gained: Flustered +1}

"..." Fiona was dazed for a moment. Then she felt angry as she got over her shock. Even though she had pulled him into the room and had kissed him for some reason while thinking he was Max, he had still stolen her first kiss.

She couldn’t believe she had kissed a boy other than Max in such an obscene and hungry way. She could still perfectly taste him inside her mouth and on her lips. This thought only filled her with more shame and embarrassment, as guilt for Max rose in her heart.
"I-It’s all your fault. Did you feed me something? I would never behave like that. My body was extremely hot earlier. That was not normal," Fiona spoke, her face burning with shame and guilt.
’This was just a mistake. I was in a strange state and I thought it was Max, so I hadn’t betrayed him... right?’ she tried to ease her heart.

"Hah! So now it is my fault. Fine, I am going out. Then I will ask Max and let’s find out who was the one at fault." After speaking, he didn’t even look back and walked towards the door. Fiona panicked as she got off the bed hastily and ran towards him.
She held his hand and pulled him back. She could never allow Max to know about this. Wouldn’t their unbaked relationship, that hadn’t even started properly yet, already be over otherwise?
"Fiona, are you inside? Open the door," Max called out again. Despite the ambush and receiving such injury, he still wanted to go ahead with his proposal.
’He woke up faster than I expected,’ Vritra thought. But he soon understood that it must be because of his skill, which slightly increased the speed of his body’s recovery.
"I am fine, but can we t-talk tomorrow? I am not feeling well today," Fiona lied with a guilty and self-blaming look on her pretty face.
"Are you really fine? Just let me see you once." Max insisted. He felt that something was wrong but he couldn’t understand exactly what.
"I am really fine. I can’t see you right now. Please just leave for now." Fiona replied, feeling even worse. By lying, she had unwillingly become an accomplice in this act of betrayal and cheating.

{Sin Point Gained: Hated +1}

"Okay, as you wish." Vritra nodded and opened the door. Then, after wishing her goodnight, he walked out and shut the door behind him.

Finally, as soon as he left, Fiona sat down on the ground, her face turning bright red. She gulped her saliva and could still almost feel his lips and tongue. She lightly touched her neck, touching the area where he had left such a deep mark.

"He is indeed a bad person... I have to forget all about it and Max should never know any of it. Ughh... Why was he so sweet though?" Fiona mumbled, unconsciously licking her lips before freezing upon realisation.
Vritra walked back to his room. He could see a trail of blood on the floor, which was left behind by Max.
"KNIGHT!" After arriving in front of his room, Vritra called out in a low voice. Instantly, a shadow moved away from under his feet and appeared in front of him. The Dark Knight remained hidden.

"Go and observe the situation. Don’t reveal yourself but find what the king and those from the Nine Pacts are doing," he ordered. Vritra knew sooner or later he would be exposed, but he should delay that for now.
"I understand, master." The knight bowed and answered before he disappeared. He could still speak human language, so it was the easiest to command around.
After the Dark Knight left, Vritra opened the door and walked inside. His mother was sitting on the bed and reading a book. As he entered, she put the book aside and looked up at him.
"Is there any problem?" she asked worriedly.

"No, everything is fine for now. I just needed to finish a small task. In a few days’ time, we will be leaving this kingdom, but you will have to go separately from me with Diana." Vritra spoke; he closed the door and climbed onto the bed.

"...Okay, but will you be fine?" Vanessa rested her head over his shoulder and asked. Even though there wasn’t a very long time before she had to get a master, she wasn’t rushing Vritra. Both of them needed time to build that kind of relation.
"Of course I will be fine. Didn’t you see how strong I am?" Vritra smiled as he turned the lights off and lay down, his mother using his arm as a pillow.
They talked for a while about different things and then fell asleep in the comfortable and warm embrace of each other.

Early in the morning, Vritra woke up from the sound of a knock on his door. He gently moved out of his mother’s arms and sat up. After stretching his arms and rubbing his eyes, he stood up and walked up to the door.

A sweet and flowery scent drifted inside even before he had opened the door. Vritra already knew who it was, and as he opened the door, the ethereal and graceful figure of the goddess came into his view.
