chapters.title: Chapter 67: Planning
paragraphs: Diana looked just as beautiful and pure as ever, wearing a graceful white dress and having an air of respect and reverence around her. Her expression was serene and her skin looked like milk.

Vritra rubbed his eye and gestured for her to enter, then he pulled a chair for her and went to wash his face. After coming out of the bathroom, he took a seat in front of her and asked, "So what is it?"
Diana faintly glanced into the room—it was perfectly clean and well-organized. On the bed, Vanessa was still asleep. She didn’t think too much about it and focused her gaze on Vritra.
"I heard a news and I thought you would be interested in it so I came here to tell you," Diana spoke, her voice still containing that high and authoritative tone, but she seemed much more tamed.

"You came yourself? You could have sent someone from those followers of yours to deliver this news. Do you have something to ask?" Vritra asked, though he already had an idea what she was about to ask.
"Umm... Was that really you yesterday? D- Did you really kill Arthur?" Diana asked in a cautious tone, but being his maid she wasn’t much worried that he would kill her too.
"Yes, things turned out that way." Vritra answered and thought:

’Now that I think about it, that was the first time I killed a human, but I didn’t feel any kind of sadness or remorse. Is it because I have been killing so many demons that I got numb to that feeling?’
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +1}

"Ah... I see, so you really got so strong in just a month after our fight. J- Just how did you do it? Arthur was incredibly strong, even if he was caught up in your plan it wouldn’t be easy to kill him." Diana asked. She tried to see his level and could only see 90, which was obviously fake.

Vritra had increased his level the previous day using the Fake Status skill. Otherwise, how could a level one beat Raino in a moment? He needed a bit more time to prepare, so he was still being a little careful, but he also wasn’t lying completely low.
"So what kind of news did you want to deliver?" Vritra questioned, instead of answering her.

"..." Diana remained silent for a moment. After meeting Vritra, her normal life, which was going on without many big events, had suddenly been turned upside down. She wasn’t sure anymore what future held in store for her.

Sighing, she decided to forget the earlier topic for now as she spoke, "You asked me about any big event happening in the capital, right? Because of the fight yesterday, a few guards had died and the exam for guard selection that was supposed to happen a week or so from now has been rescheduled to today. The number of entries and the size of the platform have increased too, so there will be an even bigger crowd." Diana spoke. She wondered why he wanted to know about crowded places.
"..." Vritra pondered for a moment, then his lips rose slightly as his gaze landed on the gorgeous goddess.
"Will the number of people watching and participating increase if the goddess herself were to go there to watch and encourage those people?" he asked.
"Of course, the number will increase by several times. Most people would just come because of me," Diana spoke pridefully before understanding his words.
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +1}
"You want me to go there?" she asked, surprised.
"Yes, is there a problem?" Vritra asked nonchalantly.

"T- There is no problem, but it is such a minor event. It wouldn’t look good for someone like me to go there personally... is it really necessary?" the goddess asked. After all, she has to maintain her reputation.
"Hmm. If you go, then I won’t give you any orders for a day." Vritra said after a moment.
"Three days!!" she bargained.
"Two days," Vritra said firmly.
"Deal. I will announce the news of my arrival there first, and I will be there right on time." Diana added, as she made the deal and stood up. She wasn’t losing anything in this deal.
"Alright." He watched as Diana left the room in a good mood, then he glanced at his sin points that were still stuck near only 20,000.

’Don’t worry, I will collect as many sin points as possible today. If I could get one more of such skills then my strength will increase again greatly.’ Vritra mumbled as he patted Zengis’s head and then went to take a bath.
Vritra ate breakfast with his mother, then he told her about the event while eating.
"Can I go there too?" Vanessa asked. She didn’t know what he was planning this time—what if he is planning to blow the entire venue?
"Sure, go along with Diana." Vritra nodded. If no one interferes in that competition, then it shouldn’t be too dangerous.
"Okay. You are going to participate too?" Vanessa asked with a smile, feeling happy. Recently, she hadn’t been able to leave the castle or the temple.
"Yes, I will certainly be participating though not normally—and you will know it is me when I am being introduced." Vritra said with a mischievous smile. This event was going to be quite special.

After eating breakfast, Vritra and Vanessa left the room. Vanessa went to meet Diana while Vritra left the temple. He needed to prepare a little for the competition. His entrée needed to be spectaculous to the point that he would be showering in sin points.
The more outrageous things he did, the more reactions he would receive from the public. But before leaving, he had one task to complete.

He went to knock on the doors not too far away from his own, then he pulled the two boys into one room and made them sit on the bed while he stood in front of them, releasing a faint aura of his, making them cower.
"W- What do you want?" Tyler asked, his chubby face looking pale.

"We d- didn’t mock you or anything before," Jace spoke. His body seemed to have become even thinner. They were also in Max’s team in the labyrinth, so both of them were afraid that Vritra would blame them and take revenge.

"Don’t be so afraid, I need you to do a couple of simple tasks for me. If you complete them, then both of you would be fine. But if you don’t, then... remember the last two times when you almost died? The third will be your last." Vritra said, his friendly smile looking haunting.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +2}

’So it was him?!! He definitely knows that it was our team that tried to kill him.’ Jace and Tyler were both shocked as they looked at each other in shock and fear, before becoming even paler and their bodies shrunk back.
"W- What do we have to do?" Jace asked, his voice shaking and his entire body shivering.
"Not much, you just have to..." Vritra explained their part in his plan—the plan to deal massive blows to Max, to torture his soul and completely shatter his heart, before his body is tortured.

Vritra had increased his level the previous day using the Fake Status skill.
Otherwise, how could a level one beat Raino in a moment?
He needed a bit more time to prepare, so he was still being a little careful, but he also wasn’t lying completely low.
"So what kind of news did you want to deliver?" Vritra questioned, instead of answering her.
"..." Diana remained silent for a moment.
After meeting Vritra, her normal life, which was going on without many big events, had suddenly been turned upside down.
She wasn’t sure anymore what future held in store for her.
Sighing, she decided to forget the earlier topic for now as she spoke, "You asked me about any big event happening in the capital, right?
Because of the fight yesterday, a few guards had died and the exam for guard selection that was supposed to happen a week or so from now has been rescheduled to today.
The number of entries and the size of the platform have increased too, so there will be an even bigger crowd." Diana spoke.
She wondered why he wanted to know about crowded places.
"..." Vritra pondered for a moment, then his lips rose slightly as his gaze landed on the gorgeous goddess.
"Will the number of people watching and participating increase if the goddess herself were to go there to watch and encourage those people?" he asked.
"Of course, the number will increase by several times.
Most people would just come because of me," Diana spoke pridefully before understanding his words.
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +1}
"You want me to go there?" she asked, surprised.
"Yes, is there a problem?" Vritra asked nonchalantly.
"T- There is no problem, but it is such a minor event.
It wouldn’t look good for someone like me to go there personally... is it really necessary?" the goddess asked.
After all, she has to maintain her reputation.
"Hmm.
If you go, then I won’t give you any orders for a day." Vritra said after a moment.
"Three days!!" she bargained.
"Two days," Vritra said firmly.
"Deal.
I will announce the news of my arrival there first, and I will be there right on time." Diana added, as she made the deal and stood up.
She wasn’t losing anything in this deal.
"Alright." He watched as Diana left the room in a good mood, then he glanced at his sin points that were still stuck near only 20,000.
’Don’t worry, I will collect as many sin points as possible today.
If I could get one more of such skills then my strength will increase again greatly.’ Vritra mumbled as he patted Zengis’s head and then went to take a bath.
Vritra ate breakfast with his mother, then he told her about the event while eating.
"Can I go there too?" Vanessa asked.
She didn’t know what he was planning this time—what if he is planning to blow the entire venue?
"Sure, go along with Diana." Vritra nodded.
If no one interferes in that competition, then it shouldn’t be too dangerous.
"Okay.
You are going to participate too?" Vanessa asked with a smile, feeling happy.
Recently, she hadn’t been able to leave the castle or the temple.
"Yes, I will certainly be participating though not normally—and you will know it is me when I am being introduced." Vritra said with a mischievous smile.
This event was going to be quite special.
After eating breakfast, Vritra and Vanessa left the room.
Vanessa went to meet Diana while Vritra left the temple.
He needed to prepare a little for the competition.
His entrée needed to be spectaculous to the point that he would be showering in sin points.
The more outrageous things he did, the more reactions he would receive from the public.
But before leaving, he had one task to complete.

He went to knock on the doors not too far away from his own, then he pulled the two boys into one room and made them sit on the bed while he stood in front of them, releasing a faint aura of his, making them cower.
"W- What do you want?" Tyler asked, his chubby face looking pale.
"We d- didn’t mock you or anything before," Jace spoke.
His body seemed to have become even thinner.
They were also in Max’s team in the labyrinth, so both of them were afraid that Vritra would blame them and take revenge.
"Don’t be so afraid, I need you to do a couple of simple tasks for me.
If you complete them, then both of you would be fine.
But if you don’t, then... remember the last two times when you almost died?
The third will be your last." Vritra said, his friendly smile looking haunting.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +2}
’So it was him?!!

He definitely knows that it was our team that tried to kill him.’ Jace and Tyler were both shocked as they looked at each other in shock and fear, before becoming even paler and their bodies shrunk back.
"W- What do we have to do?" Jace asked, his voice shaking and his entire body shivering.
"Not much, you just have to..." Vritra explained their part in his plan—the plan to deal massive blows to Max, to torture his soul and completely shatter his heart, before his body is tortured.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Superhero
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Shocked +2}
"W- What?!! How can we d- do that? That’s just too..." Both the teenagers were shocked and disgusted by what they had just heard. They not only had to lie to Max, but the worse part came after that.

"Well, you are free to reject, but the price of rejection is your life," Vritra spoke, the air around him becoming suffocating. Then he added, "Of course, you can also decide to get help from others or tell Max about my plan."
THUD
BANG
A loud sound reverberated and shook the floor slightly. Vritra took out one of his axes and simply put it down. Just by its weight, cracks formed on the floor.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +2}
"W- We will do it; we will do whatever you say." Both boys almost ended up peeing in their pants, their bodies turning cold as they agreed instantly.

"Alright, put the plan to work starting from today. The moment you try anything strange, you will lose your lives." Vritra raised the heavy axe casually and made a gesture with it to cut their necks, then he disappeared.
The room fell into silence. The two looked around in fear, and after a few minutes had passed, Jace finally spoke, "D- Did he really leave? How did he just disappear?"
Tyler added in a trembling voice, "I- I don’t know how, but I think he left. Do we really have to do all that?"
Jace: "... Yes, he is too scary. I think I peed in my pants."
Tyler: "... Me too."

After leaving the temple, Vritra bought a unique set of clothes that was quite eye-catching, and after wearing them, he arrived at the arena where the recruitment would take place. Finding the place wasn’t difficult at all.

The news of Diana’s appearance in that competition had already spread in just a couple of hours. A lot of people were hurrying to go there. As Vritra watched such a crowd heading towards the arena from the sky, he felt quite excited.
"Do my current appearance look weird?" Vritra asked. He was wearing a red dress along with a cape, with a mask that perfectly hid his face and a red wig — a typical cliché superhero costume.
Four words were written on his chest and two on his cape, saying:
-LAST NIGHT, I FUCKED-
-YOUR MOTHER-

"Yes, you look extremely weird. Why are you using a mask? Won’t your looks get you even more sin points?" Yasmine chuckled at his comical appearance. He looked too funny, and others would be easily offended just by looking at him.

"Uh... to be honest, it is quite embarrassing, especially everything I will be doing there. Sigh... getting sin points isn’t an easy task. Thankfully, the rewards are very much comforting," Vritra said, shaking his head. He calmed himself while thinking about Shift, Four Dimension, and the two treasure maps — he could obtain something even better next time.
"Hehe, you will certainly attract everyone’s attention. Let me know if you need my help," Yasmine spoke. She was looking forward to this good show.
Vritra nodded and flew towards the arena. The place was quite big, enough to accommodate more than ten thousand people. He went directly to register.
Several people were doing the work of registration, so despite the large crowd planning to participate and who hadn’t registered yet, the queues weren’t long.
[Fourth Dimension Deactivated.]
Vritra’s figure became visible. He joined one of the queues and waited patiently. He had already started to attract quite a few gazes.
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +48}
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +57}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +71}

Vritra ignored all the gazes; he would only start his act after the fight started. Soon, it was his turn. The person responsible for registration passed him a form and asked him to fill it without even raising his gaze.

"Haha, I think all the people in here already hate you. This dress of yours is wonderful; it is simply a point-grabbing machine." Yasmine was already laughing so hard. Staying with Vritra was like experiencing a completely packed film.
There was action, adventure, comedy, love, taboo love, ecchi things, despair, and much more. She would never be bored while with him.
Vritra looked at the form while receiving a few dozen sin points every few seconds just by standing there. The form was pretty simple — he had to write his name, level, and address.
"What among these things will be announced on the stage?" Vritra asked.
"Your name and level," the man with dark circles under his eyes said, his voice full of irritation.
"What is the normal level of warriors participating?" Vritra asked.
"Tch, it’s the guards for the castle. The minimum level is 100." The man sounded really annoyed, but he still answered while writing something in the register.
"Hmm, is there a word limit for the name? Will the full name be announced before the fight?" Vritra asked, irritating even the people who were queuing behind him.
"You!! There is no word limit and yes, the whole name will be announced—" He finally became enraged, and while answering, he looked up and was shocked by Vritra’s appearance.
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +39}
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +1}
"Alright, thank you. Give me a minute." Vritra didn’t mind the angry man. As long as he was receiving these points, he quickly began to fill the form.

The registrar took several deep breaths to calm himself down. There were always a few crazy people like that. He had already been working for several hours by now, and getting angry would only make him sick.
There was no checking of the level, since if it was higher than what was written, it would be better for the castle. But if the real level was lower, then they would get beat up in the competition.
After filling the form, Vritra passed it back to the man busy doing yoga, before saying, "Make sure he calls my full name."
Then he walked away, leaving behind a small crowd of people fuming in anger.
The registrar looked down at the form, wondering what that alien meant, and after seeing the name, his face turned black and blue in rage.
"Stop, dammit, are you messing with me!! Huh, what is written on that cape? Your mother?" After reading that, the registrar went so mad that he struck his head on the table and fainted.
Vritra observed the arena from the warrior lobby. In the lobby alone, there were several hundred people, and as he glanced at the seats...
"T- There should be nearly..." Vritra roughly counted the large crowd in astonishment and was sure there were around eleven or twelve thousand people gathered there.

"Damn, just jumping in the centre of the arena will give me tens of thousands of points. Hehe, we will be rolling that Gacha again today." Vritra’s smile widened under the mask, and he was no longer bothered by his strange clothes.

It wasn’t long before the goddess also arrived in the arena and took her seat on the high platform. There was another woman who looked just as gorgeous with her. The crowd went mad with chatter and shouts as they saw the two women.

They began to bow and pray. The number of people reached more than thirteen thousand. This was going to be such a huge event that most of the people in the capital from around there had arrived in the arena.
"Shall we start?"

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Daddy
paragraphs: "Divine Goddess, please bless us with a happy family and a long life." A man sitting on his knees joined his hands and prayed.
"Oh Holy Mother, I would really appreciate it if you give me lots of money, a young beautiful wife, and while you are at it, add a big house, an easy job, a long life, a— and increase my height too."

All the people were bowing or kneeling as they prayed to the goddess. She was a holy figure, and just catching a sight of her was considered a great fortune. Even if she looked very beautiful and hot, no one would have improper thoughts about such a pure being.
Diana smiled as she sat down on a throne-like seat. Beside her, Vanessa also sat on a similar seat, looking around the arena to find her son.
"Where is Vritra?" Diana asked as she gazed at her follower. She carried an air of grace.
"I don’t know, he should be here soon," Vanessa replied. Her tone was neither respectful nor disrespectful, just like talking to an equal— as if she wasn’t speaking to a literal goddess.
’This pair of mother and son... sigh, forget it.’ Diana ignored the hot MILF and continued to look at all the people, occasionally smiling.

Vritra stood calmly in the lobby where the number of participants continued to increase. Only around fifty people would be selected, but he could see that almost a thousand people had gathered for the fight.

To get as many Sin Points as he could, Vritra would have to stand out in the large crowd by whatever means. Just by standing in the lobby, he was getting quite a few points from the people around him who kept sending death glares at him.
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +42}
{Sin Point Gained: Taunted +33}
{Sin Point Gained: Provoked +59}

All the participants had already entered the waiting lobby and the time to register had ended. The door to the lobby’s entrance had closed. Then several people entered the lobby carrying registers in their hands along with big boxes full of badges.
They moved from person to person in the large lobby that was spacious enough to hold more than a thousand warriors. Vritra stood to one side, and soon a person approached him.
"Tell me your name," the man spoke without much emotion in his voice.

Vritra took the register and soon found his name. After the man put a number in front of it, Vritra was given a badge with number 669. The person registering then moved away without even seeing Vritra’s name.

The whole process didn’t take long. Within twenty minutes, all the warriors had received their badges as they excitedly waited to give their best performance on the stage. Even the goddess would be watching over them.

Just as the badge distributing process was about to end, Vritra sensed that the Dark Knight had returned. He moved to one of the corners and stood there casually as a shadow flew discreetly and disappeared under his feet.
’So is there anything out of the ordinary?’ Vritra asked while looking outside the lobby and toward the arena where the main event was about to start.
"No, Master. The Nine Pact and the Royal Army are all busy trying to find the tracks of those monsters.
My death had too big of an impact on this kingdom; the king won’t let this go so easily. As for the Nine Pact, it seems their reason for looking for you is completely different.
Though I sensed that you are still being held in doubt by several people," the knight gave his report.
’I see, that’s good enough for now. Hellmancer and Golem, go protect my mother for now.’ As he commanded, two shadows flew out— though no one noticed them.

There was a large stage at the center of the arena where more than a thousand people would be fighting. They could form groups and use any weapons. There were still some rules, and killing was prohibited.
Out of a thousand, only fifty would be selected in the end.

Around the fighting area, the seats were completely crowded with people— there were over fourteen thousand people. The whole place was already filled with excitement and cheering, as if they had already forgotten about the disaster that happened the previous day.
DING
"Welcome, Goddess and Miss." A middle-aged man wearing a colorful dress and with spiked hair suddenly jumped onto the fighting stage, holding something that resembled a mic.
His voice reverberated all over the place as he bowed respectfully toward Diana and Vanessa before addressing the crowd.

"Hello my friends, this is Uranus, the famous host who will be hosting this special event. It is much more than just the recruitment of guards. The fights will, as usual, be very brutal, so those with weak hearts— make sure to keep all your openings closed."
Uranus shouted, building up the excitement. He didn’t waste much time as he next announced: "Let’s call all of our one thousand eighty-four warriors onto the stage to fight.
The rules will remain the same as usual— the last fifty standing will be selected as the Royal Guards. So let’s welcome our strong warriors!"
The crowd roared and clapped.
The warriors in the lobby felt their excitement increase. All of them rushed out to the fighting stage, spreading over the large area.
The fighters made sure to stand in a way that they wouldn’t end up ambushed right at the start. Many were even joining groups.
Within seconds, the stage became crowded. Uranus took his position on a platform close to the stage while looking at the excited warriors.
After a minute had passed, he roared in a loud voice: "Alright, now that all of you are ready, then let’s START THE FIGH—"

Uranus was about to announce, but one of the men carrying a register ran toward him and spoke in a hushed tone: "Sir Uranus, it seems a person is still missing. I think he is still in the lobby, his number is 669."
"Hmm? What’s he doing there? Sigh, let me call him." Uranus shook his head before speaking into the mic: "Warrior number 669, come to the stage. The battle will be starting soon."
A minute passed and there was complete silence in the arena. Even the crowd had become quiet by now as they looked around to see which fighter was missing, but no one came forward.
"Warrior 669, if you don’t come forward, then you will automatically be eliminated from the battle." Uranus shouted again, in an irritated tone, while gazing at the lobby area.
Five more minutes passed, yet there was no response.
"Damnit, what is his name?" Uranus was getting angry. He looked at the registrar and asked.
"Uh... that’s..." the registrar fumbled with the register as he looked down and up nervously.

"Just give it here. Let me give him one last call. It wouldn’t be good if he accidentally missed such a big event." Uranus snatched the register and then looked down at the name attached to number 669. His face twitched and veins bulged on his face.
’W-What kind of name is it? Why is it so long? He wrote an entire damn essay. Is he trying to cause trouble?’
But gritting his teeth, he still announced that warrior’s name.
"Ladies and Gentlemen—" Uranus cleared his throat and began to read out the name, while the public’s interest was instantly piqued since it seemed the host was about to make some big announcement.
" The warrior- ’Since the beginning of this universe, the greatest man to have ever been born, the one with the best mind and body.
The most important person in the world, main character of this match; around whom all of you are nothing more than side characters— no, cannon fodders, mere dust and shit.
Of course, the two beautiful ladies excluded. Now let’s welcome the one and only... DADDY V!!! THE GREATEST OF ALL TIME!!!’ please come on the stage."
"..." The whole arena fell silent, while Uranus turned red from embarrassment. He really wanted to beat up the person who used such a big and shameful name.
"Daddy V?!! Who the hell is that? Damnit, is he messing with us? Making us call him that?"
"D-Daddy V? What is that even? And why did the host give such an exaggerated intro for this guy? Is he the son of the king or something?"
"Is the host kidnapped? Why is he so biased this time? What’s wrong with him? His script was probably changed, right? How could he be praising one contestant to such an extent?"
All the people were passing all kinds of comments as they stared at Uranus in disbelief. More than half of them had started to hate this warrior called— Daddy V even before he had appeared.
Just while everyone was busy questioning or cursing, the sky rumbled and turned dark. The arena fell silent as they all looked up in surprise. The atmosphere had suddenly turned cold and then—
In the midst of summer, snow began to fall from the sky. The clouds rumbled, and the whole arena became darker and darker.

Then, as if a performance was being prepared, a single ray of light fell from amidst the clouds as they parted just a bit. Then a figure in a strange red dress, with a cape on his back, slowly descended with snow swirling around him.
His speed was very slow as he floated toward the fighting area.
On his chest were letters: —LAST NIGHT, I FUCKED—
On his cape were:—YOUR MOTHER—
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +14,249}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +13,973}
{Sin Point Gained: Provoked +14,188}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +14,248}

Hellmancer and Golem, go protect my mother for now.’ As he commanded, two shadows flew out— though no one noticed them.
There was a large stage at the center of the arena where more than a thousand people would be fighting.
They could form groups and use any weapons.
There were still some rules, and killing was prohibited.
Out of a thousand, only fifty would be selected in the end.
Around the fighting area, the seats were completely crowded with people— there were over fourteen thousand people.
The whole place was already filled with excitement and cheering, as if they had already forgotten about the disaster that happened the previous day.
DING
"Welcome, Goddess and Miss." A middle-aged man wearing a colorful dress and with spiked hair suddenly jumped onto the fighting stage, holding something that resembled a mic.
His voice reverberated all over the place as he bowed respectfully toward Diana and Vanessa before addressing the crowd.
"Hello my friends, this is Uranus, the famous host who will be hosting this special event.
It is much more than just the recruitment of guards.
The fights will, as usual, be very brutal, so those with weak hearts— make sure to keep all your openings closed."
Uranus shouted, building up the excitement.
He didn’t waste much time as he next announced: "Let’s call all of our one thousand eighty-four warriors onto the stage to fight.
The rules will remain the same as usual— the last fifty standing will be selected as the Royal Guards.
So let’s welcome our strong warriors!"
The crowd roared and clapped.
The warriors in the lobby felt their excitement increase.
All of them rushed out to the fighting stage, spreading over the large area.
The fighters made sure to stand in a way that they wouldn’t end up ambushed right at the start.
Many were even joining groups.
Within seconds, the stage became crowded.
Uranus took his position on a platform close to the stage while looking at the excited warriors.
After a minute had passed, he roared in a loud voice: "Alright, now that all of you are ready, then let’s START THE FIGH—"
Uranus was about to announce, but one of the men carrying a register ran toward him and spoke in a hushed tone: "Sir Uranus, it seems a person is still missing.
I think he is still in the lobby, his number is 669."
"Hmm?
What’s he doing there?
Sigh, let me call him." Uranus shook his head before speaking into the mic: "Warrior number 669, come to the stage.
The battle will be starting soon."
A minute passed and there was complete silence in the arena.
Even the crowd had become quiet by now as they looked around to see which fighter was missing, but no one came forward.
"Warrior 669, if you don’t come forward, then you will automatically be eliminated from the battle." Uranus shouted again, in an irritated tone, while gazing at the lobby area.
Five more minutes passed, yet there was no response.
"Damnit, what is his name?" Uranus was getting angry.
He looked at the registrar and asked.
"Uh... that’s..." the registrar fumbled with the register as he looked down and up nervously.
"Just give it here.
Let me give him one last call.
It wouldn’t be good if he accidentally missed such a big event." Uranus snatched the register and then looked down at the name attached to number 669.
His face twitched and veins bulged on his face.
’W-What kind of name is it?
Why is it so long?
He wrote an entire damn essay.
Is he trying to cause trouble?’
But gritting his teeth, he still announced that warrior’s name.
"Ladies and Gentlemen—" Uranus cleared his throat and began to read out the name, while the public’s interest was instantly piqued since it seemed the host was about to make some big announcement.
" The warrior- ’Since the beginning of this universe, the greatest man to have ever been born, the one with the best mind and body.
The most important person in the world, main character of this match; around whom all of you are nothing more than side characters— no, cannon fodders, mere dust and shit.
Of course, the two beautiful ladies excluded.
Now let’s welcome the one and only...
DADDY V!!!
THE GREATEST OF ALL TIME!!!’ please come on the stage."
"..." The whole arena fell silent, while Uranus turned red from embarrassment.
He really wanted to beat up the person who used such a big and shameful name.
"Daddy V?!!
Who the hell is that?
Damnit, is he messing with us?
Making us call him that?"
"D-Daddy V?
What is that even?
And why did the host give such an exaggerated intro for this guy?
Is he the son of the king or something?"
"Is the host kidnapped?
Why is he so biased this time?
What’s wrong with him?
His script was probably changed, right?
How could he be praising one contestant to such an extent?"
All the people were passing all kinds of comments as they stared at Uranus in disbelief.
More than half of them had started to hate this warrior called— Daddy V even before he had appeared.
Just while everyone was busy questioning or cursing, the sky rumbled and turned dark.
The arena fell silent as they all looked up in surprise.
The atmosphere had suddenly turned cold and then—
In the midst of summer, snow began to fall from the sky.
The clouds rumbled, and the whole arena became darker and darker.
Then, as if a performance was being prepared, a single ray of light fell from amidst the clouds as they parted just a bit.
Then a figure in a strange red dress, with a cape on his back, slowly descended with snow swirling around him.
His speed was very slow as he floated toward the fighting area.
On his chest were letters: —LAST NIGHT, I FUCKED—
On his cape were:—YOUR MOTHER—
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +14,249}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +13,973}
{Sin Point Gained: Provoked +14,188}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +14,248}

chapters.title: Chapter 70: The Detestable
paragraphs: ’Oof, how much love I am receiving, look how excited they all are.’ Vritra, who was slowly descending from the sky, was gloating as the Sin Points literally rained down. All the people were too kind to give him so much.

"Hahaha, sure, they really are very happy to see you. I can’t believe you made all fourteen thousand people hate you just by your appearance." Yasmine laughed. Seeing Vritra act like that and the reaction of the people was just too funny.

All the people were staring at him in stunned silence, then many began to curse and mock him for his intro and the words written on his clothes. He seemed to have become the public enemy, but what mattered were just the Sin Points.
{Sin Point Gained: Mocked +10,915}
{Sin Point Gained: Belittled +11,129}
Vritra looked around at the crowd. A couple of minutes had passed, yet with his slow descending speed he was still several meters high in the sky.

"What the hell do you think you are doing? Get down here immediately, how long do you plan to stay up there, Dadd—warrior 669?" Uranus shouted, his face turning red from anger. Never in a battle had he become this angry at any warrior.
"Oh sorry, I am a little bad at landing." Vritra spoke, his voice sounding much heavier, as he increased his speed.
"That’s him!!" both Diana and Vanessa exclaimed. They could both recognize that it was Vritra, but they couldn’t understand why he was doing all that, so they just observed silently.
All of a sudden, it seemed Vritra slipped in the air as he swung his arms around and began to fall down. The crowd instantly became happy.
{Sin Point Gained: Laughed At +14,268}
{Sin Point Gained: Mocked +14,197}
{Sin Point Gained: Worried +2}
"Serves you right, damnit, this is what karma looks like. Now drop dead, dadd- damn it. I am still so pissed, this guy is a demon."
"Hahaha, fall to your death, bastard. You’re the greatest man in the world? Haha, throw him away from the stage, you can’t let him fight— or just let me fight and kill him."
But unlike what everyone was hoping for, Vritra suddenly rolled and safely landed on his feet. Then he waved at the audience.
{Sin Point Gained: Disappointed +14,333}
{Sin Point Gained: Cursed +13,863}
"Shit, I am betting a hundred gold coins that he will be beaten to death by all the thousand participants. I can’t even see his face, but I hate that smug look more than anything."
"So detestable, darn it, even god doesn’t want him there."
"Go Daddy V, Go!! You can do it, Daddy V, you are the most most most most most goated man in the world. Go brother!!!"
{Sin Point Gained: Encouraged +1}
"Huh? Who is this baldy, why are you praising him so much? Are you a monk? Did he pay you to say that? Hey everyone, get this baldy bastard, he is with Daddy V."
And so, Monk Shitless ran away from his seat to hide as several people ran behind him to beat him up.
"Tch, let’s not waste any more time and start the fight. All of you are free to make groups, and even if all of you were to target a single participant it would be alright.
And even if you accidentally end up beating him half to death, it will also be fine." Uranus announced. His hate towards Vritra seemed even higher than the others.

’Sigh, this is really embarrassing, but at least I am getting a lot of Sin Points. Things are going to become even more chaotic now.’ Vritra sighed as he adjusted his mask. He didn’t want his real identity to be revealed, while Yasmine kept laughing.
"The battle starts NOW!!" Uranus announced, his voice very loud as the crowd also roared— most of them encouraging others to kill Daddy V.
The warriors grinned as they looked around. Many even fixed their sights on Vritra, but before the fight could start, a loud shout reverberated.
"STOP EVERYONE!!"
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +15,024}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared At +14,261}
Uranus became extremely furious.
"COUGHAs you all already know, I am the most important person among everyone present here, and I have absolutely no interest in the shitty pigsty position of a guard.
That’s too low for someone like me, and only lowlife bugs, beggars, sewer rats like you all would want it." Vritra spoke, his voice full of arrogance and ridicule.
{Sin Point Gained: Aggravated +15,190}
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +14,597}
{Sin Point Gained: Vowed Vengeance +10,986}
{Sin Point Gained: Snapped +4,423}

Vritra’s words had instantly enraged everyone, but he was not yet finished. With his hands behind his back and the cape fluttering despite there being no wind, he walked around casually; each step meant to belittle others.
"So here is an offer for you all gutter bugs— if any single one of you can manage to make me bleed, then you would directly receive the job.
If you can cut any of my limbs, then you would be given the job of a guard commander directly. And if you could injure me seriously, then you would get an even higher-ranked position in the castle.
If you don’t believe me, the revered goddess would confirm my words." Vritra said, his voice ringing around the entire arena.
The people were confused as they instinctively looked at Diana, who seemed just as confused, but she nodded her head, making all the people baffled.
"Is your son alright? What is he doing this for?" Diana whispered to Vanessa, who just shrugged her shoulders and looked at Vritra worriedly.
"Is he one of those who likes getting hit... masochist? Does he want to be killed by challenging more than a thousand people?" one of the warriors holding a blade muttered.
"Who cares? We have to snatch his limbs before others. Our life would be set if we could become one of the commanders. This is a godsent opportunity," another warrior added.
"Brothers, let’s slaughter this shameless Daddy V! I would be happy as long as anyone could cut off his tongue. I will offer two hundred gold coins to that person."

Similar discussions broke out among all the participants. They instantly became excited. How could just one person fight against so many of them? So it wasn’t a question ofifhe could be killed, but who would be the ones to reap benefits from his death.
"Go for it! Go for it!!" Uranus, who was supposed to stop this madness, was cheering on the warriors.
’Will he be alright?’ Vanessa felt nervous. Vritra stood surrounded by more than a thousand men with all kinds of weapons. She believed in him but still felt worried.
{Sin Point Gained: Locked On +1,132}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared At +10,536}
{Sin Point Gained: Hesitated +1,131}
Vritra noticed that despite all his harsh remarks and cursing, these people were hesitating since he seemed to have some kind of connection with the goddess.
All of them wanted to rush forward and attack him, but they were afraid of the consequences.
So, he decided to give them the final push.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Demonic Eye Slash
paragraphs: ’Sigh, such timid people. What could they do with so little courage?’ Vritra shook his head internally and decided to give one more push.
"Hehe, let the show start, hubby!!" Yasmine cheered him on. Aside from Monk Shitless, who was hiding in one of the corners, she was the only one who cheered for him to create more chaos.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra gave a loud shout: "If all of you have more than two fathers then move, but if you are cowards, then just stay standing there like the loyal pigs you all are."
{Sin Point Gained: Taunted +1,134}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +15,052}
{Sin Point Gained: Cursed +2,521}

The warriors on the stage were instantly enraged. They had trained for so long, so how could they stand when someone was cursing them like that? Their rage overtook their minds as all of them took one step towards Vritra.
STEP!!!
"You bastard, of course we aren’t cowards. Now you’re gonna have to pay the price for your shit talking." One warrior raised a heavy hammer as he got ready to charge forward.
"Of course we have more than two fathers, do you think we are like you—" While another warrior was shouting, he suddenly noticed something, and all the warriors instinctively fell silent.
Vritra seemed to have played the word game; shouldn’t he have said: "If you are born from a single father then step forward?"
STEP...
All of the warriors took that step back at the same time, as they glared at Vritra, who was just enjoying the rain of Sin Points. The more emotions he induced in them, the more points he obtained.
{Sin Point Gained: Furious +1,134}
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +15,052}
"Alright, let’s not waste any more time and get started. All thousand of you are free to use whatever means to fight me." Vritra announced as he raised his hand to bring forth his weapon.
All his opponents became vigilant. They wondered if his weapon was the one giving him all the confidence.
Vritra brought his right hand back towards his neck and seemed to pull out his deadly weapon from under his cape. All the thousands of people watched with curiosity to see the legendary weapon.

As he brought his right hand forward, everyone saw a thin and long green stick in his hand that seemed to have broken off from a tree just recently. It was like a stick parents or teachers would use to scare the kids or sometimes punish.
{Sin Point Gained: Stunned +15,055}
{Sin Point Gained: Mocked +14,826}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1,134}
"Now, come and fight me." Vritra took one step forward, waving the thin stick dangerously in the air.
"..." The warriors were just shocked by this scene.

"Let me go, just let me go. I am going on the stage and I am going to kill that daddy on my own—I mean Daddy V on my own." One middle aged man from the spectators shouted, even though no one was holding him.
"I- Is this damned creature planning to fight us all with that flexible stick? Is he openly mocking us all? Fuck, I knew it. He was only here to cause trouble."

"Kill him! Kill him! Kill him! Kill him! Whoever kills him will be able to marry my daughter and gain all my property! Just kill this bastard!" Uranus, who was supposed to keep the situation calm, was the most angry one.
"Go, Daddy V, Go! Beat all their asses with that stick! You are the greatest of all!" someone cheered from under the seats.
"Huh? Isn’t that Baldy’s voice? Where is that bastard hiding? He is in cahoots with Daddy V. Brothers, let us kill that Baldy first—oh, that bastard is hiding under the seats."

Vritra looked at the messages in satisfaction. His points were shooting up like crazy. After he was done gathering all the points, he would certainly be able to pull out one or two things at least with so many points.

"Let’s just kill him." The warriors couldn’t hold themselves back anymore. All thousand of them charged forward with their weapons raised while some prepared to launch various kinds of spells at Vritra.

"Heh, now face my most dangerous and deadly attack, the power I have been hiding in my left hand for a long time. Go and face the..." While speaking, Vritra raised his left hand, but no warrior stopped at his bluff. They arrived very close to him.

"The Demonic Eye Slash." Vritra shouted in a menacing voice as he waved his left hand in the air, and something red colored shot out of it. The warriors finally became vigilant as they raised their guards and pulled up their defenses.

But it was too late. The ones in the front were affected first as the Demonic Eye Slash struck them all. A burning sensation instantly spread in their eyes, and they could only stand there while rubbing their eyes and cursing. The red powder spread across the air and under Vritra’s control spread across all the other warriors.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +15,109}
{Sin Point Gained: Speechless +15,097}
{Sin Point Gained: Looked Down Upon +14,103}

"D- Did this bastard really just use chili powder in such a fight? And he called it what—Demonic Eye Slash?!! Hah, ridiculous! How is this not against the rules? Just let me enter and I will break that bastard’s neck." The same man from earlier shouted, rolling up his sleeves.
"Hey host! Get that cheater out! How is this a fair fight? He is so despicable, so detestable! I hate him even more than the man who stole my wife, fuck!!"

Vritra didn’t care about any of them. For him, this wasn’t a fair fight to begin with—no, it wasn’t even a fight. It was just to farm Sin Points, and he was going to do whatever it took to get them, as many as he could.
He controlled the chili particles with his dust manipulation skill and made most of the warriors go blind for a bit of time.

"Now, get ready to suffer!!" Vritra spoke and released a loud demonic laughter that reverberated even outside the arena, making people shiver. The audience was already worried about those poor warriors who were still rubbing their eyes.
Vritra moved calmly forward as his speed increased suddenly. He didn’t use full speed, but only of someone near the 200 level, which still surprised the audience.
His figure almost turned into a blur as he moved from warrior to warrior, his right hand slashing at the opponents dozens of times each second.
BANG BANG
WHACK WHACK
WHAP! —
"Aiiieee! Aiiiiieeeeeee! Not the face, NOT THE FACE!!"
"Ow- ow- ow- ow! Nooo, not again!"
"NYAAAHHHHHHHH! My spine!! Waaah! That was my butt!! SOB, PLEASE, I HAVE A FAMILY!! N- Not there! Ugghhh! My children..."
"KYAAAAAA! M- MORE, YESSSS!! RIGHT THERE, SMACK MY ASS—HNNNNN~"
Loud noises from the people instantly filled the entire arena. Vritra moved from person to person at an extremely fast speed and would deliver a couple dozen strikes before moving to the next person.
The audience fell into shocked silence as they watched this baffling sight. Those warriors were releasing all kinds of noises.
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +14,107}
{Sin Point Gained: Shivered +13,937}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +15,011}
{Sin Point Gained: Petrified +9,168}

All thousand of them charged forward with their weapons raised while some prepared to launch various kinds of spells at Vritra.
"Heh, now face my most dangerous and deadly attack, the power I have been hiding in my left hand for a long time.
Go and face the..." While speaking, Vritra raised his left hand, but no warrior stopped at his bluff.
They arrived very close to him.
"The Demonic Eye Slash." Vritra shouted in a menacing voice as he waved his left hand in the air, and something red colored shot out of it.
The warriors finally became vigilant as they raised their guards and pulled up their defenses.
But it was too late.
The ones in the front were affected first as the Demonic Eye Slash struck them all.
A burning sensation instantly spread in their eyes, and they could only stand there while rubbing their eyes and cursing.
The red powder spread across the air and under Vritra’s control spread across all the other warriors.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +15,109}
{Sin Point Gained: Speechless +15,097}
{Sin Point Gained: Looked Down Upon +14,103}
"D- Did this bastard really just use chili powder in such a fight?
And he called it what—Demonic Eye Slash?!!
Hah, ridiculous!
How is this not against the rules?
Just let me enter and I will break that bastard’s neck." The same man from earlier shouted, rolling up his sleeves.
"Hey host!
Get that cheater out!
How is this a fair fight?
He is so despicable, so detestable!
I hate him even more than the man who stole my wife, fuck!!"
Vritra didn’t care about any of them.
For him, this wasn’t a fair fight to begin with—no, it wasn’t even a fight.
It was just to farm Sin Points, and he was going to do whatever it took to get them, as many as he could.
He controlled the chili particles with his dust manipulation skill and made most of the warriors go blind for a bit of time.
"Now, get ready to suffer!!" Vritra spoke and released a loud demonic laughter that reverberated even outside the arena, making people shiver.
The audience was already worried about those poor warriors who were still rubbing their eyes.
Vritra moved calmly forward as his speed increased suddenly.
He didn’t use full speed, but only of someone near the 200 level, which still surprised the audience.
His figure almost turned into a blur as he moved from warrior to warrior, his right hand slashing at the opponents dozens of times each second.
BANG BANG
WHACK WHACK
WHAP!
"Aiiieee!
Aiiiiieeeeeee!
Not the face, NOT THE FACE!!"
"Ow- ow- ow- ow!
Nooo, not again!"
"NYAAAHHHHHHHH!
My spine!!
Waaah!
That was my butt!!
SOB, PLEASE, I HAVE A FAMILY!!
N- Not there!
Ugghhh!
My children..."
"KYAAAAAA!
M- MORE, YESSSS!!
RIGHT THERE, SMACK MY ASS—HNNNNN~"
Loud noises from the people instantly filled the entire arena.
Vritra moved from person to person at an extremely fast speed and would deliver a couple dozen strikes before moving to the next person.
The audience fell into shocked silence as they watched this baffling sight.
Those warriors were releasing all kinds of noises.
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +14,107}
{Sin Point Gained: Shivered +13,937}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +15,011}
{Sin Point Gained: Petrified +9,168}

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Fall! Fall! Fall!
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1023}
{Sin Point Gained: Despised +14,276}
{Sin Point Gained: Threatened +10,132}
{Sin Point Gained: Pleasured +2}

For a straight half an hour, Vritra gave a hard beating to all the participants—though it seemed a couple of them enjoyed it quite a bit—while the audience was horrified. For thirty minutes, Vritra received message after message, as his sin points increased rapidly.
Uranus was going crazy, but Vritra hadn’t really broken any rule, so he couldn’t do anything.
He just kept shouting from the outside at this one-sided slaughter. It was like those grown-up warriors had become kids and they were being beaten by their parents.
"H- He really is Daddy. I pity those thousand warriors. Are they going to be alright? Look at those red marks, and what is that stick made of? Why hasn’t it broken already?"
"Sigh, I can’t watch this anymore. He is just so hateful. Just let me enter the fighting area and I will beat the crap out of him."
"Is that so? Then here you go."
"Ahhh! Baldie, what are you doing? Ughhh, s- sorry, I was just joking. I didn’t actually mean to enter the arena, f- forgive me Daddy V, t- that baldie pushed me. Aaaaaaah!!"

Finally, Vritra paused after beating up all the warriors and one additional person from the audience. He noticed that the number of points was reducing since the audience’s emotions hadn’t changed much after watching the beating for so long.

"Now, I won’t use my weapon and won’t attack anyone. You are free to go ahead and attack me however you want. Don’t you want those shitty guard positions?" Vritra threw away the stick and stood still, his tone mocking, as another wave of points came.
"Die, you dirty, tricky bastard. I am going to slash you into a thousand pieces."
"You demon! I told you n- not to hit my sob face. Now who is going to marry me? All my girlfriends are going to leave me... sob... those older girlfriends."
"Brothers, let’s attack this red man together. If we don’t kill him today, then we are not sons of one father."
Thousands of enraged men charged forward. Many instantly shot spells, and others waved their weapons at Vritra, while the audience cheered them on. They all wanted to see this man being killed.
But Vritra just casually walked around, slightly twisting or turning his body as he easily dodged all those attacks. Another wave of sin points began to appear.
Just like that, the competition continued. Whenever Vritra noticed that the number of points was getting lower, he would again do something even more ridiculous that enraged everyone even further.

Hours passed while the audience experienced all kinds of emotions. By the end, several people from the audience had jumped from their seats into the fighting area to kill Vritra themselves, only to get beaten so badly.

Slowly, the number of people on the stage kept decreasing as more and more were either thrown out of the fighting area or jumped out in terror. Diana and Vanessa were extremely confused, wondering why Vritra was doing all this.
They knew that this wasn’t his personality, but they found it all too funny. Yasmine kept laughing the entire time—she had never laughed so much in her life.

The battle was supposed to end by two or three in the afternoon, but it was already evening, and the sky had started to darken. The fight was still going on—no, this wasn’t a fight, this was just Vritra’s farming land.
At one point, the number of people had reached even more than twenty thousand, and the public collectively hated just one person. It was all too ridiculous.

Finally, only fifty-one people remained on the stage. Vritra stood on one side and fifty others fearfully looked at him. Their bodies were bruised and battered, they were bleeding badly and kept shivering. All their bravado had completely disappeared.

"You fifty are the finest shit among the ones who had come here to become lowly guards. It is a great accomplishment for you all to still be standing despite all the beatings. You could be called the Bitches in Britches!!" Vritra continued to mock them as he walked along the boundary of the fighting area.
"W- What do you want? Sob... I have a young mother at home. Who is going to feed her? Please let me go. My father only has one leg. I brought his fake leg here to fight. Please let me leave."
"Ughhh... M- My heart is bleeding... I need to get my balls treated... My sister just got pregnant, and the child needs a father. You can take her if you want."
Vritra ignored their comments, as he gazed at the red-faced Uranus, who was standing near the boundary and seemed as if he was about to go berserk.
"Mr. Host, are you alright? Do you need some help?" Vritra stopped at the boundary and leaned forward, his hands resting over his knees.
THUCK
Just then, the stone under Vritra’s feet broke, and his body swayed forward. The audience once again became excited. They prayed and cheered for him to fall forward.
"Fall! Fall! Fall! If gods really exist, then you won’t let a cheater like him win."
"I will go to temple daily and give away all my wealth. O God, please make him fall."
{Sin Point Gained: Excited +20,597}
{Sin Point Gained: Encouraged +19,911}
Vritra tried to balance himself as he pulled back, his body still swinging in the air.
"Nooooo! Fooo Foooo, please fall down." The crowd was even blowing air to make him fall, but it seemed Vritra was about to regain his balance.
{Sin Point Gained: Disappointed +21,844}
{Sin Point Gained: Hoped +18,232}
THUD

Finally, Vritra wasn’t able to balance, and he ended up stepping out of the stage and lost the competition. Fifty warriors fell to their knees as they cried and hugged each other, praying and thanking the gods, thanking even their ancestors.
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +21,845}
{Sin Point Gained: Thanked +50}
{Sin Point Gained: Satisfied +20,124}
{Sin Point Gained: Delighted +21,776}
"Yesssss!!! There really is a god. Haha, I have never been this happy." The crowd got so happy that they hugged one another and smiled amicably.
"No, I didn’t lose. That was an accident. A- Allow me to go inside again." Vritra stepped in front of the host and asked, but Uranus laughed madly in satisfaction as he shook his head.
"No no no, you have lost. Now get lost. Hahahaha. Such a great day! Ahh, I can now die in satisfaction." Uranus felt as if he had become several decades younger—he was too happy and delighted.

"You bastard. I don’t agree with your rules. You get lost." Vritra slapped the host, and the man instantly vanished from there. The audience was shocked as they looked around and couldn’t find the host.
{Sin Point Gained: Terrified +21,139}
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +18,235}
"W- Where is Uranus?"
"Huh? My anus? It’s on my butt. Wanna see it?"
"Shut up, Baldie—Oh, you are back again? Brothers, let’s put this seat in his butt."
As the sin points poured out, Vritra turned his gaze towards the high platform where his mother and Diana were seated. Then he flew up under everyone’s gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Lab Experiment?
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Startled +2}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}

After Uranus disappeared, Vritra suddenly flew towards the high platform where Diana and Vanessa were seated. Both of them were surprised by his sudden action. Vanessa wasn’t much worried, but Diana had started to sweat; she was afraid that Vritra might do something.
’Don’t come, don’t come.’ She pleaded internally while remaining calm outside.

Vritra landed in front of the two ladies while the crowd was frozen. Of course, there were many guards there to protect the goddess, but just as they were about to make their moves, Diana waved her hand, making them stop.
He first glanced at Diana but didn’t say or do anything immediately. After a painful few seconds while the crowd held their breath, he simply extended his right hand for a handshake.

Diana was still worried internally, but she shook hands with him without showing any emotion, as another wave of sin points rained. Most of the people were jealous of him—just seeing the goddess was considered such a lucky thing, after all.

Vritra then turned to face his mother. He took a step forward and halted exactly in front of her. He slightly raised his mask, showing half of his face to his mother, who stood up and looked at him with a faint smile.
"Mom, shall we leave?" Vritra asked in a low voice that only Diana could hear. Vanessa nodded in response; she was already aware that it was Vritra.

In the next moment, he took another step forward. His left hand circled around her soft body as he pulled her into a tight embrace, while his right hand held the mask in position, displaying half of his face.
The two slowly began to rise in the air while the entire crowd watched in hushed silence, feeling various kinds of emotions that could clearly be seen in the sin points notifications.
Once Vritra and Vanessa were a few meters high above the platform—but were at a height that everyone could still see them clearly—the pair halted in the air.
This was going to be the last and biggest wave of sin points.
Slightly lowering his head, Vritra pressed his lips against Vanessa’s. The sudden kiss shocked everyone in the arena. The ones who were most shocked were, of course, Vanessa herself and Diana.
Vritra felt her soft and warm lips against his. They were so juicy and moist, excitement rose in Vritra’s body as their lips gently rubbed and pressed.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +22,536}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +17,490}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +20,473}
{Sin Point Gained: Crushed +21,239}
{Sin Point Gained: Heartbroken +18,373}
"G- Get away from her, bastard! How dare you try to taint our goddess? Fuck, I want to murder him but he is too scary."
"Guards, anyone please stop that criminal!!"

The audience—especially the men—had already given Vanessa the title of goddess just based on her beauty. Most men couldn’t help but steal glances at Vanessa earlier. In terms of hotness, her body was even more seductive.
And all the audience already hated Vritra so much—that’s why seeing such a guy kissing a goddess-level woman—they had simply gone mad; it was too much for them all.
’What’s going on? Aren’t they mother and son? Was their relation fake? Is he not Vritra? No, he definitely is, but...’ Diana was extremely confused as she watched the pair kiss in the sky.

Vritra didn’t care about anyone else. Their lips remained in contact for around twenty seconds, and there was barely any movement, but Vanessa’s face had turned bright red. The sensation on her lips was too strong.
{Sin Point Gained: Craved +1}

As their lips separated, Vanessa licked her lips unconsciously while staring at the face exactly in front of her, her mind racing. Even though she had kissed Vritra once before, this was still too stimulating.
"Mom, shall we go? We have an important business to finish." Vritra whispered, his voice taking her breath away, as she averted her gaze and nodded a bit shyly.

Vritra didn’t care about the audience, the competition, or the sin points anymore, as he flew away from there carrying her in princess-carry style, leaving behind a frozen and shocked crowd. All the people had finally reached rock bottom—many were depressed and some had even fainted in rage, especially Uranus, who was nowhere to be seen.
Vritra and Vanessa flew away silently. After a moment he asked, "Mom, there is something I have been very curious about for quite some time."
"..." Vanessa remained silent. She already knew what he was going to ask.

"Since my childhood, I have never even heard the name of my father nor have I seen his photo. You always avoided the topic. Can you at least tell me who he is and if he is still alive?" Vritra asked. They were about to cross a taboo line, so he really wanted to know that.

"Sigh..." Her expression became serious as she decided to finally reveal it. "I am sure you have noticed it already—that you were different from everyone your age. In whatever aspect, you are far better than everyone else."
"Yes, I did." Vritra nodded. Even his stats were higher than everyone else’s. He certainly wasn’t normal.

"You also know that I hate all men because of that incident where my mother died right in front of me because of my father, right?" Vanessa asked, and Vritra nodded again. That’s why he was even more confused since she would never want to be close to a man.

She sighed again and added, "Actually, I had several skilled doctor friends. I asked them to create the perfect sample... and that’s how I got pregnant with you. That’s why you were perfect in every aspect; the peak human."
Vritra: "..."
’What the hell?!! Does that mean I am a lab rat—cough—lab experiment?’

In the morning, Jace and Tyler got ready, then together they walked towards Max’s room. The pair of thin and fat looked quite frightened, but were both afraid and disgusted by Vritra’s plan—but they had no choice but to do it.
He was just too scary.
They stopped beside Max’s room’s door, then they leaned against the walls and did their best to calm down as the first part of the plan began. Laughing loudly, they began to chat.
"Hahaha! Did you see that girl? She was giving me straight-up signals. I think she was into me; next time I am going to take her out," Jace said proudly.
"Yeah, right. Are you sure she was just not disgusted by you? I think she was laughing at you." Tyler laughed, his body jiggling.
"Hmph, there was even a time when more than ten girls asked me to go out at the same time," Jace said, his face full of arrogance.
"Dude, then stop entering women’s washroom. Of course, they are going to ask you to leave." Tyler laughed even harder.
Jace was about to get angry and punch him, but then he realized that they had gone off-topic.
"Cough... You know, yesterday I was going to my room and I heard Fiona talking to her friend. It was a secret, so don’t tell anyone," Jace said, calming his anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Hissss!
paragraphs: The slightly dark office remained silent for a few seconds, as the seven men wearing the golden masks stared into empty spaces as if they were nothing more than statues.

Then a man wearing the same black robe and a black mask hurriedly walked inside and passed a letter to each man after bowing respectfully. From the shivering of his body, it could be noticed how nervous and fearful he was.

"Sir, I have brought the latest report," the black masked man said and then waited there silently. The seven men picked up the reports and went through them quickly. On the masks, each of the seven men had a number written on it.
None of them were aware of each other’s real identity and only used those numbers to address one another.
"So the tomb has finally been found," Number Five muttered, his voice rather emotionless.
"Haha! So when are we leaving to go there? I heard there is some great treasure hidden in the tomb." Number Three appeared to be a psycho; even his clothes and mask were covered in blood.

"We have little information about that tomb. More than thirty men who had gone there to explore the area have already lost their lives. We could only personally make the move," Number Two spoke. Despite the grave news, his voice was calm.

"Tch, those sniffing dogs got a smell of the tomb too. Ha, I guess it can’t be helped. They are always on our tails, so we would just have to be careful against them. They can be quite annoying," Number One muttered as he threw away the report.

These seven men had been dispatched by the Nine Pact to the Dunshire Kingdom. They had several purposes in doing so; on the surface, they were performing various kinds of research, but they also had to find out more about a secret that the Nine Pact had discovered from ancient texts.
A tomb!!

Nothing was known about it except for the general location and the fact that it held a great treasure that could easily sway the power scale of a universe. So how could anyone not want something of that calibre?
"We will be going into the tomb soon, so all of you should finish your preparations by tonight. Has there been any other big change or breakthroughs in the research?" Number One asked after a moment.

"No sir, one subject is showing some special effects. We will be shifting that subject to this place today. Aside from the death of the golden knight, there have not been any big changes," the man in the black mask reported.

The man who had been by the king’s side had the number Six written on his mask. For a moment, he pondered about Vritra. Even though he was insignificant, it was still possible that he might be the pawn of someone on the opposite side.

’Well, it doesn’t matter, he will be taken care of soon.’ Number Six thought as he soon began thinking of some other matter. The king was hesitant to directly deal with Vritra because of the goddess, but the Nine Pact was not afraid of anyone in this small kingdom.
"Hurry everything up. Our motives aren’t hidden from others any longer, so it would be difficult to stay here for too long unless we succeed," Number Two spoke, then stood up and disappeared.
The tense atmosphere remained in the office even after the seven numbered men had disappeared from there.

’H- How terrifying, they are all monsters and to think they are just low tier leaders in the Nine Pact. No wonder most of the biggest families and organisations are afraid of our Nine Pact.’ The black masked man remained standing there even after dozens of minutes, fear creeping in his body.
Achoo!
Vritra sneezed suddenly during his casual walk in the market street, as another wave of sin points rained down.
{Sin Point Gained: Cared for +41}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +53}
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +83}
Rubbing his nose, Vritra mumbled, "Is someone talking about me?"
He was still wondering about how to find the location of the Divine Sin Tomb. Aside from the name, he knew nothing about it. It could be anywhere in such a large kingdom.
Yasmine had been quiet for some time now. Vritra wondered if she was pondering deeply about the current situation, so he asked in his mind, ’What are you thinking about?’

"Hmm, I was thinking that with the speed you are moving at, it won’t be long before you end up with a couple more wives. I was wondering who is going to be next. A dragon, a succubus, a goddess, a phoenix... and then what?" Her tone was quite solemn as she spoke, as if this was really a very serious matter.
Vritra: "..."
’Don’t worry, I will remember all your teasing and once you get your body, I will make you regret all of it. Haa, just you wait...’
"Hehe, stop tempting me, hubby," Yasmine giggled.
’Believe me, I will—’
HISSSS!
Just as Vritra was about to speak, he felt something rustling close to his feet and then he heard that hissing sound.
It was a snake, and for some reason, Vritra was reminded of Monk Shitless’s words.
’Be careful of the snake.’
Instinctively, he stepped to the side in a hurry and barely avoided stepping on the snake, which soon disappeared into one of the alleys. But in his hurry, Vritra didn’t see where he stepped.
THUMP
He bumped into a black robed man who was carrying a cubical box over half a meter large. The force of the strike was enough to make the man stumble as he fell on his butt.
THUD
The box fell from his hand, and the lid of the box opened and something round rolled out of it.

Just a moment ago, that man had taken the box from someone else inside a small hotel. He was advised to close the lock after checking, but he had forgotten to lock the door and that’s why, after the fall, the box opened.
Vritra was about to help the man when his gaze landed on the round object and his mind froze for a moment, though none of the reaction was visible outside.
It was a human head—and one that Vritra was all too familiar with.
It was the head of a slightly older woman: his class teacher.
Mrs. Mia. Vritra was shocked to see that head of his teacher, but outwardly, his expression remained calm.
The black robed man hastily got up and picked the head up and stored it in the box. Then he glanced around, and after making sure no one else had noticed it, his gaze returned to Vritra.
Killing intent flashed in his eyes. He couldn’t let any of the secrets of the Nine Pact out, so the only option was to kill Vritra.

"Oh man, nice prop. It looked so real. Damn, was it some kind of mask? Are you preparing for Halloween? I would love to buy one myself. Anyway, if we meet ever in the future, I am definitely getting such a mask. I am in a bit of a hurry right now," Vritra said as he patted the shoulder of the other man and released a helpless sigh.

Vritra whistled, and finally, the shock in his eyes became visible. The shocking part wasn’t only that it was the severed head of his teacher— but that he saw her pupils move slightly. It was such a slight movement that it was easily ignorable, but the message that popped up next made him believe such an impossible thing.

I did hear that she died in the labyrinth too, so she was being used for such cruel experiments?’ Vritra felt a chill. Had he not jumped into the trap at that time, wouldn’t it have been his head that would be carried around in the capital?

So, he soon made his decision.
He turned toward a random street and suddenly his body vanished, without leaving behind a single trace.

The black robed man discreetly walked out of the market and headed into a desolate area in the forest. His speed suddenly increased after he had entered the forest. He was still quite vigilant as he took sharp twists and turns and ran through strange paths, to throw anyone following him off his trail.

In around forty or so minutes, the black robed man and all the people following behind him had arrived in front of a well hidden and ordinary looking cave. Occasionally, people would walk in and out of it. The group of twenty men made their way into the cave, unknown to them Vritra followed closely behind.

In his current state, none of the people were able to sense him at all. They had already relaxed as they chatted casually and walked toward a very large hall. Constant screams and painful wails continued to ring out from that hall. There were hundreds upon hundreds of iron beds of sorts placed all over the hall.
Even though the cave seemed ordinary from the outside, it was extremely well built from the inside. There were all kinds of equipment in the hall for various experiments.

Each of the iron beds had at least one or two people they were referring to as subjects. Vritra paused at the entrance as he gazed at the entire hall in shock and disgust, while holding onto mana potions in his hands.
He had slaughtered so many demons already and had even consumed their flesh and blood.

Even when he killed a human with his own hands for the first time, he didn’t feel much— but seeing the inhumane scene in front of him, even Vritra’s nose wrinkled as he felt disgusted toward all these people from the Nine Pacts who were conducting the experiments.
Doctors—it was the word being used for those people in black robes with white masks. The box containing Mia’s head was passed to one such doctor, who safely put it away and dismissed the team.

Constantly, a few people died every couple of minutes in such cruel ways. Their bodies were dismembered, various kinds of poison, viruses, and whatnot were injected into their bodies. Some even looked so disfigured that people would just vomit upon seeing their appearance.
Blood was such a normal sight in there, even Vritra couldn’t keep looking at those pitiful humans for too long. From kids to old people, men and women— there were a lot of them.

"This is just a small side of the Nine Pacts, and there are a few more such dark organizations who would go to any limit to obtain their goals," Yasmine spoke, her voice filled with anger. She too hated such humans who put others— innocent people— through such agony just for their selfish reasons.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra began to move around the large cave. The more he knew about his opponent, the better his chances were at winning against them.

Among the seven leaders present here, five had already left the cave after their meeting to prepare themselves for entering the dangerous tomb, while two had remained behind to look over the various arrangements.
Number Two and Number Four— one was making sure that all the preparations were done regarding the tomb, while the other was more interested in the results of various researches.
Among the seven men, Number One was the strongest and Number Seven was the weakest, but all of them were above level 800. They alone were capable of throwing off the royals of this kingdom.

While flying around the cave, Vritra soon heard a term he hadn’t expected to. A group of men were talking about a certain adventure in a certain tomb. They too didn’t have much info, but that was enough for Vritra to guess what this adventure was about.

After moving around for over half an hour and using a few mana potions, Vritra finally left that area. He soon arrived at the market since he was reaching the limit of the skill. Now that he had stayed in that space for a long time, he noticed the limit.
Not only did his head begin to hurt, but he felt that if he stayed there too long with his current strength, he would be lost there forever.

After arriving in the market and finding a rather quiet corner, he came out of the Fourth Dimension and felt mentally exhausted. But withShiftandSerene Mindworking passively, his mental state soon got better.
’Huff... so it is the Nine Pacts that had discovered the Divine Sin Tomb. I have to go there, but it would still be very dangerous.

I can depend on the Fourth Dimension to avoid danger to some extent, but it isn’t omnipotent— and who knows, maybe others might have a way to counter it, like Yasmine had said before.’ Vritra pondered as he pulled a chair out of his inventory, sat down, and drank water from a bottle.
"Do you really want to go there?" Yasmine asked in a serious tone. She couldn’t underestimate a tomb of that caliber, and there would be many other dangerous factors.
"Yeah, I am going there. But before that, I guess we’re gonna have to do some shopping." After he spoke, Vritra shifted his attention to the Divine Sin Points in his status window.

I’m in a bit of a hurry right now, so I’ll be taking my leave," Vritra said with a smile.
Then he hummed a song and walked away.

Vritra whistled, and finally, the shock in his eyes became visible.
The shocking part wasn’t only that it was the severed head of his teacher— but that he saw her pupils move slightly.
It was such a slight movement that it was easily ignorable, but the message that popped up next made him believe such an impossible thing.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
’She was alive?
That was Mrs.
Mia, my teacher back in school.
She had come here along with us.
I did hear that she died in the labyrinth too, so she was being used for such cruel experiments?’ Vritra felt a chill.
Had he not jumped into the trap at that time, wouldn’t it have been his head that would be carried around in the capital?
"Yeah, she certainly was alive.
What do you plan to do now?
They were definitely from the Nine Pacts," Yasmine asked.
She had sensed that there were a few more men who were following that person from the shadows.

His relation with his teacher wasn’t so close that he would madly charge to take revenge after witnessing that scene, but he had to know more about the Nine Pacts.
