chapters.title: Chapter 82: Better Luck Next Time
paragraphs: {Sin Point: 3,892,289}
"So there are a total of three hundred eighty nine chances. That’s the number of keys I can currently buy."

Maybe adding the Divine Sin Arrow— if I obtain it later— would greatly upgrade the Divine Sin Wheel, and he might later regret expending most of his points. But to survive in that tomb, he needed more than his current strength. What would be the point of dying while carrying so many points?
It was better to be prepared than end up regretting it.
"So wifey, how strong do you think I currently am? If I were to go all out, using everything in my arsenal, what might be the highest level I can take on?" Vritra asked.
He had seen those two people—Number Two and Number Four—in the cave, and they seemed even stronger than the golden knight and that man from the Nine Pacts.
"..." Yasmine remained silent for a few seconds. She didn’t want to make any mistake as she observed Vritra even more carefully. After five whole minutes had passed in silence, she finally spoke:
"Hmmm... level 870 with the addition of the Dark Knight. But if you were to really push it without caring about anything else, and are lucky enough, then maybe 872 or 873.

The difference between each level becomes exceedingly high the more you approach level one thousand. After level 873, it will get truly dangerous for you—of course, without my involvement. But with me here... around level 900 or so."

Vritra felt that the concept of levels was too absurd. Even with high stats, the power difference between each level couldn’t be easily crossed. But he couldn’t complain—after all, just being in the 500s, he had killed someone that high level only a couple of days ago.
"I understand. Then what about those two men who seemed especially strong? What should be their level?" Vritra asked, trying to see just how dangerous this trip was going to be.
"They were around level 865. Those two are manageable if you fight them one on one and with all your strength," Yasmine answered simply.
"Sigh... so I can only place my hopes on getting something useful." Vritra sighed. Just as he was about to buy the Sin Keys, he remembered that he had received a new skill recently.
[Natural Hypnosis]

(Skill Description): A natural and subtle change of thought caused to the intended target; would change their actions naturally without them being aware of the alterations. Slow and gradual manipulation.

"Oh, isn’t that just perfect? Such a skill might even be able to surpass the mental defences of most people. It will be of great help in the future... in various scenarios," Vritra mumbled and finally focused on the Divine Sin Wheel.
He spent a portion of Sin Points and bought lots of Sin Keys.
{Sin Keys Available: 100}
{Sin Point: 2,892,293}
One million points were gone just like that. Vritra felt a bit of heartache as those hard earned points disappeared—but it was fine as long as he could get a couple of skills or something.
"So, my lovely wifey—" after buying the keys, Vritra spoke but was interrupted by the exasperated lady.
"Ha! I’m not going to choke you again. I don’t want to hurt you. It makes me feel bad," she said directly.
"I wasn’t going to say that. I was just going to ask you to stay close to me. It seems you bring me good luck." Vritra released a disappointed sigh as he spoke.

"That is fine then. Of course I will help you in whatever way I can." Yasmine pretended not to hear his disappointed sigh as she manifested into a small dragon form and coiled herself gently around him, resting her head over his shoulder.
"Then here goes nothing." Vritra tried to remain calm as he inserted all the keys at once into the golden wheel and watched as one after another message popped in front of him.
{Used 100 Sin Keys. Sin Keys left: 0}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
"Cough cough." Vritra coughed loudly and suddenly felt a little dizzy while also feeling a bit suffocated out of nowhere. All hundred draws had failed, and a million points were wasted over nothing.
"FUCK FUCK FUCK! What kind of joke is this? Shouldn’t I receive at least one skill?" Vritra cursed loudly as he stood up abruptly and almost threw Yasmine off his body.
The chair he had just used broke to pieces as he punched it hard, forming a small crater in the ground.

"We can’t go on like this. How am I supposed to increase my luck? Damnit, it’s so frustrating. O One million points... ughh You Wheel, I am going to" Vritra continued to curse for a few minutes. He felt so angry that he wanted to slaughter hundreds of thousands of demons again.
"Calm down, calm down. It’s fine. Just take a deep breath," Yasmine tried to calm him, but Vritra needed to vent his frustrations for at least twenty minutes before he felt a bit calm.

"Sigh... this is so unfair. Let’s enter the keys one by one this time and move to a better location. This place has no luck at all." Vritra activated the Fourth Dimension again as he disappeared and flew into the air.
He moved to the center of the market where a lot of people were gathered. He sat cross legged in the air and placed his hands over his knees as if he was about to fall into deep concentration.
Then he bought the Sin Keys again.
{Sin Keys Available: 100}
{Sin Point: 1,892,301}
"Ughh... another million gone. Sigh... oh great golden wheel, please give me something good this time," Vritra said. If he experienced that again, he might really end up coughing blood the next time.
He pushed the first key.
{Used 1 Sin Keys. Sin Keys left: 99}
{Better luck next time.}
Then again...
{Better luck next time.}
Hooo... it’s fine.
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{You have acquired the Active Skill: Forbidden.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}

By now, Vritra was like a robot. He just kept throwing one key after another, not even looking at the results after more than fifty keys had failed. His mind had gone blank, and his emotions seemed to have all faded. All his body knew how to do was push keys into the golden wheel.
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{You have acquired the Innate Skill Upgrade Stone.}
{Better luck next time.}
As the keys ended, Vritra’s almost dead soul didn’t stop. His absent mind bought another 100 Sin Keys, and then he continued to push key after key into the golden wheel.
His eyes were already hollow, and it seemed as if life had been sucked out of his body by the continuous failure and loss.
{Sin Keys Available: 100}
{Sin Point: 892,309}
In his disappearing state in the sky, he continued with his dead action.
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{You have acquired the Active Skill: Blood Lock.}

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Forbidden
paragraphs: {You have acquired the Active Skill: Blood Lock.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
Vritra pushed one key after another, he was not even seeing the notifications, a feeling of complete defeat overtook his mind, he felt that he wouldn’t be able to obtain the Divine Sin Arrow anymore.
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{You have acquired The Third Eye: Nether Eye.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
Soon all three hundreds keys were spent, but Vritra was still in a daze he was once again about to buy more keys with his remaining points but Yasmine called out to him in time.
"Hubby, are you alright?"
Vritra blinked and finally came to his senses, he only remembered seeing dozens of failure messages before he became dazed, he was surprised to see that less than a million points were left now.
"I used three hundred keys and still got nothing?" Vritra was about to lose all the strength in his body and fell down to the ground when Yasmine reminded him again.
"You were in kind of a trance earlier, look again I am sure you should have gotten at least one good thing even if the chances were so low."

Vritra nodded and with his heart bleeding he looked over the three hundred messages, there were so many {Better luck next time.} that he felt terrible but soon he noticed that several lines were longer than the other.
"I got f- four things?!!" Vritra was pleasantly surprised, as he called their names out loud:
"Forbidden, Blood Lock, an skill upgrade stone andNether Eye?"

All the sadness instantly vanished, yes it is true that a lot of sin points were wasted and he still found it hurting but since the luck couldn’t be increased by allocation points so he couldn’t do anything about it for now.
Still getting four things of the level of shift and fourth dimension was more than worth it, he had worked hard for just one day and obtained these godly rewards, what was there to regret.
Throwing these useless thoughts away he focussed on his rewards and read their description carefully.
[Forbidden]
(Skill Description): A forbidden law shall remain non existent. It allows you to seal a single core concept or attribute from a target, rendering it null and unusable.

The chosen concept may be physical, mental or abstract. Once sealed, the target suffers complete loss of that function until the effect ends or is broken, effects and duration are based on your intelligent intelligence stat.
Vritra red the description and his eyes widened in surprise, it was quite well detailed this time around.
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +1}

"Whoa, what a cheat. So you can just seal any concept or attribute of the opponent at will? So as long as you can hold on, you can seal off his strength, agility, thoughts, regeneration or even something like mana to a great extent, sigh."
Yasmine shook her head as she read the description along with him, she wondered how much of a monster was her hubby planning to be.

Vritra nodded, he understood the same thing, but this skill went even deeper. Won’t he able to seal things as fear, sanity self awareness or stamina, physical strength or sight, hearing, pain or the abilities of the opponent or even natural restriction such as sealing the space around him or even gravity.
He instantly decided to give it a try, he looked around in the market and soon his eyes fell onto a beggar who was begging while pretending to be blind.
Vritra was still in his disappearing state, from dozens of meters away he locked onto the middle aged beggar and muttered.
"Forbid: Sight!!"
[Forbidden activated.]
"Please give me s- some money, my children hadn’t eaten anything in days. How can I work when the god sent me here with sob such a defect, please help this poor old blind beggar."

While the beggar was pleading, looking very miserable many people helped him by giving him coins. The beggar secretly glanced at his stash of coins and notes and felt delighted, it seemed tonight he would be able to drink wine and gamble again, where could he find such fools.

But suddenly, darkness appeared in front of his eyes, startling the beggar. For a few seconds he remained frozen then he rubbed his eyes but that didn’t do anything, he looked around in fright but it seemed he had really gone blind.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
"H- HELP MEEEE!! I HAVE GONE BLIND, S- SOMEONE PLEASE HELP ME I CAN’T SEE ANYTHING ANYMORE, WHAT’S HAPPENING?" He screamed in horror.
But the people just sighed seeing the poor beggar, while some felt annoyed since they already gave some money to him earlier, they felt this shameless beggar wanted more.
"What are you yapping about? Weren’t you already blind?" a man spoke.
"No, I was just pretending!!" beggar replied hastily.
"Forbid: Gravity!!"
[Forbidden activated.]

In the next moment, the beggar’s sight returned but his body began to float in the air as he screamed in terror and flailed his arms and legs around, all the people around him were also surprised as they moved away.
"G- Ghost, he is possessed by a ghost. Call the shamans, w- wait, is that Baldy a monk? Get here and throw your holy water on the ghost."
A Baldy in the distance who was busy stuffing food in his mouth was dragged towards the beggar forcefully, while his bull ignored the pleading screams of his owner.
The concept of gravity hadn’t been completely reduced to zero but it was reduced to almost zero.
"Forbid: life."
It didn’t work, so this skill couldn’t be used to directly kill the opponent. But he could still use this skill to kill the opponent in countless ways.

Vritra ended his experiment, he was delighted. He could do much more than this with such a deadly and disastrous skill, though he could only seal one concept or attribute at a time and only on one person but it was still a great skill.
"And I don’t even need use the mana, it only exhaust my mental strength." Vritra mumbled to himself feeling quite joyful with one other.
Then his expectant gaze moved to the next thing.
[Innate Skill Upgrade Stone]
(Description): A stone which could instantly increase the level/grade of your innate skill.

Vritra read the single line, this stone could only be used with the skill Dust Manipulation. He decided to think about this stone later, it was a obviously an awesome item too, but he needed to put some thought into whether to use it now or not.

So he directly moved onto the next part, his smile widening in anticipation. Even Yasmine’s expectations had increased greatly by now, this divine sin wheel was just too unreal, each reward it provided was just too terrific each successful draw increased Vritra’s strength greatly.
"Let’s see what’s next." Vritra rubbed his palms together and read the description of the next skill.
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "..."
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}

"I- Isn’t that a bit too scary? What the hell are these skills? Hubby, just don’t be too hard on your enemies in the future, sigh those pitiful creatures." Yasmine spoke in shock, giving him one sin point after another.

sentences.text: {You have acquired the Active Skill: Blood Lock.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
Vritra pushed one key after another, he was not even seeing the notifications, a feeling of complete defeat overtook his mind, he felt that he wouldn’t be able to obtain the Divine Sin Arrow anymore.
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{You have acquired The Third Eye: Nether Eye.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
Soon all three hundreds keys were spent, but Vritra was still in a daze he was once again about to buy more keys with his remaining points but Yasmine called out to him in time.
"Hubby, are you alright?"
Vritra blinked and finally came to his senses, he only remembered seeing dozens of failure messages before he became dazed, he was surprised to see that less than a million points were left now.
"I used three hundred keys and still got nothing?" Vritra was about to lose all the strength in his body and fell down to the ground when Yasmine reminded him again.
"You were in kind of a trance earlier, look again I am sure you should have gotten at least one good thing even if the chances were so low."

Vritra nodded and with his heart bleeding he looked over the three hundred messages, there were so many {Better luck next time.} that he felt terrible but soon he noticed that several lines were longer than the other.
"I got f- four things?!!" Vritra was pleasantly surprised, as he called their names out loud:
"Forbidden, Blood Lock, an skill upgrade stone andNether Eye?"

All the sadness instantly vanished, yes it is true that a lot of sin points were wasted and he still found it hurting but since the luck couldn’t be increased by allocation points so he couldn’t do anything about it for now.
Still getting four things of the level of shift and fourth dimension was more than worth it, he had worked hard for just one day and obtained these godly rewards, what was there to regret.
Throwing these useless thoughts away he focussed on his rewards and read their description carefully.
[Forbidden]
(Skill Description): A forbidden law shall remain non existent.
It allows you to seal a single core concept or attribute from a target, rendering it null and unusable.
The chosen concept may be physical, mental or abstract.
Once sealed, the target suffers complete loss of that function until the effect ends or is broken, effects and duration are based on your intelligent intelligence stat.
Vritra red the description and his eyes widened in surprise, it was quite well detailed this time around.
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +1}
"Whoa, what a cheat.
So you can just seal any concept or attribute of the opponent at will?
So as long as you can hold on, you can seal off his strength, agility, thoughts, regeneration or even something like mana to a great extent, sigh."
Yasmine shook her head as she read the description along with him, she wondered how much of a monster was her hubby planning to be.
Vritra nodded, he understood the same thing, but this skill went even deeper.

Won’t he able to seal things as fear, sanity self awareness or stamina, physical strength or sight, hearing, pain or the abilities of the opponent or even natural restriction such as sealing the space around him or even gravity.
He instantly decided to give it a try, he looked around in the market and soon his eyes fell onto a beggar who was begging while pretending to be blind.
Vritra was still in his disappearing state, from dozens of meters away he locked onto the middle aged beggar and muttered.
"Forbid: Sight!!"
[Forbidden activated.]
"Please give me s- some money, my children hadn’t eaten anything in days.
How can I work when the god sent me here with sob such a defect, please help this poor old blind beggar."
While the beggar was pleading, looking very miserable many people helped him by giving him coins.
The beggar secretly glanced at his stash of coins and notes and felt delighted, it seemed tonight he would be able to drink wine and gamble again, where could he find such fools.
But suddenly, darkness appeared in front of his eyes, startling the beggar.
For a few seconds he remained frozen then he rubbed his eyes but that didn’t do anything, he looked around in fright but it seemed he had really gone blind.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
"H- HELP MEEEE!!
I HAVE GONE BLIND, S- SOMEONE PLEASE HELP ME I CAN’T SEE ANYTHING ANYMORE, WHAT’S HAPPENING?" He screamed in horror.
But the people just sighed seeing the poor beggar, while some felt annoyed since they already gave some money to him earlier, they felt this shameless beggar wanted more.
"What are you yapping about?
Weren’t you already blind?" a man spoke.
"No, I was just pretending!!" beggar replied hastily.
"Forbid: Gravity!!"
[Forbidden activated.]

In the next moment, the beggar’s sight returned but his body began to float in the air as he screamed in terror and flailed his arms and legs around, all the people around him were also surprised as they moved away.
"G- Ghost, he is possessed by a ghost.
Call the shamans, w- wait, is that Baldy a monk?
Get here and throw your holy water on the ghost."
A Baldy in the distance who was busy stuffing food in his mouth was dragged towards the beggar forcefully, while his bull ignored the pleading screams of his owner.
The concept of gravity hadn’t been completely reduced to zero but it was reduced to almost zero.
"Forbid: life."
It didn’t work, so this skill couldn’t be used to directly kill the opponent.
But he could still use this skill to kill the opponent in countless ways.
Vritra ended his experiment, he was delighted.
He could do much more than this with such a deadly and disastrous skill, though he could only seal one concept or attribute at a time and only on one person but it was still a great skill.
"And I don’t even need use the mana, it only exhaust my mental strength." Vritra mumbled to himself feeling quite joyful with one other.
Then his expectant gaze moved to the next thing.
[Innate Skill Upgrade Stone]
(Description): A stone which could instantly increase the level/grade of your innate skill.
Vritra read the single line, this stone could only be used with the skill Dust Manipulation.
He decided to think about this stone later, it was a obviously an awesome item too, but he needed to put some thought into whether to use it now or not.
So he directly moved onto the next part, his smile widening in anticipation.

Even Yasmine’s expectations had increased greatly by now, this divine sin wheel was just too unreal, each reward it provided was just too terrific each successful draw increased Vritra’s strength greatly.
"Let’s see what’s next." Vritra rubbed his palms together and read the description of the next skill.
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "..."
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
"I- Isn’t that a bit too scary?
What the hell are these skills?
Hubby, just don’t be too hard on your enemies in the future, sigh those pitiful creatures." Yasmine spoke in shock, giving him one sin point after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Blood Lock
paragraphs: [Blood Lock]

(Skill Description): A Death Sentence. Once you draw or touch even the smallest amount of blood from your opponent, he would be marked by Blood Lock. From that moment onward, with each passing minute, 0.5% of his combat power would be reduced until the effect is broken or the opponent is dead.
Both Yasmine and Vritra were surprised by this skill. Even though drawing out a fight when facing someone stronger is difficult, still, there was no mention of distance or time limit.
If he could just run away after Blood Lock is activated, then wouldn’t the opponent just end up dying as long as he couldn’t break free from it?

Forbid plus Blood Lock plus Fourth Dimension— wasn’t that such a dangerous combination? Vritra chuckled, already imagining lots of ways to use these skills. He had gained more than he could have imagined.

"I want to try this out so bad but... forget it, I will try it later in the tomb. Three million points for these cute skills, they couldn’t have been spent any better." Vritra mumbled. In a fight, his opponent would constantly get weaker even if they were just standing there and talking.
"I wonder what is that Divine Sin exactly..." Yasmine wondered to herself.
Vritra was also quite curious about all that— like this wheel, the system windows everyone sees— whoever is the one controlling everything from behind.
But he didn’t think too much about it. What was the benefit of thinking about any of it when there was no way of finding any answers?
"Let’s see what we have got next." Vritra’s smile widened as he looked at the final reward— it was the Third Eye.
[Nether Eye]

(Description): Omnipresent. The eye that allows you to look at everything from a new perspective within a range of ten kilometres around you. In accordance with the Intelligence attribute, you could penetrate through the mental barriers of the opponent and deal mental damage.

"Oh, isn’t this just too perfect? It is great to avoid all kinds of ambushes, and I can always be in control of my surroundings with this. Not to mention, the damage to mind. Hmm... first Forbid and now this, these skills are more dependent on my Intelligence stat. Looks like I need to invest more in it." Vritra pondered. But that was all for later; first, he decided to give the skill a try.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Just as the skill activated, a third eye opened on his forehead. It was vertical and present in the centre of his forehead, though no pupil was visible... there was only darkness.
Vritra’s mind was instantly filled with the information of his surroundings. It was like a spherical boundary with a radius of 10 kilometres had formed around him.
He could clearly see anything within that range just by focusing— even insects that were several kilometres away, or the bugs crawling deep within the ground, birds flying high in the sky.
It was so clear as if he was watching it in the best resolution possible. The effect of the Third Eye was great.
Vritra closed the Nether Eye as it disappeared from his forehead. He did feel a slight headache after using it for a couple of minutes, but without a doubt, he would get used to it soon.

"All three things are extremely good, thousands of times better than my expectations. They will certainly be of great help in my next adventure." Vritra mumbled. Finally, he focused on the glistening white stone that appeared in his palm with just a thought.

"The only skill this stone can be used on is Dust Manipulation, which is currently at level 5 and rank B. It had evolved not too long ago, and even if I continue to use it all the time, I can feel that it would take several months or even more than a year to evolve to the next grade." Vritra spoke to himself.

Without a doubt, using this stone would give him more benefit once it had levelled up to rank 6. Then he could instantly upgrade it—but he would have to wait a long time for such a thing, and he needed to increase his strength as soon as possible for the Divine Tomb.
After several moments of pondering, Vritra finally made his decision.
"Upgrade Dust Manipulation to the next grade."
[Innate Skill Upgrade Stone used on Dust Manipulation.]
[Dust Manipulation is evolving to Rank A.]
[Evolution of the body has started...]

Just as he commanded, the stone glowed with a bright colour and then it was absorbed into his body. A strange but soothing energy flowed inside his body and gathered in his chest area. Vritra closed his eyes as he allowed the changes to occur in his body.

Dust began to swirl around him. This time the changes seemed to be several times more monumental than before—even his body seemed to be undergoing some sort of transformation—as more and more dust was absorbed into his body.
A strong storm began to rise in the capital around Vritra, making all the people confused by the strange occurrence.
Several minutes passed. Vritra had started to feel a headache since he was still in the Fourth Dimension and needed to leave soon, but he just focused on the evolution for now.
After more than twenty minutes had passed, the changes had finally completed, and his surroundings began to return to normal—even his body had returned to its peak state.
Several more messages popped in front of him.
[Evolution complete.]
[Dust Manipulation has levelled up to level 6.]
[Elemental Transmutation has transformed into Body of Dust.]

Vritra looked around, then at his own body. The capital had gone through a short but heavy storm, and everything was covered in dust. His own body looked a bit dirty—though with just a thought, all the dust disappeared from his body.
He had a feeling that he had become even closer with the dust. Without much thought, he directly opened the skill description, only focusing on the new part.
[Body of Dust]
(Description): Becoming one with the dust, getting closer to the path of the Dust Lord. Your control over the dust has increased.
"Hmm... Not much info is given there, but I have a feeling I can do this." Vritra raised his right hand slightly and stared at his palm while concentrating, as he used Dust Manipulation.
In the next moment, his hand turned into dust, which then crumbled and the dust swirled in the air. There was no blood or any pain—Vritra was surprised, even though he had expected this.
{Sin Point Gained: Intrigued +1}

"So your body can transform into dust now? It is already so terrifying at rank A. It even increases your defences to a great level, not to mention all kinds of other ways it could be used in." Yasmine exclaimed. She kept getting shocked again and again.
His hand returned to normal in the next second with a thought. Now he was completely prepared for his adventure.
He needed some practice to be able to perfectly integrate all his skills together in a battle—otherwise, even such great skills won’t bring victory to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Protective
paragraphs: Some distance away from the castle, in a dense side of the forest.

Several dozens of guards circled around the large area; they had captured quite a few demons who were bound by chains and other restrictions. The guards lazily observed the situation, ready to take action if the need arose.

A little over thirty teenagers were gathered in the forest as they fought against these demons. Although they could still get slightly injured, their lives weren’t in danger, and all of them had already gotten used to killing these strange creatures.
Raino was the only one who was having difficulty killing the demons. He could barely run, and despite the healing potions he drank, his ass was still badly wounded because of his strange fetishes.

Some distance away from him, Fiona was fighting against an orc absentmindedly. She had noticed that since yesterday, Max had been acting very strange. He seemed rather cold and uninterested in her all of a sudden.

’Is he somehow angry at me? I’m sure he doesn’t know about that incident between me and that... that devil, so what could it be?’ While she was deep in thought, she kept shooting fire at the orc who kept closing in on her.

Max was fighting not far away from her. He too was fighting an orc. While dealing with the demon, he kept an eye on Fiona. He had been acting like a perfect red flag and not paying much attention to her, and the results were immediate.
It seemed she was now showing more interest in him, even now she kept glancing back at him.

’If I continue like this, I’m sure very soon she would be the one to confess to me,’ Max thought, feeling giddy. Although he didn’t feel too good about ignoring her, if this was what she wanted, then he would do anything.

Just while he was deep in thought, Max saw that because of her carelessness Fiona was about to be attacked by the orc’s heavy hammer. This wouldn’t kill her, but it would definitely injure her severely.
"Be careful—" Max shouted as his eyes widened. He couldn’t pretend in such a situation as he rushed toward her, to protect her and kill the damn demon who dared to try to hurt her.

Fiona noticed it too, her eyes widened as she saw the hammer that had already appeared right above her head. It was too late for her to dodge or block; she was frightened and let out a fearful cry and shut her eyes.
"Kiyaaaaaaah!!"
WHOOSH
THUD
Suddenly she was pulled away from the orc and landed in a comforting, tight embrace while the scream of the orc came to an end as his head was severed, which fell down and rolled on the ground.
At first, Fiona couldn’t understand anything. She wondered if she had gotten hurt, but then she felt the arms tightly wrapped around her body, and she was instantly filled with joy.

’Max saved me!! As I thought, he really loves me. He must have been angry at me earlier for something. Mmm it feels so good to be in his arms.’ Fiona felt as if her body was about to melt in his arms, feeling his strong muscles and the warmth of his body.
She slowly opened her eyes and mumbled: "T- Thank you, are you alright?"

Then she raised her eyes with a soft smile on her face, which froze instantly as instead of Max’s face, she saw the face she hated the most. It was none other than Vritra, for a few seconds she stared at his face in a daze.

She was just pulled out of danger and landed in his protective arms, her mind became a mess as she struggled to tear her gaze away from his face, her heart beating wildly. She was too vulnerable just now.

"Yes Fiona, I am perfectly fine. But it isn’t the time for you to be worrying about me. Are you fine?" He caressed the cheek of the frozen girl gently, then added in a softer tone, "Stop putting yourself in such dangers. If I hadn’t arrived here just now, do you know how badly you would have been hurt? I can’t let that happen. Never."
Fiona ignored his words. As she came back to her senses, the first thing she remembered was... Max.

She looked to the side and saw Max standing there with an emotionless face. Her mind instantly became a mess. She wondered why she kept ending up in such situations; wouldn’t Max get even madder if he saw this again and again?
She hastily pushed him away and got out of his arms. She stood on her feet and spoke to Max: "T- This wasn’t..."

"It’s fine. You didn’t get injured, right? Then you can return to your training," Max said coldly, going back to his character as he glared at Vritra. He hated Vritra touching his girl but couldn’t show too much worry about her.
"And you, stay away from her," Max shouted toward Vritra.
[Natural Hypnosis Activated.]

Vritra used his new skill, making Max even more firm in his beliefs, while Fiona began to doubt Max now. This skill didn’t control them but induced ideas in their heads and then made their beliefs firmer.

’Hmph. The more care you show for her, the further she will go away from you. Only by acting cold and indifferent will she fall in love,’ Max thought, laughing internally. He knew the more care Vritra showed, the more she would ignore him.

"..." Fiona was speechless. She first stared at the indifferent Max and then glanced at the dead orc. As she had believed, Vritra was stronger than he showed; even she wouldn’t be able to kill that demon with a single strike.
’But what is wrong with Max? He was never like this... does he really not care for me anymore?’ she wondered, feeling pain in her heart. A part of her had started to hate and resent Max.
"And what if I don’t? What are you gonna do even if I touch or hug her?" Vritra said, wrapping an arm around Fiona, who was shocked by this strange development.
Max was so angry that he instantly wanted to kill Vritra. He charged forward, ready to strike him with all his strength. He still couldn’t tolerate Vritra touching Fiona.

Several guards had charged forward earlier to save Fiona, but Vritra had done the job before them. Seeing the current situation, they could no longer just observe. They made their move and held back the angry Max, neutralizing his attack.

"Let go of me, I am going to kill that bastard!" Max roared. Vritra just stood calmly with his arm still around Fiona’s waist, who finally came to her senses and moved away from him, shooting him an angry glare.
"You two can’t fight like this, not here," one of the guards said lazily.
"Heh. Don’t tell me you want to challenge me to a fight? Or are you coward enough to just walk away?" Vritra taunted, puttingNatural Hypnosisto full use.
"Hahaha. Let’s fight! An official fight between the two of us. Since it can’t be a death match, then whoever loses the fight will lose an arm!" Max shouted, influenced easily by his anger.

She first stared at the indifferent Max and then glanced at the dead orc.
As she had believed, Vritra was stronger than he showed; even she wouldn’t be able to kill that demon with a single strike.
’But what is wrong with Max?
He was never like this... does he really not care for me anymore?’ she wondered, feeling pain in her heart.
A part of her had started to hate and resent Max.
"And what if I don’t?
What are you gonna do even if I touch or hug her?" Vritra said, wrapping an arm around Fiona, who was shocked by this strange development.
Max was so angry that he instantly wanted to kill Vritra.
He charged forward, ready to strike him with all his strength.
He still couldn’t tolerate Vritra touching Fiona.
Several guards had charged forward earlier to save Fiona, but Vritra had done the job before them.
Seeing the current situation, they could no longer just observe.
They made their move and held back the angry Max, neutralizing his attack.
"Let go of me, I am going to kill that bastard!" Max roared.
Vritra just stood calmly with his arm still around Fiona’s waist, who finally came to her senses and moved away from him, shooting him an angry glare.
"You two can’t fight like this, not here," one of the guards said lazily.
"Heh.
Don’t tell me you want to challenge me to a fight?
Or are you coward enough to just walk away?" Vritra taunted, puttingNatural Hypnosisto full use.
"Hahaha.
Let’s fight!
An official fight between the two of us.
Since it can’t be a death match, then whoever loses the fight will lose an arm!" Max shouted, influenced easily by his anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: A special Game
paragraphs: Vritra’s smile widened. It was so easy to manipulate the idiots. The situation had played out just as he wanted. He glanced back at Fiona, who looked a bit frightened. She knew how clever and strong Vritra was, and she understood a bit that Max had just fallen into his trap.

Seeing his devil-like smile, she was even more sure of her thoughts. She walked towards him, wanting to sway Max not to fight against Vritra. She didn’t want the person she loved to be beaten like shit in front of everyone and then even lose his arm.
"Max, you shouldn’t fight him, he is—" she spoke, but Max instead got mad over her concerns and interrupted her.

"Why? Are you worried about him? Since he is your prince charming, saving the princess from danger every time?" he asked. He hated the memory where he saw her in Vritra’s arms. Poor Max didn’t know what was about to come.
"N- No, that wasn’t what I meant. I am just worried about you," Fiona said. She felt bad from his piercing words.

"OH, so you believe I am weaker than this bastard? Is that why you are always landing in his arms?" Max spoke, getting even angrier. He now understood that she felt Vritra is an even bigger bad boy than him, so she might be getting interested in him now.
"I... I didn’t mean that..." Fiona was at a loss for words. She wanted to persuade him not to fight, but Max just wouldn’t listen to her. Why had he changed so much?

"If you two want to fight, you can do so in the training area of the castle. If you don’t want to, then say so right now and not waste our time," a guard said. He had seen guys like that many times who would chicken out later on.

"Let’s go. We are betting our right arms in this fight," Max said with a menacing grin as he glared at Vritra, then looked at Fiona before turning around and walking away along with the guards, towards the castle.
"..." Vritra planned to break Max. He wanted Max to suffer knowing the girl he loved so much was being intimate with someone else. But first, he needed to change Fiona.
He too began to follow behind the guards, but Fiona pulled his arm and looked at him angrily.
"Just what are you planning on doing?"
"What do you mean? I am going to fight Max and beat him so badly, then he would be alive but also be dead more than the dead itself." Vritra smiled and shrugged his shoulder.
"You— Stop that challenge right now! I know you are very strong... just don’t hurt Max," Fiona said, gritting her teeth.
"Why shouldn’t I? Just watch and enjoy the show as I break him apart like a broken puppet." Vritra said, his smile looking increasingly devilish.
"..." Fiona felt so frustrated, angry, and helpless. She knew she couldn’t threaten Vritra to stop, so she did what she could do for now... she pleaded.
"P- Please don’t hurt him. I know he has been quite disrespectful towards you after arriving in this universe, but p- please, for my sake."
"... Huh? What relation do we have that I end the challenge? If you want to, then at least offer something of importance." Vritra said, pulling his arm away from her grip.
She gritted her teeth and asked in a low voice: "What is it exactly that you want?"
"Hmm. If you promise to play a special game with me, then I will bring the match to a draw." Vritra said, his smile softening.
"What kind of game exactly?" she asked, now feeling a bit nervous.

"Nothing much, a simple, small, and ecchi game. Of course, we will play only if you want. I don’t want to force you into playing it or anything, so choose." Vritra said, standing there and waiting patiently.
"..." At first, Fiona instantly wanted to reject him, but this rejection meant Max would be beaten like a dog. She found it hard to make a decision.
"Hah. I guess you don’t love Max as much as I thought. Well, I understand—it’s not like he loves you or anything." Vritra sighed and got ready to leave.
"No wait, I do love him a lot and he... he loves me too, I believe." Fiona said, though she no longer was 100% sure now. Then she added: "Fine, I will do whatever you want, just don’t hurt him."
Vritra smiled and nodded: "Good. Make sure you follow through on your promise."

Then he walked away. Fiona stood there for a while. She felt guilt and shame crawling inside her. She knew what making that promise meant—she would be willingly betraying Max, but to save him, she had no choice but to do this.
"Sigh, I am sorry, Max. But why did you have to challenge Vritra? No matter what happens in that game, I will still love you." Fiona mumbled, as she too followed behind Vritra.

Soon everyone arrived in the training area. Along the way, more guards joined the group as they prepared for the fight. By the time Vritra and Max stood opposite each other, nearly a hundred guards had gathered.
Vritra was naturally receiving sin points, but they wouldn’t give him too many points, so he didn’t try that hard.
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +121}
Fiona stood there nervously, and soon the fight began.
"Get ready, I am going to beat you up so bad, you janitor." Max shouted as he charged forward as electricity buzzed around his body.
{Sin Point Gained: Provoked +1}
The fight was going to be ten minutes long. If no one is defeated in that time, then the result would be a draw.
Max threw one punch after another, sending strong bolts of lightning coursing through the air directly hitting Vritra’s body, but none of it had even the slightest effect on him.
"Is that all you have got? Tsk. How pitiful, so weak..." Vritra shook his head, as he didn’t even make a move to dodge and allowed the electric bolts to hit him as if he was just fighting a kid.
Ten minutes passed, and Max was sweating heavily and panting like a dead-tired dog. He wasn’t able to inflict even a tiny wound on Vritra’s body, but since the time had ended, the match was over.
"It is a draw. Now everyone, get back to your work." The guard in charge of the battle said. The match was far from interesting. It was obvious Vritra had completely bullied and humiliated Max.
"Good job. I didn’t know you were so strong. Keep working hard, electro boy." Vritra chuckled as he patted Max’s shoulder and walked away.
He stopped beside Fiona and said: "Be ready. I will tell you when we are going to play the game."
Then he left.
Fiona worriedly stepped forward and asked: "Max, are you fine?"
"..." Max was feeling so angry. He had become a joker in everyone’s eyes—especially Fiona. He glanced at her and saw a bite mark on her neck.
’What is that? I- is that a kiss mark? No way... yeah, it must be a mosquito bite or something.’ Max shook his head and walked away. He didn’t want to face her right now.
’How pitiful do I look in her eyes?’

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Instincts
paragraphs: After the fight, Vritra returned to the castle. He didn’t have much to prepare for the adventure he would be going on the next day, so he decided to spend this time with his mother.

But before returning to his room, he decided to pay Diana a visit. Since he would be going on a very dangerous adventure the next day, even with his skills, he needed to leave behind some kind of safety.
The morning prayer had already ended. There were very few people still praying, while the priest, janitors, and others were busy with their work.
They looked and saw Vritra walking by. No one stopped him since they had already been informed by the goddess not to speak to him, not to obstruct him, and not to offend him.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +35}
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +34}
{Sin Point Gained: Seduced +9}
Vritra ignored the envious gazes of the men and the strange look from the women as he made his way up the stairs and toward Diana’s room.
The goddess seemed to be reading some sort of documents.
Using the fourth dimension, Vritra disappeared and appeared again right beside her. He leaned forward and whispered close to her ear.
"Hello, Diana."
{Sin Point Gained: Startled +1}
Diana’s body jolted as the documents fell from her hands. She was ready to attack, but seeing that it was Vritra, she could only get angry internally, as she took several calming breaths.
"C-Can’t you just enter through the door? And what kind of strange ability is that?"
Diana asked, not hoping to get any answer. Vritra certainly only possessed just one dust-related ability before. He must have found some kind of treasure to grow so strong so rapidly.
"Has there been any kind of important news or report you have received?" Vritra asked as he walked away from her and sat on the bed. He wondered if Diana had somehow heard about the Divine Sin Tomb.
"Sigh... well, nothing much. I was just reading the replies I have got from the Blue Kingdom.
I had informed them that we will be arriving there in advance as you had instructed me to." Diana collected the papers before setting them on the table.
"And what is their reply?" Vritra asked, not in a hurry to get to the main point.
"We can leave any time after a week, and it takes almost two weeks to arrive there even through the fastest travel," Diana said, as she walked toward Vritra.
Vritra nodded and wondered, "Two weeks huh... isn’t there anything like teleportation po— Huh? Wait, what are you doing?"
{Sin Point Gained: Craved +1}
The goddess naturally walked towards Vritra and knelt in front of him. Then her hands just as gracefully moved to free his member out of his clothes, but when he asked, her mind and hands froze.
’What am I doing?’ Diana’s face turned bright red. It was like her body had reacted based on instincts. Before she knew it, she was about to have another treat of that sweet, thick milk.
"Cough... weren’t you here for that?" Diana said, tilting her head down in shame. Even if he was here for that, how could she just take the initiative?
Even though that white thing tastes good—ughh what am I saying? Still, even so, why did my body just crave that? Yes, it must be this Greatest Demon Emperor’s fault.
"Of course I wasn’t here for that. Did you forget you got two free days? But if you really want it, then I won’t deny it." Vritra said, smiling towards the goddess.

Diana stood up hastily as she acted proud and arrogant. She turned her red face away and spoke in a tsundere tone: "Hmph. Why would I want that? It is because you keep making me do those weird things."
{Sin Point Gained: Resented +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Charmed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Corrupted +1}
The goddess glanced back and felt that it was a pity that she didn’t get to do it— she shook her head instantly and threw that thought away. Something was definitely wrong with her brain.
"Answer my question." Vritra said. He had given her two days of freedom, so he didn’t say anything.
Only by stick and candy method could she be controlled. The only important thing was that the stick wasn’t a normal stick here, but a very very special one...
"What question... oh, that. There are no teleportations here in this kingdom; there is no one capable enough to create one here."
Diana turned her head toward him and answered simply. It wasn’t the smallest kingdom, but it was even below average when compared with many others.
"Anyway, I will be going out for... hmm, a couple of days or maybe more. During this time, make sure to take the best care of my mother." Vritra said, as he stretched his arms and then stood up.
"Oh, where are you going? And of course, I will do my best." Diana nodded, staring at his face. For some reason, he seemed even more handsome and tempting than yesterday.
"You don’t need to know that. Just be safe and protect my mother." After speaking, he disappeared, leaving behind a confused and curious goddess.
’He is so mysterious, but I am sure when he returns, he might become even more of a monster... sigh, what have I gotten myself into? At least those sweet treats are nice—ughh I am going mad.’

Vritra then returned to his room. Vanessa wasn’t in the room. She must have gone out to prepare lunch for the two of them. She loved to make food for Vritra, so she used the kitchen herself and made food.
Of course, she wasn’t adding that special ingredient to the food now. After all, Vritra had direct access to it now.
Vritra sat on the bed and began to imagine all kinds of scenarios—not just for the big event the next day but even for their escape from this kingdom.
He planned to send Vanessa away to the Blue Kingdom along with Diana first. Then he could create a bit of chaos before making his own escape.

Then they would reunite in the Blue Kingdom. Just leaving this kingdom wasn’t an option. He had to think of ways to throw off the Nine Pacts, otherwise they might end up grabbing unnecessary attention.
While Vritra was deep in thought, the door to his room opened and Vanessa walked in carrying a tray with several plates on it. A sweet scent instantly filled the room, grabbing his attention.
His gaze drifted toward his mother. This sweet and intoxicating smell didn’t belong to the food— it was Vanessa’s natural scent.
She wore a loose and modest blue dress, but Vritra’s eyes were locked onto his mother as he stared at her in surprise for several minutes.
{Sin Point Gained: Seduced +1}
He had not seen her for just a few hours, but it seemed she had become several times more beautiful.
Her voluptuous body looked even more ripe. Maybe it was the changes brought by the formation of their bond, but she looked absolutely gorgeous and terrifyingly hot.
"What’s wrong, honey?" Vanessa smiled sweetly as she put away the tray of food on the table and walked toward him.
"Mom, you look very beautiful." Vritra mumbled. Even a thousand words wouldn’t be enough to properly define her charms.
"How sweet, thank you." Vanessa leaned toward him and pressed her moist lips against his cheek, giving him a kiss.
"Let’s eat." She said, pulling Vritra’s arm.
Something in the way she looked at him had changed. Vritra himself found it difficult not to pounce on this beautiful lady.
"So mom, now that you have obtained that crest, you can use all your bloodline and physique-related abilities?" Vritra asked, as the two sat on opposite sides of the small dining table.
"Yes, I can. But there is something I wanted to share with you." Vanessa spoke, a slightly shy look appearing on her beautiful face.
"Well, I also have something to tell you." Vritra said, as they began to eat.
"Then you go first." Vanessa said, as she brought a spoonful of rice to her mouth.
"Okay, so I am going to leave again for some time. It won’t be as long as the last time. I will be back in two or three days, most probably.
And I am going on a special adventure tomorrow morning, but it isn’t too dangerous." Vritra lied.
She would protest strongly against this trip if she were to know how dangerous it truly was.
"Ah, is that so?" Vanessa’s mood instantly dimmed visibly. She felt very sad at the fact that she would have to be away from him again.
It seemed that hollow feeling had increased even more now. She was already feeling very sad.
"Just be careful outside, and return to me as soon as possible." Vanessa said after a few seconds. She had even lost her appetite all of a sudden.
"What did you want to tell me?" Vritra asked, trying to change the topic. He didn’t want to see her sad, but going there was important, and he couldn’t bring her along.

"Oh that... because of this crest that I obtained after bonding with you, the speed of skills leveling up will increase greatly for both of us, but..." Vanessa paused as the redness returned to her cheeks.
"But what?" Vritra asked as he shifted forward slightly. He already had the answer in his head.
"This crest intensifies certain emotions like lus— cough— of ours toward one another until uhm we..." Vanessa began to speak, as Vritra listened to her with full concentration.
{Sin Point Gained: Tempted +1}

"What’s wrong, honey?" Vanessa smiled sweetly as she put away the tray of food on the table and walked toward him.
"Mom, you look very beautiful." Vritra mumbled.
Even a thousand words wouldn’t be enough to properly define her charms.
"How sweet, thank you." Vanessa leaned toward him and pressed her moist lips against his cheek, giving him a kiss.
"Let’s eat." She said, pulling Vritra’s arm.
Something in the way she looked at him had changed.
Vritra himself found it difficult not to pounce on this beautiful lady.
"So mom, now that you have obtained that crest, you can use all your bloodline and physique-related abilities?" Vritra asked, as the two sat on opposite sides of the small dining table.
"Yes, I can.
But there is something I wanted to share with you." Vanessa spoke, a slightly shy look appearing on her beautiful face.
"Well, I also have something to tell you." Vritra said, as they began to eat.
"Then you go first." Vanessa said, as she brought a spoonful of rice to her mouth.
"Okay, so I am going to leave again for some time.
It won’t be as long as the last time.
I will be back in two or three days, most probably.
And I am going on a special adventure tomorrow morning, but it isn’t too dangerous." Vritra lied.
She would protest strongly against this trip if she were to know how dangerous it truly was.
"Ah, is that so?" Vanessa’s mood instantly dimmed visibly.
She felt very sad at the fact that she would have to be away from him again.
It seemed that hollow feeling had increased even more now.
She was already feeling very sad.
"Just be careful outside, and return to me as soon as possible." Vanessa said after a few seconds.
She had even lost her appetite all of a sudden.
"What did you want to tell me?" Vritra asked, trying to change the topic.
He didn’t want to see her sad, but going there was important, and he couldn’t bring her along.

"Oh that... because of this crest that I obtained after bonding with you, the speed of skills leveling up will increase greatly for both of us, but..." Vanessa paused as the redness returned to her cheeks.
"But what?" Vritra asked as he shifted forward slightly.
He already had the answer in his head.
"This crest intensifies certain emotions like lus— cough— of ours toward one another until uhm we..." Vanessa began to speak, as Vritra listened to her with full concentration.
{Sin Point Gained: Tempted +1}

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Clean off
paragraphs: "This crest intensifies certain emotions like lus— cough— of ours toward one another until we are craving each other madly, and the only way to keep everything normal is by exchanging our body essences." Vanessa spoke with her head tilted downward and getting embarrassed. She kept glancing up at him to see his reaction.

"That’s wonderful— cough— I mean what a strange ability you have but it does make sense, mom." Vritra corrected himself in time. He reacted too strongly. He really felt that he was just looking for some excuse to get even more intimate with his mother.

"I guess after I return, we can try to level up together in that manner... sigh now that we are on this path, we don’t have any choice but to go all the way." Vritra said, shaking his head while feeling excited internally.
"Yeah, we don’t have any other choice." Vanessa smiled seductively, it was as if both the mother and son wanted to keep up the pretence, even though their desires were obvious.

While chatting casually, the two began to eat. At one point Vritra saw something sticking to Vanessa’s upper lip, he picked up a cloth from the side and spoke: "Mom, you got something on your lips, let me clean it for you."

Vanessa swallowed the food and looked at him then she simply tilted her chin upwards, giving him easier access to her lips. Vritra stared at those juicy pink lips that looked far more tastier than anything and tempted him to take a bite off them.
{Sin Point Gained: Seduced +1}
Even the simplest moves Vanessa made were more than enough to seduce anyone, as the succubus queen, her charms were simply off the chart already.

He brought the white cloth close to her face but before it could clean the wet spot, his lips landed on hers first as he took her upper lip in his mouth and licked it with his tongue, cleaning it properly.

Vritra was surprised by his own action as he pulled back stretching her lip a bit before it was released with a soft sound, acting like that was the most natural action, he said with a smile: "There, all clean."
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
Vanessa remained silent for a few seconds then a smile blossomed on her beautiful face, looking even more gorgeous as she said:
"Thank you, honey."
Soon the mood relaxed and the two began to eat happily, Vritra knew that after he leaves danger might lurk around her; that was he was leaving his dear mother/wife in the most secure hands.
He had already grabbed the king’s and nine pacts’ attention, they might not think too highly of him for now but that doesn’t mean they won’t try to eliminate him or try to get some info out of him.
Vritra was more than eighty percent sure that someone is going to come knocking on their doors sooner or later, but he still has to leave for the tomb and bringing her along wasn’t an option as well.
Still he was sure no one would be able to harm her even a tiny bit.

Vanessa and Vritra spent the rest of the day together, their relation had become much more intimate already and the awkwardness was slowly disappearing, though it would still take a little more time to fully accept their new relation.
The night passed as the two slept peacefully in each other’s arms, their embrace was full of love and warmth.
Vritra woke up early in the morning. After taking a bath, he was going to leave right away, but Vanessa first made him eat breakfast along with her.
Finally, he was ready to leave. As Vritra stood outside the door, his mother looked a little upset. She wanted to stay with him so badly but also didn’t want to hold him back.

"Don’t worry, Mom. I will be back in just a couple of days. Also, don’t trust anyone other than Diana, and try not to leave the temple— or just don’t go too far away from here," Vritra said. Despite his arrangements, how could he still not worry about her?
"It is like I am the one going on a dangerous trip. Don’t worry about me and just return safely. I hate not being with you, so don’t take too long," Vanessa spoke with a pout, making him smile.
Then she smiled and moved closer to him, before giving a short kiss on his lips, pressing her lips against his for a few moments before pulling back.
"Come as soon as you can," Vanessa said, trying not to show her sadness.
"Yes, Mom, I will be right back," Vritra replied softly and then gently touched her cheek. In the next moment, his body disappeared.
Vanessa’s expression instantly turned sad as she stared at the empty air for a while, then she walked back into the room.

Vritra flew out of the temple and halted outside the castle boundary in the air. Then he removed the Fourth Dimension and decided to travel a little distance while flying, which would bring him quite a lot of Sin Points—plus, he needed to conserve his energy.
He didn’t fly at a high altitude or at a fast speed—just enough that everyone would get to see him, but not clearly enough.
The number of Sin Points kept increasing as he flew through the market area.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +164}
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +181}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +211}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered +259}
He needed to collect more Sin Points again. Whatever this Divine Sin Arrow was, Vritra had a feeling that he was gonna need a lot of Sin Points later on.
The more, the better.
Just while he was midway, Vritra sensed someone calling out to him from the ground. He focused and saw a shining head on the ground; the man was waving his hands rapidly.

"Why is he here again? It feels like he appears anywhere I go. Sigh... I wonder if he also has some ill motive against me." Vritra decided to have a small chat with this monk— he didn’t like stalkers.
Just as he landed, Monk Shitless smiled and greeted him, "Pitiful one, it is me, Monk Shitless."
"Yeah, I know you. It is hard to forget someone like you," Vritra said nonchalantly as he instantly got to the point. "Anyway, why were you calling me? And have you been following me lately?"
"No, no, no, I wasn’t following you. I was just following my fate. As for the reason why I called you—if you don’t mind, can I also enter that place you are going?" Shitless spoke.
Vritra frowned and asked, "Do you know where I am going?"
"No, but I know it is going to be very fun," the monk replied.
Vritra sighed, and while rubbing his head, he refused, "No, I won’t bring you anywhere. Just go back to your kingdom or something."
"You don’t have to bring me along with you. I am very good at hiding, so I will arrive there on my own. Just promise me to protect me one time inside, and I will help you inside," Monk Shitless said.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Golden Moon
paragraphs: Vritra pondered for a moment and replied, "...As long as helping you doesn’t put me at risk and you don’t bring me any trouble—so yeah, I will help you."
"That’s great!!" Monk Shitless exclaimed, looking quite excited. Then he bowed and bid farewell.

"Pitiful one, let’s meet inside that place. I am very good at hiding, so you might not recognize me until the very end, and I will gesture when I need that one help." After speaking, Monk Shitless climbed onto his bull and hit its butt as the two ran away at full speed.

Vritra couldn’t understand his ways or motives. He did seem like a genuine fortune teller, but he acted very strangely and shamelessly. Vritra decided not to think about it and continued with his journey.
He flew up again and continued to head toward the Divine Sin Tomb, while collecting lots of Sin Points along the way.
Outside the cave of the Nine Pacts, everyone was already gathered. Aside from the Doctors, who were managing and looking over the experiments, everyone else was going to head toward the tomb.

The seven marked leaders stood in front of their teams. They were controlling a total of over five thousand men. Originally, they only had around two thousand, but they called all the nearby forces and gathered just this much. Their levels weren’t too high; the highest ones among them were up to level 600, which were few.
They had sent the information back about the tomb, but they had no choice but to enter as soon as possible since the information had been leaked to that annoying organization.
If they were too late, then the treasure would be taken away.
"Is everything ready?" Number One asked. He was the collective leader even among the seven leaders and was the strongest in the group.
"Yes, let’s just leave and have some fun. I’ve been getting pretty bored in this backside kingdom. You won’t even let me slaughter too much," Number Three spoke, acting pitiful.

"Don’t act reckless inside. We are already acting without instructions from higher ups because of the urgency of the matter. If you mess up inside, then I would be the one to kill you," Number Two spoke in his usual solemn voice.

"Oh come on, won’t it be fine as long as we get that treasure, even if it means sacrificing a few or maybe all these people? And there is nothing I enjoy more than slaughtering those annoying dogs." Number Three spoke as he tried to lick his blade, but it only ended up slicing his mask in two.

"Damn it, stop breaking your masks. This is already the twenty fifth. If you keep on going like this, then you’ll have to go around with that stupidly ugly face of yours." Number Four shouted as he brought out a small silver cube and then took out a mask from it before sending it at Number Three.
"Hehe, sorry, I’ll be careful now. This will be the last," Number Three grinned.

"Stop it. Let’s not waste any more time here. The tomb has already been awakened. We have to hurry before those dogs arrive there," Number Six said after reading a paper. He had given a mission to one of the assassination organizations a couple of days ago and had just received their report about the target.

Soon, the group of five thousand people moved together as they headed deeper into the forest. They ran for nearly twenty or so kilometers, taking several turns and even passing through all kinds of traps before finally arriving at a rather simple looking place.
It looked like a large house built in the middle of nowhere a very long time ago. Its condition had greatly deteriorated now, and it seemed the house might fall apart at any moment.

"Everyone be careful inside. Don’t make any moves without permission—there will be death at every step," Number One announced. They had no info about the inside of this place, since the scouts never returned after entering.

They all began to enter through the large door of the old house. Still, it took a few minutes for all five thousand people to gather. They found themselves standing in a silent, dark space that seemed to stretch endlessly, but they could still see each other perfectly fine. Everyone was already getting dangerously tense vibes.
Some distance in front of them stood a large and majestic looking gate, with something written on it in a language none of them could decipher—but they knew it was the tomb they were searching for.
"Should we enter?" Number Seven asked, but Number One only shook his head and remained silent.

Soon they heard the sound of footsteps and chatter from the entrance of this dark space, and then people wearing white robes charged into the dark area. They all wore white masks and looked no weaker than those in the black robes.

Within a few minutes, a group of similar size—or maybe slightly bigger—had gathered on the other side from the Nine Pacts. Leading them were six leaders. They wore golden masks, each one symbolizing a different animal.

The leader wore a dragon mask, while the ones under him wore lion, monkey, fox, and bear masks. Their auras weren’t at all weaker than the numbered leaders of the Nine Pacts. The two groups now numbered more than ten thousand.

"Hahaha! So the sniffing dogs of the Golden Moon followed us here. No wonder you people are praised for wiggling your tails loyally," Number Three was the first one to pass a remark as he looked at the other group in disdain.

"Hmm? Did you hear oinking from somewhere? Sigh... the Golden Moon needs to work harder to eliminate all the pests. Look—even pigs are moving around such places in groups now. The world sure is going down the gutter." The fox masked man from the other side said, clearly annoyed.
"Keke, bastard! Wanna have a go at me?" Number Three pulled out his blade and took a menacing step forward.
"Huh? Why hasn’t the oinking stopped yet? Is the little pig hungry or too horny?" the fox said in a mocking tone.
"Yes, this pig is horny. Wanna have a taste? Just let me use you real quick," Number Three said as he licked his blade. As his mask broke, he had sacrificed his self respect for a comeback.

"No thanks. I hate it the most when pigs like you try to stick their sticks where they shouldn’t enter. Be careful, or you might end up losing your stick—oh, I mean your life," the fox masked man spoke.
"How about—" Number Three began to speak again but was interrupted by Number One, who frowned and scolded him:
"Enough with your bickering. Don’t make a fool of yourself."

Then Number One and the dragon masked man looked at each other and nodded. They were enemies, but they weren’t going to start fighting here—at least until one side had obtained the treasure from the tomb, they would not interfere with one another.
This was a kind of silent pact.
"Now that all of us are here, let’s enter. I doubt anyone else was able to obtain this information. Let’s hurry up a bit," Number Two said.
STEP STEP
Just then, the sound of footsteps echoed.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Divine Tomb-1
paragraphs: STEP STEP
All the gazes were drawn towards the entrance as they heard the sound of the footsteps. Nine Pacts had already gathered all their members, so they thought it was a member of the Golden Moon.
The same was true for the Golden Moon. They thought that the new member must belong to the Nine Pacts.
Unless, of course, it was someone entirely different, so they all waited to see the new participant.
Whether it be someone in the black or white robe or something different altogether.
The footsteps drew closer and soon the silhouette of a person came into view, and after a few silent moments, his figure finally became clear.

This person wore a robe, its left side was white while the right side was black. He wore an elephant mask with the number Zero written on his forehead, and there was a plus sign on his chest, with a single letter inscribed in each of its four arms.
When read from left to right it formed two short sentences:
’FUCK NINE PACTS!!’and’GOLDEN MOON THE GREATEST!!’
But when read from top to bottom, it formed:
’FUCK GOLDEN MOON!!’and’NINE PACTS THE GREATEST!!’
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared At +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Amused +11}

The people on both sides were looking at him in confusion. His half white robe and golden animal mask were like the Golden Moon, while his half black robe and the zero number on his forehead resembled the Nine Pacts.
’Damn this bastard, so he is on the Golden Moon’s side? How arrogant to curse the Nine Pacts so openly. He is lucky to live for a couple more days.’ Number One thought, feeling angry.
’This evil bastard, so he is on the Nine Pacts’ side? These cultists are going out of hand. Tch, the moment this mission is over, I am going to slaughter him first.’ The dragon masked man thought.
Both sides were feeling very angry just from one look at him.
Vritra stood between the two groups. He had even used the skillNatural Hypnosisto induce the thought that he belonged to the other side in their heads.
He had turned on his shameless switch. The one to come here wasn’t Vritra butDaddy V, he planned to cause as much chaos as he possibly could.
Vritra was informed about Golden Moon in advance by Yasmine, unlike the Nine Pacts which is a dark organisation with hidden motives and brutal means.

The Golden Moon is like a government to the entire continent. They are the law enforcers that are feared by most of the dark organisations and kingdoms. They even have the authority to directly kill the royal family of most kingdoms as long as they find something wrong.

They are divided into several groups, like the ones present here are calledWhite Moon Executioners. These people are solely responsible for hunting down the humans of dark organisations. It is quite a fearsome organisation which could be said to be the ruler of the continent.

Both the dark and white organisations couldn’t fight right now. They were unsure of each other’s plans and preparations, while revealing themselves and wasting resources right now would result in a failed mission.

Vritra glanced at both his sides. Most of the gazes were fixed on him. Just by his entrance, he had gained quite a bit of Sin Points, but him acting like this had another reason— he would be able to fool both sides.
"Oh, that friend of yours is actually here. He is quite strange, but I don’t think he has any kinds of bad intentions towards you," Yasmine spoke as she saw someone familiar not too far away.

Vritra looked around. He understood that she must be referring to Monk Shitless, but he did say he is quite good at hiding, and with their entire bodies covered, it would be a bit difficult to recognise him—
"..." within moments, Vritra saw a bald head on the side of the Golden Moon. He was wearing a white mask and seated on his bull. Indeed, he was hiding very well.
Shaking his head, Vritra decided to ignore him as he first turned towards the left, where the Golden Moon was gathered. All the eyes were fixed on him.
Then he turned and faced the Nine Pacts. Both sides only now noticed that there was something written on his back too. They squinted their eyes and read it...
"Enter 10 Meters, If Your Birth Was A Team Effort And Still A Misfire!!"
All the men collectively took one step back, as they frowned and then almost rushed forward to kill this person who had appeared out of nowhere.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Furious +10,996}
{Sin Point Gained: Blood Boiling +10,888}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared At +11,101}
Vritra smirked. Before any side could take action, he shouted out loud:
"What are you ass licker twats staring at? Do any pig among you dare to attack me when my strong group is here to back me up?"
Vritra did his best to sound as disrespectful as possible, making both sides angry at the same time.
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Locked On +9,863}
{Sin Point Gained: Cursed +10,855}
Both sides felt extremely angry. The two leaders glared at each other. Both thinking that if the other side wasn’t backing him up, this detestable person would already be cut to pieces.
"Keep your members in check," Number One said angrily.
"I should remind you of that. Don’t cross the line," the dragon masked man said. Then both looked at Vritra and said almost at the same time:
"Boy, behave yourself."
Vritra smiled under the mask, as he glanced at both men and nodded:
"Yes, leader, I understand haha, but what can I do when the other side is full of twats."
’If only the other side wasn’t backing him and we weren’t about to enter the tomb, I would have already sliced him in two.
How shameless of them to bring someone like that here, the dark/righteous organisation has become truly shameless and pure evil.’ Number One and the dragon masked man thought at the same time.
They both sent death stares at one another, while believing that the other person was reading this killing intent as a warning not to touch this person.
{Sin Point Gained: Snapped +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Threatened +7,329}
"Hmph, let’s not waste any more time here and head inside. Get ready, everyone." Both the leaders warned their teams, completely ignoring that person for now. He was going to die quite soon anyway.
The atmosphere instantly turned solemn. All the people took out their weapons, shields, or whatever they had prepared. They would have to face the unknown right after passing through that door.
Vritra nodded, as he too decided to pull out his legendary weapon.
"Now, behold the most feared and deadly weapon—a weapon wielded by the strongest warriors from the east!

A sure kill weapon that humans and demons fear all the same, made from the greatest materials in the entire universe! It is called...the Death Bringer—"Vritra continued to praise, but was interrupted by the furious shouts of the two leaders.
"ENOUGH!!"

Unless, of course, it was someone entirely different, so they all waited to see the new participant.
Whether it be someone in the black or white robe or something different altogether.
The footsteps drew closer and soon the silhouette of a person came into view, and after a few silent moments, his figure finally became clear.

’FUCK GOLDEN MOON!!’and’NINE PACTS THE GREATEST!!’
{Sin Point Gained: Observed +11,101}
