chapters.title: Chapter 91: Divine Tomb-2
paragraphs: "ENOUGH!!"

"Okay, don’t be so angry at me, Cap. I was just trying to scare the other sides’ bitches. Anyway, everyone don’t get blinded by the brilliance of my weapon, everyone." Vritra added, as waves after waves of Sin Points flowed out.
He had already started to enjoy this shameless behaviour—it easily earned him so many points.
Everyone instinctively turned to look at Vritra, actually feeling curious about his weapon. And the moment it appeared, everyone’s eyes widened in surprise and bewilderment.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Speechless +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Confused +11,101}
"T- That is your weapon? The legendary weapon, the Death Bringer? Sure kill weapon?" Everyone was at a loss for words.
In Vritra’s hand rested the east’s strongest warriors’ most deadly weapon, the legendary...Slipper.

"He actually took out a slipper? He plans to enter the dangerous tomb using that thing? Is this bastard still messing with us?" All the people broke out in curses and shouts. They truly didn’t know what to feel about it.
But after reading the words on his back, no man dared to step within ten meters of him.
"Boss, just please allow me to stab that shameless bastard. After that, I will have no regrets left even if I die here."
"Hahaha, a great weapon indeed. Just spank everyone with the Death Bringer, pitiful one hahaha."

"Let’s just thrash the other side. I always knew these dark organisations are evil, but they were hiding a hideous, vicious creature like that. Even for them, it is too low. If I don’t kill him today, then I will name my children—Cuck NutandRegretful Jizz."

Both sides were extremely mad and ended up fighting just because of one person. But in the end, the tomb was much more important, so the leaders silenced their groups. They just decided to enter if it meant getting away from that contagious, detestable organism.

The Nine Pacts were the first to jump in as they threw vicious curses and threats toward that one person. In a way, Vritra had just united the dark and the righteous factions just by being the common enemy.
Within a minute, all the men from the Nine Pacts had disappeared. Only Vritra and the Golden Moon remained behind.

Vritra didn’t want to stay alone with that group. All of them were releasing very strong killing intent toward him and waves of Sin Points, so he walked towards the door, and before entering, he looked back and spat out even more disrespectful words.

"Yo, Necrophile shits with enlarged backdoors, yes, I am talking to the six of you. Did you ever wonder why your daddy never returned after going out to buy milk? Heh That is because—" Vritra paused, then jumped into the darkness of the door.
{Sin Point Gained: Betrayed +6,707}
{Sin Point Gained: Missed +5,290}
"You inhumane freak, at least finish what you were saying!!"

"Why? WHY?!! Why did he not return? And did they have a common daddy—I mean, father? Tell me the reason." Lots of people who got interested in hearing that were disappointed as Vritra left them at the crucial point.
"SILENCE!!"The lion masked man shouted. That unknown boy was too vulgar and shameless. They all really wanted to slice him apart.
Vritra passed through the darkness. A blinding light hit his face, making him shut his eyes for a moment. After a moment, he opened his eyes and carefully observed his surroundings.
This place seemed the complete opposite of the previous space. It was completely white in colour, but he could actually see walls in the distance—at least this place didn’t seem endless.
On the walls, there were several dozen levers which were all turned upwards, and it was unknown what would happen if someone pulled those levers.
The men in black robes were already cautiously observing their surroundings. They didn’t dare to make even the slightest movement without instructions from the leaders.
In the front, there was another big gate which was shut tight.

"Hmm, as I thought, this tomb is built in a separate space. Be careful here, there might be places where even your fourth dimension might not allow escape. If the space is broken and separated, then void appears between them, and I don’t think even the fourth dimension will help you pass through it," Yasmine warned.
Vritra nodded. He was being as cautious as he could be. He didn’t take the two groups or the tomb lightly at all.
Soon, the Golden Moon also entered through the door and arrived in the white space. They looked at their surroundings curiously and cautiously, for a while forgetting about Vritra.
"It seems one among all these levers might open the door, but there are a total of one hundred forty-eight levers.
Is there a way to find the correct lever?" Number Two mumbled. He walked around the group to find any kind of clue but couldn’t—except for those strange letters.

"Hmm... how strange. It seems some kind of letters are written on those levers, but that is the Minoan Crete language. We haven’t even been able to decipher 1% of it since it’s hard to find texts related to that language,"
Number Four, the expert in solving puzzles and ancient languages, muttered. He was the biggest hope for their team in passing through Stage One.
On the other side, the fox masked man also began to observe the levers carefully, since there might be other traps in the white room.
Vritra grinned under his mask. If this test was related to language, then who could be better than him here? It was completely his forte and a test solely made for him.
He looked at the levers and instantly understood those words. It didn’t take him more than a moment to find the actual way that would open the door.
He laughed after finding the solution to this challenge. Whoever designed this must have loved playing pranks on people.
Yes, Vritra— with hisLanguage Masteryskill— could easily bring everyone to the other side.
But was he a good enough person to help those more than eleven thousand nervous men pass safely along with him?
Heh. He would rather let them suffer before they were able to move to the next area.

Of course, he wasn’t planning to kill those Sin Point generator lambs, but even if they were bruised and battered and kept barely alive, they could still be put to work and made use of until their last moments.
{Sin Point Gained: Glared At +10,673}
{Sin Point Gained: Threatened +9,267}

Vritra ignored those messages. He didn’t make any more remarks and stood silently. Soon, the display messages quieted down, and the attention of all the people was now completely focused on the first challenge of the tomb.
"Do you think all these levers might be a trap?" Number Four couldn’t help but ask. Even enemies might have to cooperate for a bit to avoid unnecessary losses on both sides.
"It might be possible. But I believe one among them is the answer to this puzzle. Why does it have to be this ancient language of all? Damn it!!" The fox masked man cursed.

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Divine Tomb-3
paragraphs: While the people were busy praying and hoping that the two geniuses of their team would solve the puzzle, a few people who wanted to secretly vent their anger on that detestable creature looked towards the spot Vritra was standing on.
People from both sides secretly planned to thrash him a bit— and maybe, while they were at it, kill him, if possible.
But when they looked, he was nowhere to be found. They were startled and looked around frantically. And as they saw that hateful figure holding the leather slipper again, all of them froze.
"L- Leader, look t- there..." one of the men hastily called out to Number One, but the leader just hushed him, asking his group to stay quiet.
"T- That person, look... h- he is going to—" one white-robed man also tried to speak but was silenced by the dragon-masked man.
"Stay quiet. If you dare disturb me again, you’ll receive severe punishment right here and now."
Soon, everyone sensed that something was amiss— even the leaders from both sides. Why was this space suddenly so quiet? Shouldn’t there be a certain someone throwing curses all over the place?

Why was that certain someone, who was as loud as a thunder strike previously, suddenly so quiet? Something was definitely fishy. If he wasn’t speaking, then he must be up to something even more dangerous.
All the gazes looked around to search for him— at least those who weren’t frozen by fear after already seeing that vile human— and it wasn’t long before...
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,088}
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +10,823}

"You!! What are you doing there? Get away from that lever! If you touch things randomly, then all of us might end up dead in this place." The dragon-masked man shouted, after seeing that person in black and white robes floating in the air, his right hand already clutching a lever.
"Are you crazy? Stop that! If you don’t, we will kill you before you have the chance to do anything." Number One roared, killing intent bursting out of his body.

"H-He has gone mad! I knew it, we should have just killed that bastard earlier! Is he some sort of suicide bomber? Damn it, my children will grow fatherless now, sob." People broke out in fear. Only the thirteen leaders were somewhat calm; the others just wanted to run away from there.

"Is that so? Do you want to see which is faster— you killing me, or me pulling this lever? Kekeke. You pieces of dog shit, should I bury all of you here?" Vritra acted like a madman while releasing the most demonic laugh he could.

"..." The leaders felt frustrated. They were aware of their strength and believed they could kill someone like Vritra in an instant, but they were afraid that if they were just a bit late, a lot of people might die.
Number One and the dragon masked man clenched their fists as they glared at each other. They could only vent their anger by cursing for now.
"Can’t you even control your members? Why the fuck did you bring that lunatic here? I didn’t know the Golden Moon is now growing such vile beings." Number One said, his tone full of thorns.

"Hah! Your shamelessness has finally hit rock bottom. How dare you throw that dirt at us? Now you are even pretending that he doesn’t belong to your group? Only an evil organization can keep that madman." The dragon masked man said.

"Stop lying, he clearly belongs to your group. See his clothes? They even say ’Golden Moon the greatest’ while cursing the Nine Pacts. You hideous bastards, he clearly belongs to your side." Number One retorted.
"Why would we ever want someone like that? He is on your team." — Dragon Mask.
"Ptui! He is definitely on your team! Nine Pacts hasn’t reached that low yet. He is definitely one of yours." — Number One.
"He is your underling." — Dragon Mask.
"He is your member." — Number One.
"Wait, so he really isn’t your member? Like seriously? Let’s forget his shameless behaviour for a moment... still not from your team?" the dragon-masked man asked.
"No... huh? So he isn’t your member either?" Number One asked, feeling bewildered. The people listening to this conversation were even more shocked.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +9,363}

All the gazes were collectively drawn towards Vritra, and they all instantly understood that two such large organizations had been played around by that single person. He had even cursed them so much, yet because of the misunderstanding, no one made a move. He had made a fool of them all.
The leaders were the ones who were the angriest. Their auras erupted and the killing intent surged, all concentrating on that heinous man.

"Heh. Trying to scare me? How cute. Now let me show you the right way to scare someone." As Vritra spoke, dust swirled in the air. All the men didn’t dare to make a move in fear of Vritra pulling the lever.

But under their shocked gazes, all one hundred forty-eight levers soon had a hand resting over them, ready to pull at any moment. Those hands were made of dust and then transformed into normal human-like hands.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Horrified +11,099}

The sweeping killing intent disappeared like it never existed. Now even the leaders were afraid. They might not fear Vritra’s strength, but this is the Divine Sin Tomb. One mistake, and all of them would be wiped out.
"I don’t believe you would kill yourself just to wipe us out. Isn’t this just a bluff?" Number One asked, but didn’t move an inch.

"Try it and we’ll see. Of course, I have a way to save myself—but more than ninety percent of you will be wiped out the moment I pull even a quarter of these levers." Vritra said arrogantly, though in his mind, he was already making several calculations.
"Bastard! I am going to tear you apart!!" One mindless brute couldn’t hold back anymore. After knowing that Vritra was alone here and still dared to act so brazenly, Number Three was truly mad.
He stepped forward at the same time as Vritra began to pull twenty levers. All the people were frightened out of their wits, sending lots of sin points to Vritra.
Number One struck Number Three’s head and glared at him. Right now, the situation had turned extremely strange— a single person was in complete control of the situation, threatening them all.
The whole place was pin-drop silent, and several thousand men were shivering in dread.
"What exactly is it you want?" the dragon-faced man asked.

"Hehe. First of all, why don’t you all dance? I will sing a song, and you all have to match the moves. Of course, the two leaders are excluded." Vritra said. His plan was to make sure that after passing this phase, no one would be a threat to him.
Yasmine had informed him about their strength already. All the secondary leaders are extremely strong, but if it’s a one on one, Vritra has a very high chance of victory.

sentences.text: While the people were busy praying and hoping that the two geniuses of their team would solve the puzzle, a few people who wanted to secretly vent their anger on that detestable creature looked towards the spot Vritra was standing on.
People from both sides secretly planned to thrash him a bit— and maybe, while they were at it, kill him, if possible.
But when they looked, he was nowhere to be found.
They were startled and looked around frantically.
And as they saw that hateful figure holding the leather slipper again, all of them froze.
"L- Leader, look t- there..." one of the men hastily called out to Number One, but the leader just hushed him, asking his group to stay quiet.
"T- That person, look... h- he is going to—" one white-robed man also tried to speak but was silenced by the dragon-masked man.
"Stay quiet.
If you dare disturb me again, you’ll receive severe punishment right here and now."
Soon, everyone sensed that something was amiss— even the leaders from both sides.
Why was this space suddenly so quiet?
Shouldn’t there be a certain someone throwing curses all over the place?
Why was that certain someone, who was as loud as a thunder strike previously, suddenly so quiet?
Something was definitely fishy.
If he wasn’t speaking, then he must be up to something even more dangerous.
All the gazes looked around to search for him— at least those who weren’t frozen by fear after already seeing that vile human— and it wasn’t long before...
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,088}
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +10,823}
"You!!
What are you doing there?
Get away from that lever!

If you touch things randomly, then all of us might end up dead in this place." The dragon-masked man shouted, after seeing that person in black and white robes floating in the air, his right hand already clutching a lever.
"Are you crazy?
Stop that!
If you don’t, we will kill you before you have the chance to do anything." Number One roared, killing intent bursting out of his body.
"H-He has gone mad!
I knew it, we should have just killed that bastard earlier!
Is he some sort of suicide bomber?
Damn it, my children will grow fatherless now, sob." People broke out in fear.
Only the thirteen leaders were somewhat calm; the others just wanted to run away from there.
"Is that so?
Do you want to see which is faster— you killing me, or me pulling this lever?
Kekeke.
You pieces of dog shit, should I bury all of you here?" Vritra acted like a madman while releasing the most demonic laugh he could.
"..." The leaders felt frustrated.
They were aware of their strength and believed they could kill someone like Vritra in an instant, but they were afraid that if they were just a bit late, a lot of people might die.
Number One and the dragon masked man clenched their fists as they glared at each other.
They could only vent their anger by cursing for now.
"Can’t you even control your members?
Why the fuck did you bring that lunatic here?
I didn’t know the Golden Moon is now growing such vile beings." Number One said, his tone full of thorns.
"Hah!
Your shamelessness has finally hit rock bottom.
How dare you throw that dirt at us?
Now you are even pretending that he doesn’t belong to your group?
Only an evil organization can keep that madman." The dragon masked man said.
"Stop lying, he clearly belongs to your group.
See his clothes?
They even say ’Golden Moon the greatest’ while cursing the Nine Pacts.
You hideous bastards, he clearly belongs to your side." Number One retorted.
"Why would we ever want someone like that?
He is on your team." — Dragon Mask.
"Ptui!
He is definitely on your team!
Nine Pacts hasn’t reached that low yet.
He is definitely one of yours." — Number One.
"He is your underling." — Dragon Mask.
"He is your member." — Number One.
"Wait, so he really isn’t your member?
Like seriously?
Let’s forget his shameless behaviour for a moment... still not from your team?" the dragon-masked man asked.
"No... huh?
So he isn’t your member either?" Number One asked, feeling bewildered.
The people listening to this conversation were even more shocked.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +9,363}
All the gazes were collectively drawn towards Vritra, and they all instantly understood that two such large organizations had been played around by that single person.
He had even cursed them so much, yet because of the misunderstanding, no one made a move.
He had made a fool of them all.
The leaders were the ones who were the angriest.
Their auras erupted and the killing intent surged, all concentrating on that heinous man.
"Heh.
Trying to scare me?
How cute.
Now let me show you the right way to scare someone." As Vritra spoke, dust swirled in the air.
All the men didn’t dare to make a move in fear of Vritra pulling the lever.
But under their shocked gazes, all one hundred forty-eight levers soon had a hand resting over them, ready to pull at any moment.
Those hands were made of dust and then transformed into normal human-like hands.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,101}
{Sin Point Gained: Horrified +11,099}
The sweeping killing intent disappeared like it never existed.
Now even the leaders were afraid.
They might not fear Vritra’s strength, but this is the Divine Sin Tomb.
One mistake, and all of them would be wiped out.
"I don’t believe you would kill yourself just to wipe us out.
Isn’t this just a bluff?" Number One asked, but didn’t move an inch.
"Try it and we’ll see.

Of course, I have a way to save myself—but more than ninety percent of you will be wiped out the moment I pull even a quarter of these levers." Vritra said arrogantly, though in his mind, he was already making several calculations.
"Bastard!
I am going to tear you apart!!" One mindless brute couldn’t hold back anymore.
After knowing that Vritra was alone here and still dared to act so brazenly, Number Three was truly mad.
He stepped forward at the same time as Vritra began to pull twenty levers.
All the people were frightened out of their wits, sending lots of sin points to Vritra.
Number One struck Number Three’s head and glared at him.
Right now, the situation had turned extremely strange— a single person was in complete control of the situation, threatening them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Divine Tomb-4
paragraphs: Only the two top leaders were quite dangerous. It might get a bit difficult if he were to face them right now, since his overall combat wasn’t at a hundred percent— one of his trump cards was missing.
"You crazy bastar— cough, sir, please don’t do anything rash. We are all good people here, let’s talk things out," someone from the Golden Moon side shouted.

"Hah! That great sir definitely isn’t a good person. Don’t you know baddies are the best? Great sir, we are all bad people on this side. Let’s cooperate," a person from the Nine Pacts said, his voice trembling.

"I will start singing now, and if— aside from those two leaders— I see anyone standing still, then I will start pulling the levers," Vritra said. Behind this action, his reason was to earn sin points, break their morale and confidence a bit, and make himself seem less harmful so they would agree to his next demand.

"Even though I can’t see his face, but I have never hated anyone this much. I will remember your hidden ugly face and I will cut you into a thousand pieces the moment we leave—" it was the lion masked who was shouting. The eyes of most people had turned red because of anger.
"So the name of the song isUnholy Child. First, start shaking your bodies, otherwise..." Vritra threatened. Over half of them instantly began to dance, but others didn’t move.
"Sigh, looks like you guys aren’t taking me seriously." Vritra sighed, and in the next moment, one of the hands pulled the lever at an incredible speed before anyone could react.

"Nooooo!!" The two leaders charged forward to stop him, but it was too late. Their movements halted and they looked around vigilantly—there were no attacks, but all the men were instantly covered by a thick white barrier.
It seemed strong enough that even if they attacked it together, it wouldn’t break instantly.
"Now, everyone, get to it, or you won’t even know how you died," Vritra threatened.

"...Everyone, we have to listen to him for now. Do as he says even if you don’t want to," both leaders gave the instruction to their groups before they walked to the side. They felt relieved that Vritra didn’t include them.
"Hey everyone, just shake your ass and follow me." A certain bald monk shouted as he began to dance, making his hips bounce.
Everyone felt enraged, but soon they all began to dance, even the animal-masked and numbered leaders of both organizations.
For providing music, Vritra hit random things against one another as he cleared his throat and began to sing loudly, while everyone did their best to move according to the beat.
"Here we go!!"
CLAP CLAP CLAP
♪ Clap it for the man who pulled out late ♪
♪ Grind for the birth your mom should hate ♪
♪ Bend like you’re proud of the mess they made ♪
♪ You’re a group project with no A-grade ♪
SHAKE SHAKE SHAKE
♪ You got made in a fight and spilled on sheets♪
♪ Daddy wore socks but forgot the briefs♪
♪ Named after beer, fed lies and yeast♪
♪ You’re the reason Plan B increased♪
EVERYBODY, PUT YOUR HANDS UP
♪ Named by mistake, not love or plan♪
♪ Your whole bloodline’s a one-night stand♪
{Sin Point Gained: Hated +11,099}
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +11,099}
{Sin Point Gained: Vowed Vengeance +11,099}
{Sin Point Gained: Burning Resentment +11,099}
{Sin Point Gained: Ridiculed +11,099}

Sin points came flooding by the time Vritra finished. All the people were feeling ashamed and embarrassed, they just wanted to bury themselves in a hole, they finally stopped twerking and shaking their asses.
He really loved this kind of leveling; the people were so mad right now, as if Vritra had become their sworn enemy after killing their entire families.
"Can you understand this language?" the dragon masked man asked. It didn’t seem Vritra had just pulled a random lever.
"Heh. What do you think?" Vritra didn’t agree or reject, leaving them to think about it.
"Are we done now? Now get away from there," Number One said.
"Haha. Do you think I am stupid? Won’t you all just kill me in the next instant? I need a guarantee," Vritra said as he threateningly pulled the lever just a tiny bit.
"Damn it, stop playing with those dangerous things and tell me what is it you want?" both leaders cursed and questioned.
"I want you two to provide a few drops of your blood," Vritra said after thinking for a moment.
"And what are you going to do with it?" they asked suspiciously.

"I know a demonic art that can make your body explode with just a few drops of your blood. Why, are you too scared to even do that?" Vritra said in a sarcastic tone, even making the first half of his sentence sound like a joke.

"..." Number One and Dragon Mask both looked at each other. They knew people could use blood to put curses and debuffs, but they weren’t scared of Vritra—they would still be able to kill him before he could attempt anything.

"Fine, here, take it." Number One and Dragon Mask both agreed, as they stretched their right hand and made a small cut with their blades. Then two hands flew in front of them and collected the blood drops, before bringing it back to Vritra.

’Perfect!! I have succeeded. Now all I have to do is wait. I am sure he wouldn’t notice anything is wrong until his strength has dropped by at least twenty or so percent. I just need two hundred minutes and he would be dead,’ Vritra said. He put away the drops and only touched one of the blood drops.
[Blood Lock Activated.]
[Target Locked. Time Until Death: 3 hours 19 minutes 59 seconds.]

Vritra was delighted, but he still couldn’t be careless. This skill could only be used on one person at a time after all, and needed some time to show considerable effects. So he decided to make another offer.

"I know none among you can understand this language, but I can— perfectly at that. So I wish to join one of your teams. I will instantly show you the way out and you might need my help in the future as well. So which among the two should I belong to?"
Vritra said, as he moved his hand away from the lever and floated in the air with an air of superiority. Of course, all the other levers were still under his control.
"..." The two leaders looked at one another, then they began to argue.
"Sorry for not controlling my members properly. Now that I think about it, he is indeed a member of Nine Pacts," Number One said, his tone full of softness.

"Hah! Your shamelessness has finally hit rock bottom. How dare you try to steal our best member. Now you are even pretending that he belongs to your group. Only an evil organization would do that," the dragon masked man said.
"Stop lying! He clearly belongs to my group. See his clothes? They even sayFuck Golden MoonandNine Pacts the Greatest. You hideous bastards—he clearly belongs to my side," Number One retorted.
"He ismyunderling." —Dragon Mask.
"He ismymember." —Number One.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Cannon Ball
paragraphs: Vritra watched in silence as the two sides quarreled over him. After all, it would give them quite the benefit if they could add him to their groups, so the two organizations fought verbally with one another.

While he waited patiently for the effects of Blood Lock to consume more of Number One’s strength, Vritra thought for a moment and said: "While you people decide whose team I should join, I will look around and find the exit."
"Go ahead," both replied before turning to look at one another and resuming their fight.

Just like that, almost forty minutes had passed, which meant Number One’s strength had been reduced by nearly twenty percent. Number One must have noticed it by now—he suddenly paused mid-fight and turned to look at Vritra with shock in his eyes.
He could feel that he couldn’t gather over twenty percent of his energy. His speed and strength also seemed weaker. That’s when realization dawned upon him.
’I have to kill him.’ Only this thought remained in his mind.
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +1}
’It’s time to end the jokes, now the real fight begins.’ Vritra gave up all his pretenses. His body directly rushed toward one of the levers, but at the same time, Number One made his move.

He had already understood that Vritra had definitely done something with that drop of his blood. He had to kill Vritra at any cost—and as soon as possible. Before Vritra could pull any of the levers, Number One shot out of the barrier at full strength.
WHOOSH
BANG

He pulled out a long spear and broke through the barrier in less than a moment, though he had to exhaust quite a bit of his energy. Then the tip of his spear directly pierced through Vritra’s forehead, coming out from the back of his head.
Vritra’s eyes widened in shock and fear, then his lips curled, and instead of blood, dust began to pour out of his forehead as he whispered a few words: "You are already dead."

In the next moment, Vritra’s body burst into dust—it was nothing more than a clone. All the eyes frantically searched for Vritra. Then the sound of a door opening echoed, and under their gazes, Vritra simply stepped through the next door and disappeared.

There was absolutely no need to pull any of the levers; they could have just opened the door. Before Vritra had disappeared, he had pulled a few levers, which instantly made the entire room fill with screams as arrows, lava, and all kinds of spells rained down upon them.
"You scheming bastard, get back hereeeeeeee!!"
Vritra landed in a new space. He scratched his head and wondered why he was feeling an itch in his ear. He looked around and felt that this space was several times more dangerous than the last.
He was in some sort of cave that seemed to be connected to thousands of paths—like he was inside some kind of ant hive.
"This place has such an eerie vibe. I can smell the danger in the air. Anyway, I need to start moving. Those guys will be here soon... but which could be the right way?" Vritra mumbled.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
An eye containing endless darkness appeared on his forehead as he scanned the surroundings, but he actually couldn’t see anything past the entrance of those thousands of caves and intersections.
RUMBLE
He heard a distant rumbling. The ground began to shake lightly, and all the senses in Vritra’s body screamed with danger. He could tell—whatever was approaching, he could do nothing against it.

"HUBBY, RUN!! IT’S A MYRIAD CREATURE!" Yasmine’s hurried voice sounded in his head. Vritra didn’t wait to ask what that term meant. After sensing the direction the creature was approaching from, he turned and ran at his fastest speed.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength → Agility]
• Strength: 10
• Agility: 3255

Not even a moment later, Vritra had moved from the spot. A loud explosive sound came from behind, and a wave of force flew in all directions. Cracks appeared on the ground, stretching for several dozen meters.

Vritra didn’t turn his head. He could see the figure behind him with his third eye. It was a monstrous creature, completely spherical in shape. Its outer layer appeared like some kind of unbreakable metal, with dangerously sharp spikes protruding out all over.
It was more than thirty feet high and emitted a very dangerous aura. Vritra had the feeling that even if he turned into dust, he might not be able to escape.

’Will the fourth dimension work against it? And what exactly is a Myriad Creature?’ Vritra rushed into one of the caves in haste, but he felt goosebumps as that large figure blurred and moved at an incredible speed—much higher than his own.
"Fuck!!" Vritra cursed and almost panicked before he shouted in desperation:"Forbid: Agility!!"
[Forbidden Activated.]
The large cannonball’s speed decreased significantly by almost forty to fifty percent, but it was still too fast. It shot toward Vritra and began to close in rapidly.
"Myriad Creatures are those whose level has crossed the thousand mark. There is no way we can defeat it with our current strength. As for the Fourth Dimension, I am not sure either.
Some humans, demons, or such creatures who don’t belong to any category may comprehend the rules of space—so I’d suggest that you don’t try it right now. Just find the gate or something.

I’ll keep you safe for now with teleportation," Yasmine explained in a hurry, as she teleported him forward to keep some distance. Even her strength was limited right now, so she couldn’t use teleportation too many times.
Vritra made several hundred clones of himself with dust, sending them running in all directions, hoping to distract the huge metal ball.
BOOOOM

The round creature bounced off the walls and continued to charge toward Vritra, completely ignoring the clones. This feeling of being chased was too terrifying—it felt like just a light push from that thing would turn his body into minced meat.
"EXHUME!!"

Several figures appeared behind Vritra. The soul wraiths’ sole mission was to delay the devastating ball, but just as the ball struck them, their bodies were destroyed—not even delaying it for a second.

"Fuck, I shouldn’t have come here first. Ughh, dear Nine Pacts and Golden Moon, where are you? Please come rescue me," Vritra said, feeling regretful. But he doubted most of them would have put up any kind of resistance.
BANG BANG

All of a sudden, the metallic spikes on the giant ball’s body grew and shot in all directions. Many of them headed straight toward Vritra. The speed was so high that they appeared exactly behind him in an instant.

Yasmine teleported him forward again, and just as the spikes were about to hit him again, Vritra’s body deformed and twisted as he turned into sand and barely managed to dodge the dangerous spikes embedded in the walls.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]

Vritra didn’t pause as he activated another skill. He suddenly changed direction, hoping that the cannonball could no longer sense him and would lose its target. But just as he turned toward another intersection, the cannonball shot straight at him—giving him a fright.

An eye containing endless darkness appeared on his forehead as he scanned the surroundings, but he actually couldn’t see anything past the entrance of those thousands of caves and intersections.
RUMBLE
He heard a distant rumbling.
The ground began to shake lightly, and all the senses in Vritra’s body screamed with danger.
He could tell—whatever was approaching, he could do nothing against it.
"HUBBY, RUN!!
IT’S A MYRIAD CREATURE!" Yasmine’s hurried voice sounded in his head.
Vritra didn’t wait to ask what that term meant.
After sensing the direction the creature was approaching from, he turned and ran at his fastest speed.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength → Agility]
• Strength: 10
• Agility: 3255
Not even a moment later, Vritra had moved from the spot.
A loud explosive sound came from behind, and a wave of force flew in all directions.
Cracks appeared on the ground, stretching for several dozen meters.
Vritra didn’t turn his head.
He could see the figure behind him with his third eye.
It was a monstrous creature, completely spherical in shape.
Its outer layer appeared like some kind of unbreakable metal, with dangerously sharp spikes protruding out all over.
It was more than thirty feet high and emitted a very dangerous aura.
Vritra had the feeling that even if he turned into dust, he might not be able to escape.
’Will the fourth dimension work against it?
And what exactly is a Myriad Creature?’ Vritra rushed into one of the caves in haste, but he felt goosebumps as that large figure blurred and moved at an incredible speed—much higher than his own.
"Fuck!!" Vritra cursed and almost panicked before he shouted in desperation:"Forbid: Agility!!"
[Forbidden Activated.]
The large cannonball’s speed decreased significantly by almost forty to fifty percent, but it was still too fast.
It shot toward Vritra and began to close in rapidly.
"Myriad Creatures are those whose level has crossed the thousand mark.
There is no way we can defeat it with our current strength.
As for the Fourth Dimension, I am not sure either.
Some humans, demons, or such creatures who don’t belong to any category may comprehend the rules of space—so I’d suggest that you don’t try it right now.
Just find the gate or something.
I’ll keep you safe for now with teleportation," Yasmine explained in a hurry, as she teleported him forward to keep some distance.
Even her strength was limited right now, so she couldn’t use teleportation too many times.
Vritra made several hundred clones of himself with dust, sending them running in all directions, hoping to distract the huge metal ball.
BOOOOM
The round creature bounced off the walls and continued to charge toward Vritra, completely ignoring the clones.
This feeling of being chased was too terrifying—it felt like just a light push from that thing would turn his body into minced meat.
"EXHUME!!"
Several figures appeared behind Vritra.
The soul wraiths’ sole mission was to delay the devastating ball, but just as the ball struck them, their bodies were destroyed—not even delaying it for a second.
"Fuck, I shouldn’t have come here first.
Ughh, dear Nine Pacts and Golden Moon, where are you?
Please come rescue me," Vritra said, feeling regretful.
But he doubted most of them would have put up any kind of resistance.
BANG BANG
All of a sudden, the metallic spikes on the giant ball’s body grew and shot in all directions.
Many of them headed straight toward Vritra.
The speed was so high that they appeared exactly behind him in an instant.

Yasmine teleported him forward again, and just as the spikes were about to hit him again, Vritra’s body deformed and twisted as he turned into sand and barely managed to dodge the dangerous spikes embedded in the walls.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra didn’t pause as he activated another skill.
He suddenly changed direction, hoping that the cannonball could no longer sense him and would lose its target.
But just as he turned toward another intersection, the cannonball shot straight at him—giving him a fright.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: BOB
paragraphs: Vritra had entered the Fourth Dimension and even used Shift to increase his speed, while using Forbidden to decrease the speed of that creature. Still, only because of Yasmine’s help was he barely managing to survive against that thing.

He wasn’t sure if his Fourth Dimension would work against it or not, but even after disappearing from the real world, that large metallic ball was still able to sense his presence, which made him even more unsure. If his gamble failed, then one strike might really kill him.
Vritra was just running around aimlessly when a message popped up in front of him.
[You have entered the Death Canopy.]
[A sealed space within the Divine Sin Tomb, this place only serves two purposes — extermination and a test.

An area which was used to clean off anyone who tries to intrude into the Divine’s house. Either you find the way out or die, but the way out is non-existent. The level required to even have a chance to exit this plane is at least 1000 (Legion level).]
[Survival chance: None]
[Difficulty level: Impossible]
Vritra almost tripped as he read the lines, while Yasmine teleported him away just in time to avoid getting hit by that rolling creature. He wondered why he always ended up in this kind of situation.
{Sin Point Gained: Chased +1}

By the message, he got a little info. So this Divine is actually some kind of godly being who is probably dead—anyway, his own house had become his tomb. And just how these creatures are calledMyriadby being at or above level 1000, humans and demons are probably calledLegionwho had achieved or surpassed that level.
"FUCK!! What kind of test is it if there is no way out? Damn it, even if I use all my strength, I doubt I could even scratch the surface of its body."
Vritra was once again in a hopeless situation. This time, his opponent was way too strong.
He couldn’t keep running like this forever—soon Yasmine’s energy would be depleted and she wouldn’t be able to help him, then he would truly be doomed.
[Quest: Survive against and Kill one of the Balls of Brutality.]
[Reward: Myriad Armor, made from the Ball of Brutality, corresponding to its level.]
[Penalty: None]
"..." Vritra was truly speechless and felt so angry that he almost wanted to slice the display screen in two. When just running away is so difficult, how could he even think of killing one?

Vritra ignored this quest for now. The only skill that could help him kill stronger beings is Blood Lock, but there was no way he could break through the Ball of Brutality’s defenses and draw even a single drop of its blood.
Wait, one of them... doesn’t that mean there’s more than one?
{Sin Point Gained: Chased +2}

Vritra felt a tingly sensation all over his body. He noticed that while he seemed to be running randomly, it was as if his direction was being controlled by that large ball behind him. It seemed that wasn’t a mindless creature.

"Damn it, there are two or probably more?!! FUCK!! BOB, WHY THE FUCK ARE YOU CHASING ME?" Vritra cursed as he saw several intersections in front of him and on both sides. It was like BOB had planned to bring him to this place from the start.
The whole place was rumbling loudly and it was almost impossible to know from which place the other BOB would pop out. Thankfully, Vritra had his Nether Eye which greatly increased his senses.
’Oh right, Nether Eye. Maybe mental attack could work against it.’
Vritra first sensed the entire space around him, his feet moving at a blurring speed, and he didn’t dare pause for a moment.

He instantly sensed the intersection with the loudest vibration. His body twisted as a dust clone appeared right beside him. Vritra kicked the clone lightly to change his direction abruptly while sending the clone flying into that intersection.
By now, he had learned to bring his body parts out of the Fourth Dimension while his entire body remained there—just now, he had done the same with his feet.
BOOOM
Another ball, looking just as large but with even more dangerous spikes, shot out of that intersection, making the clone explode instantly. Now the two balls charged at Vritra at full speed.
"FUCK FUCK FUCK, why does the situation keep getting worse? I have to think of a way immediately. Damn it BOBs, why don’t you two play with one another?"
Vritra ran towards the door from which he had entered, as he took out several potions that would increase his strength, agility, and endurance.

He hastily gulped them all and received a boost of several dozen stat points before wearing back his mask. He even pulled out a couple of rings that he had taken from the king’s inventory—they too gave him a little boost over agility.
Finally, he was able to decrease the speed at which the first BOB was catching him. He couldn’t useForbidon the second BOB, so he had to rely on Yasmine.

The people from the Nine Pacts and Golden Moon had finally neutralized all the attacks that were targeted at them because of that hateful human. Almost all had survived, but most were in very bad condition.
Only the leaders were still mostly fine.
"Let’s join hands for now. We can’t let that demon escape," Number One suggested.
"Yes, it will just be to kill him. After that, we will fight fairly for the treasure of this place," the dragon-masked man replied.
After the arrangements were made, both of them charged into the gate with mad rage. They had even forgotten about the tomb for now and only wanted to kill Vritra.
Right after passing through the door, they found themselves standing in an ant-colony-like place, with countless caves and intersections. This was an even more difficult puzzle with no way out.
"How are we going to find him in this place?" the monkey-masked man asked, his voice full of rage.

"I don’t think he has found the way out just yet. He must be walking around somewhere in those caves. Let’s divide into groups and look for him," Number Two suggested. Even he couldn’t remain calm after being insulted by Vritra and made a fool of several times.
"Alright, we must kill him." Both sides agreed but just then...
"Brothersssss, so you came for me!! Thank you."
All the people were surprised to hear the detestable voice again. Because of the echo and strange rumblings, it was hard to find his location instantly.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +11,089}

But within moments, they all saw the same person in black and white dress charging towards them at an incredible speed. His hateful hidden face flashed in front of them for a moment as he passed by—before any of them could react.
His speed was so fast that even the leaders were caught off guards and they failed to make their moves immediately.
"Thank you," were the words that everyone heard, before his figure disappeared to their left.
The leaders faces became ferocious, they weren’t going to miss this chance to kill him but just then they all heard the rumbling and explosive sound getting closer- too close.
And then they saw the monster rolling towards them, carrying along an aura of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: The plan
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Hated +11,088}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +11,088}
All the men were frightened by the approaching deadly pressure. Vritra had passed by them too fast—none of them even had the chance to clearly see him.
WHOOSH
"Damnit, what kind of creature is that?" They soon saw a large round ball that was even faster than Vritra and emitted such a dangerous pressure, even the leaders were scared.

All of them hastily moved back, but strangely BOB 2 didn’t even glance at them as it continued to charge forward, trailing behind Vritra at full speed. But there were a few unlucky men who were unable to step back in time, so they ended up crushed just by the aftershocks.
Vritra cursed under his breath as he saw that the BOBs were charging toward him like bulls that had seen red, so without a pause, he ran even faster.
Soon BOB 1 appeared, and this creature did the same—ignoring all the others while madly following behind Vritra. All the other men were pleasantly surprised, and soon they were cheering happily.
"Serves you right, bastard! So there really is a God. I knew no bad person would go unpunished in this world!" one man from the Nine Pacts shouted.
"GO! GO! GO! Crush him, large balls! Kill that shameless, evil creature!" another man shouted.

"How strange. Did he offend those things in some way as well? He sure is a troublemaker. But at least he was able to attract the danger, giving us some time. But what should we do next?" Number 1 spoke as he observed the surroundings. Then he frowned—his strength was still decreasing gradually.
He hoped the effects would end after Vritra had died.

"But that bastard sure runs fast. I can’t believe he is still alive despite being chased by two Myriad creatures. Heh, but he would be dead quite soon. Anyway, we have to find an escape route before that happens," Number Three said while wearing a new mask.

"That is true. But if we enter those caves, then we would just end up crushed by those things—even if we aren’t the main targets. But we can’t just stand here and wait. After he is dead, we will be targeted by those monsters," Fox masked man spoke.
"Well, let’s enjoy the show for now then. We can only wait a little longer for some kind of opportunity."

"Why the fuck are these things just chasing me?! I am not even the strongest here—I’m merely at level 500s!!" Vritra kept taking turns left and right to avoid BOB 2. WithoutForbidden, that thing was too fast.
He thought of all possibilities. Could it be because ofNihil-Anima? That strange core? The Divine Sin Wheel?!!

"Yes, that might be it. The Divine Sin Wheel. Dang it, so there is no way to get rid of them. They might be trying to take back the Wheel. Tch... so trying to kill them is the only option." Vritra made up his mind. He had been through just as bad situations—how could he succeed without even trying?
No one in the world who is only a little over level 500 could ever try to challenge a Myriad or Legion. The difference in strength is too huge, like a newborn child challenging Thanos.

These two creatures might be smart, but could they compare to Vritra? They kept trying to trap him again and again, yet failed continuously. Vritra wasn’t just running around—he had already formed a big map in his mind. That was how he was able to find his way back so easily.
’More of their focus is just on killing me, so I will use myself as bait to kill them.’ His face was full of determination. He began to explore even the caves that he hadn’t visited.
He ran at his fastest for thirty or so more minutes and had finally remembered enough of the ways around to execute his plan. The only problem was that Yasmine’s energy was already quite low.
"How long... huff... can you... huff... hold on?" Vritra asked, as he drank a mana potion.

"For ten or so more minutes. After that, I won’t be able to do anything. If your plan doesn’t succeed, then I will at least be able to kill one of them by exploding myself." Yasmine’s voice already sounded quite weak.
{Sin Point Gained: Chased +2}

"There is... huff huff... no need for that. Huff... just wait..." Vritra gritted his teeth. How could he ever allow his first wife to sacrifice herself to protect him? He would rather die along with her.

Before starting his plan, he headed back toward the two groups. They had started to get nervous now—they couldn’t find a way out. And although they were shocked that Vritra had managed to survive till now, it wouldn’t be long before he died.
He ran toward them from a distance and started shouting: "If any of... huff... you have the... haa... soul potion, then g- give it... huff... to me!"
Vritra only had time to say that line before he ran too far away. After entering a cave and running in a circle, he came back again.
"Why should we? Heh. Die, you bastard!" Number One shouted. His strength was nearly down by almost fifty percent, so he was getting restless. Why would he help Vritra?

"If you don’t help... huff... me, then I w- will use... huff... this to kill you all. Give me... haa haa... your soul potions! If I die, you all will die immediately. Number One, I will free you!" Vritra again entered another cave with two balls following behind him, as he took another circular path and came back to the entrance after a minute or so.
The two groups discussed this in the time he was away. They didn’t know what he wanted to do with the soul potion, but if it could give them more time, then it was worth it.
"Fine! You better stay true to your words, or I will kill you myself." Number One collected over forty eight soul potions and threw them at Vritra’s approaching figure.
The blurry figure that had maintained the same speed caught all the soul potions and stored them in his inventory instantly, as he was teleported forward— just barely managing to dodge.
{Sin Point Gained: Ambushed +2}
BOOM BOOM
The two balls collided with the ground and barely missed hitting him. Vritra entered a new cave this time. He hastily began to gulp one soul potion after another, as waves of energy flooded his body.

He stopped everything from taking this energy— all of it was only for Yasmine to absorb. It took him a few minutes before he had finished them all, and Yasmine’s energy had been replenished by a little.
"Good. Now I can support you for more than thirty minutes. Be careful, hubby," Yasmine said worriedly before putting all her focus on protecting him.

Vritra nodded and took a deep breath. A path appeared in his mind, and he gave a couple of instructions to Yasmine before he took several sharp turns— but the two balls followed behind him closely, he wasn’t able to throw them off no matter what he did.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: RUN! BOOM! REPEAT!
paragraphs: ’I have already noted their thinking pattern. I know when and how they will try to ambush me. I will use that chance. Plus, my plan depends on the fact that they have enough difference between their strengths,’ Vritra thought. He arrived at a part with more than ten intersections.
According to his plan, BOB 1 would follow behind him as he entered the number 3 cave, while BOB 2 would enter another cave to ambush him—since the two paths met ahead.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]

Vritra slightly decreased his speed and began to jump off the walls like BOB. He calculated the exact time and position in his mind and shot towards the place where the cave ended and more intersections joined.
WHOOSH
{Sin Point Gained: Ambushed +1}

Just as he had expected, the other BOB came at exceedingly fast speed from his right at the time he had calculated. Vritra gritted his teeth and waited for a moment until the spikes of the two BOBs were almost touching his body; only then did he shout: "NOW!!"
BOOOOOOOOM!!

Vritra’s body disappeared, and the two BOBs collided, creating a thunderous explosion. The walls shook, and Vritra felt his head spin for a moment just from that sound. Dust flew everywhere, and both the balls were thrown away.

Vritra used his Nether Eye to observe. He wondered if the clash was able to produce any kind of damage to either of the BOBs, and much to his joy, he saw a faint crack on the body of BOB 1—even a few of its spikes had been broken.

’Perfect, now I just need to continue it for a while longer,’ he thought. Vritra knew that these creatures were smart, and they wouldn’t keep falling for the same trick again and again, but he just needed to wait for that perfect timing.
If he can’t hurt them, then he will use them both to hurt each other.

"Again!!" He ran away from there, using whatever means to increase the distance between them. Both the BOBs came to their senses almost instantly as they continued with their charge, following behind him.
The thousands of men stood silently. They were shocked to hear that loud explosion. Not long after, a wave of strong wind hit them—they could tell just how terrifying the explosion was.
"He is finally dead!!" All the people became so happy, they hugged each other. But then they remembered that it was now their turn to be chased and killed.
Just then, they saw the two balls again running—this time Vritra was nowhere in sight, which made them sure of their doubts; he was really dead.

All of them panicked and didn’t know how to react. The two large metallic creatures were too fast, but strangely, this time again, they didn’t pay any attention to the large group and followed behind an invisible target.
"What’s going on?" they mumbled in confusion.

Vritra took a different turn this time. BOB 2 was closer to him than the other one. He again came to a point where he had several intersections in front of him. He was sure they wouldn’t try to ambush him again because of what happened the last time.

But Vritra planned to take advantage of their difference in speed and the distance he had with each BOB. He ran into one of the caves and BOB 2 followed, but before BOB 1 could follow him, Vritra suddenly teleported to the entrance just beside it.

BOB 2 had no choice but to continue, while BOB 1 changed its direction just in time and followed Vritra. He had succeeded again, and just as he planned, after a few seconds there was another ear-piercing explosion—even harder than the last one.
BOOOOOOOOM!!
Vritra didn’t pause as he observed the two creatures. BOB 1 was the one to suffer more damage; the cracks on its body got deeper and stretched even more, while more of its spikes were broken.

’Damnit, why are these things so tough? Even they themselves can’t deliver too much damage to each other. How was I supposed to kill even a single one of them?’ Vritra cursed in his mind, as he again moved toward the entrance.

The people there saw the same scene again—two balls rolled from their left to their right, chasing after an invisible enemy. They wondered if these creatures had gone mad after killing Vritra. But why were there two explosions then?
WHOOSH WHOOSH

They watched it all silently while moving as close to the door as they could, but they couldn’t go back to the previous plane. They were all afraid that if they made even the slightest move, then they would attract these crazy creatures’ attention.
"What do you think is going on? Is that person really dead? But why was there the second explosion?" Number One asked, frowning. The effect of Blood Lock was still at work.
Either that detestable person was still alive and had gone back on his promise, or he was dead and this skill would keep on working even after his death—which meant he had gone back on his promise.

’Fuck, how can I get rid of this strange curse? Do I need to go out there to search for him? But I have just a little over fifty percent strength left.’ Number One really was at his wits’ end. He was now really afraid of death, but the others didn’t seem to have noticed his predicament yet.
"Whatever might be the case, what are we supposed to do now? We can’t move and can’t keep standing here—both will result in our death," the dragon masked man spoke.
Just then...
BOOOOOM!!!

Another explosion sounded and all of them shivered. Just by the sound, they could tell that if that thing hit them, they would become minced meat. This was too terrifying—even the two top leaders couldn’t help but shiver.
This was already the third explosion. The two Myriad creatures once again came rolling from the left not long after, just as everyone had expected.

Like before, they just rolled to the left without paying any attention to the audience. But this time, the dragon-masked man barely noticed several cracks on the body of one of those creatures which weren’t there before, and seemed to have just been inflicted.
Number One couldn’t even keep up with that speed with his vision anymore. All of his abilities had grown weaker.

’What are those explosions exactly? And what kind of terrifying entity could inflict such damage to a Myriad creature... it couldn’t be him, right? Yeah, he must already be dead. What is going on here exactly? Tsk, coming here might have been a mistake,’ Dragon Mask thought.

Vritra had started to pant heavily, his speed decreasing just a tiny bit as he ran for the fourth time, passing by the audience as he made a different approach to separate the two BOBs. After that, he calculated the time and position of the explosion.
And after a few seconds...
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

Finally, at the fourth explosion, Vritra’s lips curled up as he watched the two BOBs with his Third Eye. He was filled with excitement as he had finally succeeded in achieving the first step of his plan.
’BLOOD!! I made it bleed.’

chapters.title: Chapter 98: RUN! BOOM! REPEAT! 2
paragraphs: ’BLOOD!! I made it bleed!!’ Vritra exclaimed.

The small success filled him with even more determination. BOB 2 was disoriented for just a moment before it began to follow Vritra again, while BOB 1 needed a couple of seconds since it had been very slightly injured.
’Teleport me back to it,’ Vritra said in his mind while running as fast as he could. Just as BOB 2 was about to collide with his back, Vritra disappeared.

He appeared instantly at the place where the two balls had collided previously. Without stopping, he picked a few drops of greyish blood off the ground using dust as he began running in the opposite direction.
Then...
[Blood Lock Activated.]
[Target Locked. Time Until Death: 3 hours 19 minutes 59 seconds.]

Of course, he had to remove the Blood Lock from Number One, but his strength had already been reduced by nearly fifty percent and he would need quite some time to get back to his peak. Currently, he wasn’t a threat to Vritra.
’Now I just need to hold on for long enough. As its strength weakens, the impact of the two of them colliding will get more intense, and very soon, it will get very weak.

Haa... Yasmine, are you alright? Tell me when your energy is nearly exhausted,’ he said. Even as exhaustion began to take hold of him, Vritra didn’t lower his speed. Now was the crucial time of this fight.
"Yeah, I can hold on for now. Let’s do it," Yasmine said. It had been so long since she felt this kind of excitement. Once you reach high enough, there are fewer things that could move you.

’Alright. After we leave, I will make sure to find even more soul potions for you.’ While he continued to run, a thought popped into his mind and he asked: ’When you were at your peak, how easily could you have defeated this creature?’
"Hehe, I’m not bragging or anything, but just a finger flick would have been enough to kill them both," Yasmine replied with a chuckle.

Though there was no arrogance in her voice, nor did she try to act superior or anything; Vritra might be weaker for now, but very soon his strength would soar—and even if he did remain weak, she wouldn’t mind keeping him all to herself.
"..." Vritra nodded, not doubting her words. Her words only made him more determined to increase his strength as fast as he could, but for now, he needed to only focus on his survival.

Both the giant balls rolled behind Vritra. BOB 1’s speed was more or less not that much faster than Vritra, so he could perfectly evade it, but BOB 2 was even faster—plus it didn’t possess the restriction ofForbidden.

While remaining in the Fourth Dimension, Vritra continued to keep running in circles. He avoided the paths he hadn’t already ventured in and was barely managing to escape from the two Myriad creatures.

The audience had already gotten used to this pattern. They watched the giant balls coming from the left and sometimes the right, while chasing after nothing. Sometimes the sound of the explosion would ring out, and sometimes the balls would just keep circling around.
Almost thirty minutes had passed. Under the shocked and frightened gazes of all the people in the audience, as the slower ball passed by them, a trail of greyish blood was drawn on the ground.
Number One finally felt relaxed. The strange curse had finally ended; although his strength had not returned to his peak yet, he could tell that soon his strength would start to return.

The dragon-masked man from the Golden Moon watched as the injuries on the slower ball got more intense after every loud explosion. Even its speed was slowing down, and just after 30 minutes, the metallic armor all over its body was badly damaged.

’Are these two things fighting each other for some reason?’ he wondered. Although he could barely see the first ball, which was much faster, he noticed that a few spikes seemed to be broken and faint lines had formed on its surface too—but they weren’t too noticeable.

Vritra was already extremely exhausted even with the support of all his skills. He had been running at his fastest for so long, while leading and dodging the two monstrosities. Having them chase madly was quite terrifying—just one of these creatures could slaughter everyone in the cave within seconds.

’Its strength has been reduced by fifteen percent, which had an even more significant effect on a creature with such a high level than Number One. It had already received so many injuries from these clashes, but it’s still not enough.’ Vritra gritted his teeth as he drank several types of potions and continued to run at his top speed.
BOOOOOOM!!
The balls collided again, and BOB 1 smashed against the wall as pieces of its armor flew around and blood splattered. Most of its spikes were already broken while BOB 2’s spikes had pierced its body.
Thirty more minutes had passed. By now, the Blood Lock had been active for over one hour, reducing BOB 1’s strength by thirty percent.

Yasmine was too exhausted, so she could no longer teleport him—but by now, Vritra no longer needed that. He had usedForbiddenon BOB 2 now, restricting its agility. Since the other creature’s strength had already lowered and its condition had gotten very bad after many collisions...
Its speed already wasn’t even forty percent of its top speed, so Vritra no longer needed to useForbiddenon it. Instead, if it got too slow, then it would be impossible to make the two clash.

All in all, Vritra was now able to dodge the two on his own. He took a sudden turn at one of the intersections while sending his clone to another. BOB 2 followed behind him, while the other one—which was in very bad condition—was just running forward now. It just mindlessly followed behind the clone. It seemed just the thought of killing Vritra remained in its mind now. In its current state, it couldn’t do much.
Again, Vritra calculated based on their speeds and the distance—slowing down slightly and jumping over the walls to delay a bit according to BOB 1’s speed. And when he came out of the cave...
BOOOOOOOOM!!

This seemed to be the final attack which had finally managed to push BOB 1 into a very weakened state. Almost all the armor over its body had been shattered, revealing a greyish, thick skin underneath, which was bleeding from all over.
After the impact, it could no longer charge behind Vritra. It just stayed on the ground, probably unconscious or too weak to move. And finally, the second part of Vritra’s plan had succeeded.

"I did it!!" Vritra rejoiced as he hastily ran to make another circle. Then he removed the Fourth Dimension and finally revealed his figure to the shocked and baffled crowd—they were sure he was long dead after all.
{Sin Point Gained: Dazed +11,076}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +11,075}
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +11,076}

Vritra paid no mind to the audience. He ran into the same cave as the last time and made his way toward the injured BOB 1 as fast as he could and took out both hisAxes of Chaos, a wide smile appearing on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Extract
paragraphs: Holding the axes in his hands, Vritra ran towards BOB 1 at full speed; the injured ball lay in its battered form, unable to move at all. Even for a Myriad creature, it had received too much damage, while its strength kept weakening.

The second creature paid no mind, even as it had injured its companion. It continued to charge towards Vritra as if they had found the true purpose of their life—both of them had made him run all over the place for so long.

Finally, it was the last or probably the second last step of his plan. As he approached BOB 1, Vritra raised both his hands above his head, taking the partial form of a dragon as black scales grew over his body.
He used Shift again, and momentarily his speed decreased while he poured all those points into strength. Vritra suddenly felt power filling his muscles.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility → Strength]
Agility: 10Strength: 3555

Releasing a thunderous roar, Vritra brought down both the axes, pointing the sharp parts downward. Even if the creature was severely injured, Vritra was not taking it easy. His hands and axes began to glow with a dark purple flame as he drew all the Evil-Veyll God Essence from his Essence Core.
He had decided to pour everything into this one attack. Previously, he had killed someone nearly level 850, but this time the bar had been raised to above level 1000.

He could feel the second creature creeping close to him at a great pace. Vritra wasted no time as he struck the injured ball with the sharp blades of the axes. Even its flesh was extremely hard, but after a slight resistance, the blades actually began to tear apart its flesh as they plunged deeper and deeper.
CRIIIIIIIEEEEEEKKKKKKKKKKKK!!!
For the first time, BOB released a loud roar as pain coursed through its body, but it was too weak to do anything. As the axes tore into its body, they finally plunged into its organs.
Then the purple flames, which were extremely destructive, wreaked havoc inside its body—cutting and crushing everything within. The large ball was being ground into tiny pieces from the inside.

Vritra didn’t stop — as the momentum from his downward strike pulled him forward, he leaned into it and rolled ahead with the force. The corpse, still skewered on both axe blades, moved with him like a grotesque extension of his own body.

It spun under his feet, dragged behind his back, then whipped forward once more. The half-shredded flesh rotated violently around him. Blood sprayed in arcs, and chunks of ruined muscle scattered across the ground, while the smouldering purple flames clung to the torn body of the creature until it took its last breath.
Then in the next moment...
[You have killed a Level 1011 Ball of Brutality.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
BOB 1 was finally dead.

He had actually managed to kill a Myriad creature, a being with over a thousand level. The power difference between 999 and 1000 is quite vast, even a warrior close to legion level can’t defeat someone who had just arrived at that level.
Vritra felt strength pouring into his body, but before he could follow up with any action, he sensed the other ball getting dangerously close to him.
So without a second thought, he threw the axes and the large corpse into his inventory, then used Shift again—and his agility increased even more because of so many level-ups.
Vritra was painted in greyish blood, but he didn’t have the time to stop and enjoy his feat. He sped forward and barely managed to dodge getting pinned by those dangerous spikes.

’Plan 1 was successful with only one step remaining now. I need to create more distance between us for that, but Yasmine is too exhausted right now.’ Vritra gritted his teeth and pulled out several bottles of mana potions.

He reached deeper into the caves and then gulped all of them hastily. A large amount of energy flowed into his body, which made his face turn red. This energy couldn’t be stored since his mana meter was already full.

Vritra paused for a moment all of a sudden, and then he used every bit of energy in his body as a vast amount of dust exploded out of him, completely filling up several hundred caves without leaving even a tiny space.
Even the audience were shocked after seeing so much dust leaking out of the caves all of a sudden. It was not enough to stop the deadly creature but could block it for a moment or two.
"..." Vritra pulled several more bottles of mana potions and his axes, to which the corpse of the BOB 1 was still stuck. He drank one bottle after another, and in the midst, he shouted:
"EXTRACT!!"
The invisible flames burst out of his body, completely enveloping the corpse. All the energy was instantly sucked dry from his body as the transformation to becoming a Soul Wraith had just begun.

If he failed at this step because of a lack of energy, then he really would end up dead at the hands of the other BOB. He drank one mana potion after another without any pause and gave all this energy to Nihil-Anima, as the corpse began to disintegrate.

This was such a bad feeling—drinking the mana potion again and again only to be emptied of all energy the next moment. He felt utterly exhausted, and even his mind was being affected, but he didn’t halt as he chugged bottle after bottle of the potions.
The extremely fast rotating ball was slowly getting closer—now it was a war of time and luck.

Vritra was shocked that this thing needed so much energy. He was so close to failure, but Nihil-Anima worked super hard as it consumed blood, essence, and soul of the dead creature, using a part of its own energy to help its owner.
After what felt like an eternity, the corpse had completely disappeared and...
[SOUL WRAITH INVENTORY]:
Name: BOB Rank: Myriad Creature Level: 1011

Vritra was overjoyed—plus extremely exhausted—as he sensed the presence of a terrifying being appearing in his body. Its strength was just as high as before it had died, but now it was like an undead, so it could be said to be even stronger.
Vritra looked at the stats of the Myriad creature in a haste. His combat strength had just been increased to a whole other level.
Race: Ball of Brutality
Level:1011
Vitality:100%
Field: SPACE
Stats:
• Strength: 12,059
• Agility: 13,538
• Endurance: 16,458
• Intelligence: 10,842

’Whoa, so high... It’s like almost ten times my stats. Its stats shouldn’t be so high—after all, with each level up our attributes increase by just one, aside from the allocation points. And what is that "Field"...?’ Vritra wondered, but he had no time for a chit-chat, as he heard the explosive sound from behind.

Even for a Myriad creature, it had received too much damage, while its strength kept weakening.
The second creature paid no mind, even as it had injured its companion.
It continued to charge towards Vritra as if they had found the true purpose of their life—both of them had made him run all over the place for so long.
Finally, it was the last or probably the second last step of his plan.
As he approached BOB 1, Vritra raised both his hands above his head, taking the partial form of a dragon as black scales grew over his body.
He used Shift again, and momentarily his speed decreased while he poured all those points into strength.
Vritra suddenly felt power filling his muscles.

Releasing a thunderous roar, Vritra brought down both the axes, pointing the sharp parts downward.
Even if the creature was severely injured, Vritra was not taking it easy.
His hands and axes began to glow with a dark purple flame as he drew all the Evil-Veyll God Essence from his Essence Core.
He had decided to pour everything into this one attack.
Previously, he had killed someone nearly level 850, but this time the bar had been raised to above level 1000.

As the axes tore into its body, they finally plunged into its organs.
Then the purple flames, which were extremely destructive, wreaked havoc inside its body—cutting and crushing everything within.
The large ball was being ground into tiny pieces from the inside.
Vritra didn’t stop — as the momentum from his downward strike pulled him forward, he leaned into it and rolled ahead with the force.
The corpse, still skewered on both axe blades, moved with him like a grotesque extension of his own body.
It spun under his feet, dragged behind his back, then whipped forward once more.
The half-shredded flesh rotated violently around him.
Blood sprayed in arcs, and chunks of ruined muscle scattered across the ground, while the smouldering purple flames clung to the torn body of the creature until it took its last breath.

He sped forward and barely managed to dodge getting pinned by those dangerous spikes.

This energy couldn’t be stored since his mana meter was already full.
